About DHL Blue Dart Express India:


Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


Position Overview:


The Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


Job Purpose:


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


Key Roles \& Responsibilities:


Pickup \& Delivery Operations

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.


Customer Service Excellence

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.


COD \& Documentation Management

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.


Operational Compliance

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.

title: Software Development Engineer I
description:
**About the role** 


 India built saving discipline long before smartphones. Chit funds, gold schemes at the family jeweller, collectors at the shop door every evening. Those systems built saving habits for crores of Indians. We are rebuilding that discipline digitally, for the ten crore Indians.
 





 Our user is getting their first daily usable finance app for savings, on a budget device and a patchy network. When the app stutters, they do not file a bug. They uninstall and go back to cash. Building for them is a harder engineering problem than building for users who forgive.
 





 You will own the mobile app end to end. You take a feature from development to testing to build to a live release on both stores, yourself. There is no release team behind you, and that is the point. In two years here you will have shipped more than most engineers do in five at a large company.
 




  




**What you will do** 
* Develop and maintain the app in React Native across Android and iOS, with React.js for web surfaces where needed.
* Build responsive, reusable UI components that hold up on low\-end devices.
* Integrate REST APIs, Firebase, and third\-party services; handle state management, authentication, push notifications, and deep linking.
* Monitor crashes through Firebase Crashlytics, debug from the trace, and optimize for performance and stability.
* Manage Android and iOS builds end to end: signing, certificates, provisioning profiles, and release configurations using Android Studio, Xcode, Gradle, and CocoaPods.
* Deploy to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store and own app launches and releases.
* Work directly with product, design, backend, and QA; follow Git workflows and participate in code reviews.



  




**Must have** 
* 1\+ years of hands\-on production experience with React Native or React.js.
* Strong JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience integrating REST APIs and Firebase, including Crashlytics.
* Hands\-on experience generating and deploying Android and iOS builds.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills, and a solid grasp of Git workflows.
* Proof of work. Something you shipped that we can see: a live app, a GitHub repo, or a TestFlight build.



  




**Good to have** 
* Next.js experience.
* CI/CD and automated build pipelines.
* App Store and Play Store release management.
* Native module integration (Kotlin/Java for Android, Swift/Objective\-C for iOS) for when JavaScript is not enough.



  




**How to apply** 


 Mail bharatg@onmeta.in with proof of what you have shipped. A live app, a GitHub repo, a TestFlight build. Anything real beats a resume. Subject line: your name plus the best thing you have shipped.
 




  





**About OnMeta** 




 OnMeta is registered with the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU\-IND), Ministry of Finance, Government of India. Our infrastructure powers buy and sell experiences for more than 80 web3 platforms, with UPI settlements in under 60 seconds and KYC that completes in under two minutes.
 



 That is the plumbing. What you will build is the consumer product on top of it: a new savings app for Indian users, from the same team, on rails that already move real money every day. You get zero\-to\-one ownership with regulated, production infrastructure underneath.

title: Hardware Engineer
description:
**Hardware Engineer** 

**SKEYEBOTS \| Bangalore, India \| Full\-Time \| Hybrid**



**About SKEYEBOTS** 

 SKEYEBOTS is an AI\-driven autonomous systems company developing intelligent hardware and software for unmanned platforms operating across aerial, ground, and maritime environments. We build for demanding, real\-world conditions where reliability, performance, and resilience are non\-negotiable.
 



 With engineering operations across India, we are a well\-funded, rapidly scaling organisation with a strong institutional foundation and an ambitious roadmap ahead.
 



 We are not looking for people who want to maintain. We are looking for engineers who want to build — and grow with a company doing it at scale.
   




**The Role** 

 This is a hands\-on hardware engineering role covering the full electronics and firmware lifecycle — from PCB design through board bring\-up, drone assembly, sensor integration, and field validation. You will work closely with our senior hardware engineer and hardware architect, contributing to the electronics that support multiple autonomous platform types, including systems that support and interface with our platforms on the ground.
 



 If you have strong electronics fundamentals, working firmware capability, and want your work deployed into real systems from day one, this role is for you.
   




**What You'll Do** 

**Electronics Design \& PCB Development** 



* Support and contribute to PCB design: component selection, schematic entry, multilayer layout, and routing
* Work on circuit design and analysis — power supplies, filter circuits, oscillator circuits, and protection circuits
* Apply EMI/EMC best practices and support signal integrity checks during design
* Contribute to DFM\-compliant layouts ready for manufacturing handoff



**Firmware Development** 



* Develop firmware in Embedded C for microcontroller and microprocessor\-based subsystems
* Support RTOS\-based firmware development (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or equivalent) for real\-time embedded applications
* Work with peripheral drivers, communication protocol stacks (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN), and sensor integration firmware
* Support firmware development for auxiliary ground\-support systems as needed



**Board Bring\-Up, Testing \& Validation** 



* Support board bring\-up and electrical debugging on new designs
* Conduct hardware\-firmware co\-debugging during bring\-up and integration
* Perform functional, environmental, and reliability validation on hardware and full\-system builds
* Use oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related instruments for debugging and validation
* Document test results, failure analysis, and validation reports



**Drone Assembly, Integration \& Field Testing** 



* Assemble and integrate drone platforms — sensors, electronics, and subsystems
* Support system\-level integration testing across aerial and ground platforms
* Participate in field testing and flight operations (DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate sponsored if not already held)
* Identify and resolve hardware and firmware\-level issues during field deployment


**What We're Looking For** 

**Required** 



* B.Tech / B.E. in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline
* 2\+ years of hands\-on professional experience in electronics hardware and firmware development
* Working knowledge of PCB design fundamentals — schematic entry, layout, and routing on multilayer boards
* Solid grounding in analog and digital circuit design and analysis
* Working proficiency in PCB design tools: KiCad or Altium Designer
* Understanding of EMI/EMC principles and DFM basics
* Hands\-on board bring\-up and hardware debugging experience
* Embedded C programming with exposure to RTOS concepts
* Familiarity with embedded communication protocols: I2C, SPI, UART, CAN
* Ability to work independently and take ownership in a fast\-paced environment



**Preferred** 



* Prior experience with autonomous systems, UAVs, robotics, or unmanned vehicles
* Experience with FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar RTOS platforms
* Experience designing for IP\-rated or rugged enclosures
* Exposure to 3D modelling (SolidWorks or equivalent) and 3D printing for prototyping
* Version control with Git
* DGCA Remote Pilot Training (RPT) certification (a plus, not a requirement)


**What You'll Get** 
* Direct mentorship from a senior hardware engineer and hardware architects with deep industry experience
* Hands\-on exposure across electronics, firmware, drone assembly, and field integration in a single role
* Employee Stock Options (ESOPs) — genuine equity upside as the company scales
* A fast track to greater ownership as you grow into the role
* The opportunity to see your work deployed into real, operational autonomous systems


**Location** 

 Bangalore, Karnataka — hybrid work culture. Travel to Kochi as required.
   




**How to Apply** 

 Send your CV and, where possible, examples of PCB designs, firmware projects, or hardware builds you have worked on to
 **LinkedIn Easy Apply** 
 .
 



 This is an immediate hire. We review applications on a rolling basis and move quickly.
 



*SKEYEBOTS is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate candidates solely on capability, potential, and drive.*

Creative Graphic Designer — D2C, Performance \& Social Media
   

 Company: 4Mation Skins (a 4Mation Biosciences Pvt. Ltd. brand)
   

 Location: Kolkata, West Bengal — On\-site
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Experience: 2–4 years
   

 Joining: Immediate joiners preferred
   

  

 About 4Mation Skins:
   

  

 4Mation Skins is a Kolkata\-based D2C skincare brand built on pharma\-grade formulation and backed by 4Mation Biosciences Pvt. Ltd. We sell through our own website, Amazon, Myntra and quick\-commerce, and we grow through performance marketing — which means creative is not a support function here. It is the product that gets seen.
   

  

 About the Role:
   

  

 We believe high\-performing creative is never an accident. It doesn't start in Photoshop or Canva — it starts with understanding the Ideal Customer Profile.
   

  

 We are looking for a Creative Graphic Designer who instinctively asks:
   

  

 ☆Who is this creative actually speaking to?
   

  

 ☆What specific skin concern or objection are we solving here?
   

  

 ☆What visual hook will stop the thumb in the first two seconds?
   

  

 ☆Which angle will test best — Ingredient Education, Problem\-Solution, or Social Proof?
   

  

 This is a full\-stack brand design role. You will own everything the customer sees: the ads that acquire them, the social content that builds trust, and the website experience that converts them.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 Performance Marketing Creatives:
   

  

 Design high\-converting static ads, carousels and creative variations for Meta and Google campaigns
   

 Build multiple angle variations and hooks for structured creative testing
   

 Design landing page visual assets that carry the ad message through to conversion
   

  

 Social Media Creative Design:
   

  

 Design organic social content for Instagram, Facebook and YouTube — static posts, carousels, story sets and Reel covers
   

 Build and maintain a consistent visual language across the brand grid so paid and organic feel like one brand
   

 Translate product launches, offers, ingredient stories and UGC into scroll\-stopping social assets
   

 Design festive, seasonal and campaign creatives in line with the monthly content calendar.
   

  

 Video \& Motion:
   

  

 Edit short\-form video ads, Reels and UGC\-style creatives
   

 Create motion graphics, kinetic typography and high\-impact opening hooks
   

 Repurpose long\-form and UGC footage into multiple ad\-ready cuts
   

  

 Website UI/UX:
   

  

 Design and improve landing pages, product detail pages and checkout flows for our D2C store
   

 Create wireframes, user flows and high\-fidelity mockups in Figma
   

 Apply conversion\-first thinking to layout — above\-the\-fold hierarchy, CTA placement, trust elements, mobile\-first responsiveness
   

 Maintain a reusable design system and component library so pages ship faster
   

 Work with the development team to ensure designs are implemented pixel\-accurately
   

  

 Marketplace \& Quick\-Commerce Assets:
   

  

 Produce listing images, A\+ content and category banners for Amazon, Myntra and quick\-commerce platforms
   

 Adapt master creatives across formats, aspect ratios and platform guidelines.
   

  

 Creative Iteration \& Performance:
   

  

 Work with the marketing team to review CTR, thumbstop rate, hold rate and creative fatigue
   

 Rapidly iterate on winning angles and retire what stops working
   

 Maintain an organised creative library with clear naming and version control.
   

  

 Required Skills \& Qualifications:
   

  

 Strong command of Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator and Figma
   

 Video editing ability in Premiere Pro, After Effects or CapCut
   

 Working knowledge of UI/UX fundamentals — visual hierarchy, responsive and mobile\-first design, design systems, prototyping
   

 A solid understanding of ICP, audience personas, hooks and consumer psychology: why some creatives convert and others get skipped
   

 Ability to design for conversion, not just aesthetics, and to explain the reasoning behind a layout
   

 Comfort using AI\-assisted creative tools for faster visual exploration and storyboarding
   

 Speed, ownership and comfort in a fast\-moving environment with weekly shipping cycles.
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 Prior hands\-on experience designing for D2C skincare, beauty, personal care or FMCG brands or agencies
   

 Experience designing for Shopify or WooCommerce storefronts
   

 Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and reading creative\-level performance data
   

 Basic understanding of CRO principles and A/B testing.
   

  

  

 How to Apply:
   

  

 Send a direct message, or share your updated resume along with a portfolio link showcasing your best Meta ads, D2C statics, social media designs, website/UI work and video or Reel creatives.
   

  

 One extra ask: pick one creative you made that performed well, and tell us in two lines why it worked. That answer tells us more than the portfolio does.
   

 Let's build visual storytelling that communicates, connects and converts.

title: Presales Solution Consultant(Managed Services)
description:
Overview of 66degrees
   

  

 66degrees is an end\-to\-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.
   

  

 At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
   

  

 Overview of Role
   

  

 As a Solution Consultant, you act as a trusted advisor bridging pre\-sales architectural design with long\-term operational success. You will collaborate with Sales, Engineering, and Service Delivery teams to craft robust proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs) that ensure both successful implementations and ongoing stability for Managed Services clients.
   

  

 In partnership with the sales team, you will formulate and execute a technical sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of the Google Cloud Platform. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help customers understand best practices around advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to these solutions. Additionally you will educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of Cloud and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud or on\-premise as needed.
   

  

 Managed Services Excellence
   

  

* SLA Management: Ensuring deliverables and services meet defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Incident Management \& RCA: Participating in or leading Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical production issues to ensure ongoing system reliability.
* Long\-term Stability: Managing the transition from implementation to ongoing operational support.


**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with sales and engineering teams to understand customer requirements and develop tailored cloud solutions using Google Cloud Platform services.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers to drive customer success and satisfaction.
* Specify the deliverables of services projects by developing detailed project Statement of work (SOWs).
* Put on consulting hat during stakeholder engagements and drive full stack thinking around both business and technology levers
* Assist the sales team with the preparedness and delivery of technical presentations, estimations, and Statements of Work.
* Be a technical and business consultant to our clients before, during, and after implementations.
* Differentiate 66degrees products and services from our competitors by understanding the market and industry intimately.
* Design and propose custom cloud based solutions for clients based on your research and their needs.
* Prepare demonstrations and proof of concept environments based on client requirements.
* Act as a technical resource for our team by continually bringing value and an innovative mindset to our projects.
* Assist with and perform deliverable work for clients to gain first\-hand experience with solutions.
* Embrace 66degrees team mentality by providing our team general support on new products and technology in the market.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience working within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Azure/AWS; GCP Preferred.
* Professional level certification in GCP is required within first 90 days of employment.
* Experience strategizing, designing, architecting, and leading the deployment of scalable solutions on GCP, strongly preferred.
* Experience with traditional and cloud infrastructure as well as cloud migrations.
* Experience with the primary managed data services within GCP, including Cloud Bigtable, Cloud Spanner, Cloud SQL, or BigQuery.
* Experience with using AI Platform, GE Agent Platform, Agent Studio, or BigQuery ML to manage and deploy machine learning models.
* Specify the deliverables of services projects by developing detailed project scopes of work (SOWs); Assist sales team with preparedness and delivery of technical presentations, estimations, and Statements of Work.
* Experience with container engines: Kubernetes, Docker, AWS Elastic Container Service.
* Experience with automation technologies including Terraform, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, AWS Cloud Formation or Microsoft Azure Automation
* Experience working with engineering and sales teams to elicit customer requirements.
* Ability to communicate across business units and the ability to interface with and communicate complex technical concepts to a broad range of internal and external stakeholders
* Advocate and demonstrate the value of the Google Cloud and service offerings to prospects.
* India: Willingness to work 12\.30pm to 9\.30pm IST shift for overlap with global team.
* Experience within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or large\-scale enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated understanding of SLA\-driven service delivery and operational best practices.


***Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.***
*66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*
**AI Transparency \& Disclosure**
 As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools—including LinkedIn Recruiter’s Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies—to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights.
   

  

 These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

title: HR and Admin Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONStrategic HR Manager – Workforce Productivity \& HR Operations

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Designation:** Strategic HR Manager  
**Industry:** Information Technology  
**Reports To:** Head of HR / Managing Director  
**Location:** \[Location]  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

1\. Job Purpose

The **Strategic HR Manager** will be responsible for managing and strengthening the complete employee lifecycle while driving **workforce productivity, HR operations, payroll, onboarding, employee engagement, compliance, and performance management**.

The role requires a strategic HR professional who can connect people practices with business objectives, improve employee productivity, establish efficient HR systems, and ensure smooth day\-to\-day HR administration within the IT organization.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Strategic HR Management

* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.
* Support management in workforce planning, organizational development, and people strategy.
* Analyze workforce requirements and recommend appropriate staffing levels.
* Develop HR policies, procedures, and employee guidelines.
* Identify HR risks and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide management with HR reports, dashboards, and actionable insights.

B. Workforce Productivity \& Performance

* Monitor employee productivity, utilization, attendance, and workforce efficiency.
* Establish **KPIs, KRAs, and performance measurement systems** for different departments.
* Track individual and team performance against defined targets.
* Identify productivity gaps and coordinate improvement plans.
* Develop performance improvement plans (PIPs) wherever required.
* Monitor employee workload, resource allocation, overtime, absenteeism, and attrition.
* Work closely with department heads to improve team productivity.
* Prepare monthly workforce productivity reports for management.
* Recommend process improvements to reduce manpower costs and improve efficiency.

C. Payroll Management

* Manage and coordinate the complete monthly payroll process.
* Verify attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, deductions, and salary revisions before payroll processing.
* Ensure accurate calculation of salaries, reimbursements, bonuses, and other employee benefits.
* Coordinate with Finance/Accounts for timely payroll processing.
* Maintain payroll records and employee salary documentation.
* Ensure payroll confidentiality and data accuracy.
* Handle employee payroll\-related queries and resolve discrepancies.
* Support statutory payroll requirements such as **PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS**, and other applicable compliances.

D. Employee Onboarding

* Manage the complete employee onboarding process from offer acceptance to joining.
* Coordinate documentation, background verification, employment agreements, and joining formalities.
* Ensure employee profiles are created in HRMS and other required systems.
* Coordinate with IT/Admin for email IDs, system access, laptops, ID cards, and other assets.
* Conduct HR induction and explain company policies, procedures, benefits, and code of conduct.
* Establish an effective **30/60/90\-day onboarding and integration process**.
* Track probation and confirmation timelines.

E. HR Administration

* Maintain accurate and updated employee records and HR databases.
* Manage attendance, leave, shift schedules, holidays, and employee movements.
* Issue HR letters including appointment, confirmation, promotion, increment, transfer, warning, experience, relieving, and other employment\-related letters.
* Maintain employee personal files and HR documentation.
* Manage employee lifecycle transactions such as joining, transfers, promotions, salary revisions, and exits.
* Ensure HR documentation is properly maintained and confidential.
* Implement HRMS and digital HR processes to reduce manual work.

F. Employee Engagement \& Retention

* Develop employee engagement initiatives suitable for an IT workforce.
* Conduct employee feedback surveys and engagement activities.
* Identify factors affecting employee satisfaction and retention.
* Conduct employee interaction meetings and address workplace concerns.
* Support management in developing employee recognition and reward programs.
* Monitor employee turnover and conduct **exit interviews and attrition analysis**.
* Develop retention strategies for critical and high\-performing employees.

G. Recruitment \& Workforce Planning

* Work with department heads to identify current and future manpower requirements.
* Prepare manpower plans based on business growth and project requirements.
* Coordinate recruitment activities with internal/external recruiters.
* Monitor recruitment metrics including **Time\-to\-Hire, Cost\-per\-Hire, Offer\-to\-Join Ratio, and Quality of Hire**.
* Ensure timely hiring of critical technical and non\-technical positions.
* Maintain talent pipelines for key positions.

H. Learning \& Development

* Identify employee skill gaps through performance reviews and manager feedback.
* Coordinate technical and behavioral training programs.
* Develop annual training and development plans.
* Track training effectiveness and employee development.
* Support career development and succession planning initiatives.

I. HR Policies \& Compliance

* Develop, implement, and periodically review HR policies.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour and employment laws.
* Maintain statutory registers and HR compliance documentation as applicable.
* Ensure proper implementation of company policies across departments.
* Handle disciplinary matters in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* Maintain proper documentation of warnings, disciplinary actions, and employee grievances.

J. Employee Relations

* Act as a trusted HR point of contact for employees and management.
* Handle employee grievances professionally and confidentially.
* Mediate workplace conflicts and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Maintain a positive and productive work environment.
* Ensure consistent and fair application of HR policies.

K. Exit \& Full \& Final Settlement

* Manage the complete employee exit process.
* Conduct exit interviews and document employee feedback.
* Coordinate resignation acceptance, notice period, handover, clearance, and asset recovery.
* Coordinate with Finance for **Full \& Final Settlement (F\&F)**.
* Ensure timely issuance of relieving and experience letters.
* Analyze exit trends and recommend retention measures.

3\. HR Metrics \& MIS

The Strategic HR Manager will be responsible for preparing and monitoring key HR dashboards, including:

* Employee Headcount \& Workforce Cost
* Employee Productivity \& Utilization
* Attendance \& Absenteeism
* Employee Attrition \& Retention
* Recruitment Status
* Time\-to\-Hire
* Cost\-per\-Hire
* Offer\-to\-Joining Ratio
* Employee Turnover
* Payroll Cost
* Overtime / Additional Manpower Cost
* Leave Utilization
* Performance Rating Distribution
* Training \& Development Metrics
* Employee Engagement
* Probation \& Confirmation Status

4\. Technology \& HR Systems

* Manage and optimize the organization's **HRMS / HRIS**.
* Ensure employee data is accurately maintained in HR systems.
* Automate attendance, leave, payroll, onboarding, and performance processes wherever possible.
* Generate HR dashboards and reports for management.
* Maintain data accuracy, confidentiality, and access controls.
* Identify technology solutions that can improve HR efficiency and employee experience.

5\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Strategic HR Manager will be evaluated based on:

* **Workforce Productivity Improvement**
* Payroll Accuracy \& Timeliness
* Employee Attendance \& Absenteeism Management
* Recruitment Turnaround Time
* Employee Retention \& Attrition Reduction
* Onboarding Effectiveness
* Employee Engagement
* HR Process Automation
* HR Compliance
* Employee Grievance Resolution
* Performance Management Effectiveness
* Accuracy and Timeliness of HR MIS
* Reduction in HR Operational Costs
* Employee Satisfaction \& Experience

6\. Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* **MBA / PGDM in HR** preferred.
* Strong knowledge of HR operations, payroll, employee lifecycle management, and performance management.
* Working knowledge of applicable labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets and HRMS platforms.

7\. Experience

* **5–8 years of progressive HR experience**, preferably in an IT/software/services organization.
* Minimum **2–3 years in an HR Manager / Strategic HR / HR Operations leadership role** preferred.
* Experience managing HR operations for a growing workforce is highly desirable.
* Experience with HRMS, payroll systems, performance management, and workforce analytics preferred.

8\. Key Competencies

* Strategic Thinking
* Workforce Planning
* People Analytics
* Workforce Productivity Management
* Payroll \& HR Operations
* Performance Management
* Employee Relations
* Leadership \& Team Management
* Problem Solving
* Decision Making
* Communication \& Negotiation
* Conflict Resolution
* Data Analysis
* Process Improvement
* Confidentiality \& Professional Integrity

9\. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be **both strategic and hands\-on**—capable of developing HR strategies at the management level while personally ensuring that payroll, onboarding, attendance, employee records, performance management, and daily HR operations run smoothly.

The candidate should have a strong **business\-oriented HR mindset**, using employee and workforce data to identify problems, improve productivity, control manpower costs, and build a high\-performance culture within the IT organization.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

We are seeking a proactive and performance\-driven HR Executive for our head office in Goregaon. title: Valuation Analyst
description:
Position Title

Valuation Analyst

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Vehicle and Machinery Valuator to assess the value and condition of vehicles, heavy equipment, industrial machinery, and other mechanical assets. The successful candidate will conduct physical inspections, analyze market data, determine fair market values, and prepare accurate valuation reports for clients, financial institutions, insurance companies, or internal business purposes.

Key Responsibilities

* Inspect and evaluate vehicles, heavy machinery, construction equipment, and industrial machines.
* Assess the age, condition, specifications, usage, maintenance history, and remaining useful life of assets.
* Determine market value, fair value, replacement value, and/or liquidation value as required.
* Research current market prices, comparable sales, auction results, and industry trends.
* Verify vehicle and machinery identification, model, serial numbers, registration details, and specifications.
* Identify damage, defects, depreciation, modifications, and other factors affecting asset value.
* Prepare detailed and professional valuation reports with photographs and supporting evidence.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, calculations, market research, and valuation conclusions.
* Communicate valuation findings clearly to clients and other stakeholders.
* Conduct site visits to workshops, yards, construction sites, factories, dealerships, and other locations when required.
* Keep up to date with changes in vehicle, machinery, and equipment markets.
* Ensure valuations are conducted in accordance with applicable company procedures and professional standards.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum 10th Pass
* Relevant experience in vehicle appraisal, machinery valuation, equipment inspection, automotive, engineering, insurance, banking, or asset management.
* Good knowledge of different types of vehicles, construction equipment, agricultural machinery, and industrial machinery.
* Strong understanding of depreciation and factors affecting the value of mechanical assets.
* Ability to conduct market research and analyze comparable assets.
* Good numerical, analytical, and report\-writing skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Willingness to travel for physical inspections.

Preferred Skills

* Experience valuing cars, commercial vehicles, trucks, buses, earthmoving equipment, cranes, generators, industrial machinery, and production equipment.
* Knowledge of auction and resale markets.
* Familiarity with insurance, finance, banking, or asset\-recovery valuation requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and professional judgment.
* Good communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* Valid driving license is an advantage.
* Key Performance Indicators
* Accuracy and consistency of valuation reports.
* Quality and completeness of physical inspections.
* Reliability of market research and valuation calculations.
* Timely completion of assignments.
* Compliance with professional and company valuation standards.
* Client satisfaction and quality of communication.

Working Conditions

The role may involve both office\-based valuation analysis and field inspections. The Valuator may be required to travel to client premises, workshops, dealerships, warehouses, construction sites, auction yards, and industrial facilities.

Employment Type

Full\-time

Fresher \-Experience

Reporting To

Valuation Manager / Head of Valuation

Contact\- 8144303866

Pay: ₹12,500\.00 \- ₹16,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kendrapara District, Odisha

title: Manufacturing / Process Engineer – XR Hardware
description:
Manufacturing / Process Engineer – XR Hardware

Company: US\-Based Technology Company

Work Location: Fun Republic Area, Andheri West, Mumbai

Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-Site

Experience: Freshers Welcome

Education: B.E./B.Tech in Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electronics, Manufacturing Engineering or related discipline

About the Opportunity

A US\-based technology company is hiring engineers in Mumbai to develop and manufacture a next\-generation immersive entertainment headset.

We are looking for a Manufacturing / Process Engineer who will help transform an engineering prototype into a product that can be assembled, tested and manufactured repeatedly at consistent quality.

Fresh graduates with strong manufacturing, robotics, automation, mechanical, electronics or production\-engineering projects are encouraged to apply.

What You Will Work On

You will help take the product through:

→ Manufacturing Process → Assembly Stations → SOPs → Pilot Line → Quality Improvement → Production Scale\-Up

Key Responsibilities

1\. Design the Manufacturing Process

You will define how the headset should actually be assembled.

This includes establishing the correct sequence for:

Component Inspection → Electronics Assembly → Display/Optics Integration → Sensors/Cameras → Battery → Audio → Body Assembly → Firmware → Calibration → Testing → Final QC → Packaging

The objective is to make every production unit follow a documented and repeatable process.

1\. Assembly Line Development

Help design and establish the initial headset assembly line.

Responsibilities include:

Determine the number of assembly stations.

Define the work performed at each station.

Create workstation layouts.

Determine required tools and equipment.

Define operator movement and material flow.

Reduce unnecessary handling.

Establish cycle\-time targets.

Identify production bottlenecks.

Improve line efficiency as volumes increase.

1\. Develop SOPs

Create detailed Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for each manufacturing operation.

For example:

SOP\-01: Incoming component inspection

SOP\-02: Main board installation

SOP\-03: Display installation

SOP\-04: Optical module installation

SOP\-05: Camera/sensor assembly

SOP\-06: Battery installation

SOP\-07: Audio assembly

SOP\-08: Headset body assembly

SOP\-09: Firmware flashing

SOP\-10: Calibration

SOP\-11: Functional testing

SOP\-12: Final inspection and packaging

SOPs should include tools, process steps, photographs/diagrams, tolerances, safety requirements and acceptance criteria.

1\. Jigs, Fixtures \& Tools

Work with hardware and mechanical engineers to develop production tools such as:

Assembly fixtures

Alignment jigs

Optical positioning fixtures

PCB holding fixtures

Torque\-controlled screwdrivers

Adhesive dispensing tools

Calibration fixtures

Test fixtures

Device holding fixtures

Go/No\-Go gauges

You should continuously look for opportunities to replace manual judgment with a controlled process.

1\. ESD\-Safe Manufacturing

XR headsets contain sensitive electronic components.

You will help establish:

ESD\-safe workbenches

Grounding systems

ESD wrist straps

Anti\-static mats

Component handling procedures

ESD\-safe storage

Operator training

ESD compliance checks

1\. Optical Assembly Environment

Work with the Optics \& Display Engineer to establish appropriate processes for handling displays and lenses.

This includes:

Dust\-control procedures

Optical cleaning stations

Gloves and handling procedures

Lens/display inspection

Controlled storage

Cleaning materials

Optical assembly SOPs

The objective is to prevent dust, fingerprints and contamination from becoming trapped inside the headset.

1\. Production Quality \& Yield

Track manufacturing performance using measurable data.

You will monitor:

First\-pass yield

Rework rate

Reject rate

Assembly time

Defects per unit

Station\-level failures

Component failures

Operator\-related defects

You will work with QA and hardware engineering to continuously improve that number.

1\. Root\-Cause Analysis

When manufacturing problems occur, you will help determine why.

Examples:

Display not functioning after assembly

Flex cable damaged during installation

Lens misalignment

Loose connectors

Incorrect screw torque

Housing not closing correctly

Battery connection failure

Dust inside optical assembly

Camera alignment problems

Use structured methods such as:

5 Why **Fishbone Analysis**  Pareto Analysis **CAPA**

and convert findings into process improvements.

1\. Design for Manufacturing

Work with the Mechanical, Electronics and Hardware Product engineers before designs are finalized.

Ask questions such as:

Can operators assemble this easily?

Can the connector be reached?

Can the cable be installed without damage?

Are there too many screws?

Can parts be installed incorrectly?

Can assembly be simplified?

Can a jig eliminate alignment errors?

Can the device be repaired without destroying it?

This is Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA).

1\. Production Traceability

Help establish a digital record for every headset.

Each device should have a unique serial number linked to information such as:

Device Serial Number → PCB Batch → Display Batch → Optics Batch → Battery Batch → Assembly Date → Firmware Version → Calibration Result → QA Result

This becomes extremely important when devices reach customers.

This includes line balancing, automation, additional stations, operator planning and production\-capacity analysis.

Skills We Are Looking For

Strong fundamentals in any combination of:

Manufacturing processes

Production engineering

Industrial engineering

Electronics assembly

Mechanical assembly

Process engineering

Quality control

Engineering drawings

Basic CAD

Lean Manufacturing

5S

Root\-cause analysis

Production planning

Basic knowledge of electronics is particularly useful because this is an electronics manufacturing environment.

Bonus Skills

Exposure to any of these is valuable:

Manufacturing **Six Sigma**  5S **Kaizen**  FMEA **DFM/DFA**  SPC **AutoCAD**  SolidWorks **Python**  Excel/Data Analysis **Electronics Assembly**  ESD

These are desirable—not mandatory for freshers.

Freshers Are Welcome

We are particularly interested in graduates who have participated in:

Formula Student / BAJA

Robotics competitions

Manufacturing projects

Automation projects

Production\-line projects

3D printing

Electronics assembly

Industrial internships

College workshops

Product\-development projects

We value engineers who enjoy being on the production floor and solving real physical problems, rather than only preparing reports.

A US\-based technology company is hiring engineers in Mumbai to develop a next\-generation immersive 180° entertainment headset.

We are looking for an Optics \& Display Engineer who will help create the visual experience inside the headset.

This role sits at the intersection of optics, displays, electronics, human vision and XR technology. You will work with high\-resolution displays, pancake lenses and optical modules to achieve a sharp, comfortable and cinema\-quality immersive viewing experience.

Fresh graduates with strong optics, photonics, imaging, display or physics projects are encouraged to apply.

What You Will Work On

You will help develop the visual system from:

Display Selection → Lens Selection → Optical Integration → Alignment → Calibration → Visual Testing → Production Validation

Key Responsibilities

Display Technology

Research and evaluate high\-resolution display technologies for XR headsets.

Work with Micro\-OLED, OLED and fast LCD technologies.

Compare display modules based on:Resolution

Pixel density

Brightness

Contrast

Refresh rate

Color performance

Latency

Power consumption

Thermal performance

Work with display suppliers and evaluate engineering samples.

Support display integration with the electronics team.

XR Optics

Evaluate and integrate optical systems including:

Pancake lenses **Aspheric lenses**  Fresnel systems **Other emerging XR optics**

You will help determine the right optical architecture for long\-duration immersive entertainment.

You will work on:

Field of View (FOV)

Pixels Per Degree (PPD)

Eye relief

Exit pupil

IPD

Focus

Lens\-to\-display distance

Optical distortion

Chromatic aberration

Edge\-to\-edge clarity

Glare and reflections

Visual comfort

180° Immersive Cinema Optimization

SilverScreenX is being developed specifically around immersive entertainment.

You will work closely with the XR software engineer to optimize the headset for:

Stereoscopic 180° movies

Immersive video

Sports

Concerts

Live entertainment

Long\-duration viewing

The goal is not simply to achieve impressive specifications on paper. The objective is to make content look sharp, natural and comfortable for extended viewing periods.

Optical Alignment

Small errors in display/lens positioning can significantly affect XR image quality.

You will help define:

Lens alignment

Display alignment

Optical\-axis alignment

Lens/display spacing

IPD geometry

Mechanical tolerances

Calibration procedures

You will work closely with the Mechanical Engineer to ensure the physical headset maintains these tolerances during manufacturing.

Optical Calibration

You will help develop a repeatable calibration process for every headset.

For example:

Headset → Display Test Pattern → Camera/Measurement → Distortion Analysis → Calibration → Verification → PASS/FAIL

As production grows, this process should become increasingly automated.

Visual Quality Testing

You will investigate issues such as:

Blur

Distortion

Color mismatch

Uneven brightness

Dead/stuck pixels

Glare

Ghosting

Chromatic aberration

Poor edge clarity

Incorrect focus

Eye strain

Stereo mismatch

You will help establish measurable acceptance criteria for production devices.

Optical Cleanliness

Because lenses and displays are extremely sensitive to contamination, you will help define:

Optical cleaning procedures

Dust\-control requirements

Display handling procedures

Lens handling procedures

Assembly cleanliness standards

Inspection processes

For production, you will work with the Manufacturing Engineer to create a controlled optical assembly/calibration area.

Supplier \& Vendor Evaluation

You will interact with display and optics suppliers to:

Request samples

Compare optical modules

Review specifications

Test reference designs

Evaluate quality consistency

Define acceptable tolerances

Compare cost and MOQ

Identify alternative suppliers

Resolve quality problems

You will help the company decide whether to use a ready\-made optical module, semi\-custom module or eventually a more customized optical system.

Prototype Development

During early development, you will work hands\-on with:

Display modules

Lens assemblies

XR reference headsets

Optical prototypes

Mechanical test fixtures

Calibration equipment

You will participate directly in prototype builds rather than working only on theoretical simulations.

Tools \& Technical Knowledge

Exposure to any of the following is valuable:

Geometric optics

Physical optics

Imaging systems

Display technology

Photometry

Color science

Optical measurement

Image processing

MATLAB

Python

Zemax / OpticStudio

Code V or similar optical\-design software

Python/MATLAB skills are particularly useful for analyzing calibration and measurement data.

Freshers Are Welcome

Professional XR experience is not mandatory.

We are particularly interested in candidates with academic or personal projects involving:

Optics **Photonics**  Lasers **Imaging**  Cameras **Displays**  Computer Vision **AR/VR**  Optical Instruments **Image Processing**  Color Science

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their project work and explain the underlying physics and engineering.

What We Look For

We want someone who:

Has strong fundamentals in optics/physics.

Is obsessed with visual quality and details.

Enjoys experimental work.

Can measure rather than simply judge by eye.

Is comfortable working with hardware prototypes.

Can analyze data and troubleshoot problems.

Wants to learn XR display technology.

Can work closely with mechanical, electronics and software engineers.

description:
Mechanical \& Thermal Design Engineer – XR Headset

Company: US\-Based Technology Company

Work Location: Fun Republic Area, Andheri West, Mumbai

Employment Type: Full\-Time \| On\-Site

Experience: Freshers Welcome

Education: B.E./B.Tech – Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Product Design, Manufacturing Engineering or related discipline

About the Opportunity

A US\-based technology company is hiring engineers in Mumbai to develop a next\-generation immersive entertainment headset.

We are looking for a Mechanical \& Thermal Design Engineer who is passionate about designing physical products and wants to work on the actual body, internal structure, ergonomics and cooling architecture of an advanced XR headset.

You will work closely with electronics, optics, embedded software, industrial design and manufacturing teams to transform electronic and optical components into a comfortable, lightweight and manufacturable consumer device.

Fresh graduates with strong CAD, mechanical design, 3D\-printing or product\-development projects are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Headset Mechanical Design

Design the physical architecture of the XR headset.

Create internal layouts for processor boards, displays, optics, cameras, sensors, battery and speakers.

Design mounting structures and component brackets.

Develop front housing, rear housing and internal structural components.

Define screw locations, clips, connectors and assembly mechanisms.

Design parts considering manufacturing tolerances.

Work closely with electronics and optics engineers to ensure correct component placement.

Headset Body \& Industrialization

Responsibilities include:

Develop 3D CAD models.

Create detailed engineering drawings.

Design plastic components.

Select appropriate engineering plastics and materials.

Work with prototype and injection\-molding vendors.

Review vendor tooling proposals.

Evaluate ready\-made headset bodies where appropriate.

Modify existing vendor chassis for product requirements.

Support development of custom parts when required.

For early production, we may use a ready\-made or semi\-custom XR chassis, so you will also evaluate whether existing vendor designs can be modified instead of unnecessarily designing every component from zero.

Ergonomics \& Comfort

An entertainment headset may be worn continuously for an entire movie, making comfort extremely important.

You will work on:

Overall headset weight

Front/rear weight balance

Centre of gravity

Facial pressure distribution

Head strap geometry

Face cushion/interface

Nose clearance

Ventilation

Different head sizes

Prescription\-glasses compatibility

Long\-duration wearing comfort

You will conduct physical fit tests and convert user feedback into mechanical improvements.

Thermal Engineering

High\-performance XR processors and displays generate significant heat inside a compact enclosure.

You will help design the thermal\-management system.

Responsibilities include:

Identify major heat\-generating components.

Design thermal paths from processor/display electronics to the enclosure.

Evaluate heat sinks, graphite sheets, thermal pads, heat spreaders and heat pipes.

Evaluate passive versus active cooling.

Design airflow and ventilation paths.

Measure surface temperatures.

Conduct sustained\-load thermal tests.

Prevent excessive heat reaching the user's face.

Work with embedded/software engineers on thermal throttling requirements.

The objective is to maintain performance while keeping the headset safe, quiet and comfortable.

Prototype Development

You will create and evaluate physical prototypes using technologies such as:

3D Printing → CNC → Vacuum Casting → Prototype Tooling → Injection Molding

You will:

Prepare CAD files for prototypes.

Work directly with prototype vendors.

Assemble prototype bodies.

Measure component fit and tolerances.

Identify interference and assembly problems.

Modify designs based on test results.

Maintain design revisions.

Design for Manufacturing

You will work with the Manufacturing/Process Engineer to ensure the headset can eventually be assembled efficiently.

This includes:

Design for Manufacturing (DFM)

Design for Assembly (DFA)

Injection\-molding considerations

Draft angles

Wall thickness

Ribs and bosses

Snap fits

Screw bosses

Tolerance stack\-up

Tool accessibility

Assembly sequence

Serviceability

The goal is not simply to create a beautiful CAD model—it must be possible to manufacture thousands of identical units reliably.

Mechanical Validation

You will help develop tests for:

Drop resistance

Strap durability

Button durability

USB\-C connector durability

Housing strength

Repeated assembly/disassembly

Heat deformation

Lens/display mounting stability

Transportation vibration

Long\-duration wearing comfort

Failures will be analyzed and translated into design improvements.

Tools \& Skills

Candidates should have exposure to one or more of:

SolidWorks **Creo**  CATIA **Fusion 360**  AutoCAD **Siemens NX**

Knowledge of the following is desirable:

3D CAD

Engineering drawings

GD\&T fundamentals

Materials

Plastics

Injection molding

Manufacturing tolerances

Heat transfer

Thermal management

Mechanical prototyping

3D printing

Freshers Are Welcome

Professional XR experience is not required.

We are particularly interested in fresh graduates who have built things.

Good projects could include:

Robotics **Drones**  Wearables **Consumer Products**  3D\-Printed Devices **Automotive Components**  Product Enclosures **Mechanical Prototypes**  Smart Devices **AR/VR Projects**

Candidates should be comfortable showing their CAD models, prototypes, college projects or portfolio during the interview.

What We Look For

We are looking for engineers who:

Enjoy building physical products.

Are comfortable repeatedly prototyping and improving designs.

Understand that appearance and engineering must work together.

Think about the user as much as the CAD model.

Can work closely with electronics and software engineers.

Are willing to work hands\-on with prototypes.

Can communicate directly with manufacturing vendors.

Want to see something they designed become a real commercial product.

Freshers strongly encouraged

We value hands\-on projects, engineering fundamentals, curiosity and problem\-solving ability more than years of experience. If you have designed and built real mechanical products during college or independently, we encourage you to apply.

**Department:** Manufacturing / Production  
**Industry:** Cosmetics / Personal Care / FMCG Manufacturing  
**Location:** Patalganga MIDC, Rasayani  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a responsible and technically skilled **Manufacturing Chemist** to manage and monitor day\-to\-day manufacturing activities, ensuring that products are manufactured according to approved formulations, SOPs, quality standards, and production plans. The candidate will coordinate with **Production, QA, QC, R\&D, Stores, and Maintenance** to ensure smooth and efficient manufacturing operations.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities

* **Manufacturing \& Batch Processing**
* Execute manufacturing activities as per approved **BMR, formulation, SOPs, and production schedule**.
* Ensure correct quantities of Raw Materials are dispensed and added as per the approved formula.
* Monitor manufacturing processes and ensure proper sequence of material addition, mixing, heating, cooling, and homogenization.
* **Process \& Parameter Monitoring**
* Monitor critical process parameters such as **temperature, mixing time, RPM, pH, viscosity, and batch quantity** as applicable.
* Ensure process parameters are maintained within approved limits.
* Immediately report any abnormality or process deviation to the Production/QA Manager.
* **Raw Material \& Batch Verification**
* Verify Raw Material names, codes, batch numbers, quantities, and status before starting manufacturing.
* Ensure only **approved/passed materials** are used for production.
* Coordinate with Stores and QC for material availability and status.
* **BMR \& Manufacturing Documentation**
* Complete and maintain **Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR)** accurately and on time.
* Record material usage, process parameters, equipment details, yields, and observations.
* Ensure all manufacturing documentation is completed as per GMP and SOP requirements.
* **Quality \& GMP Compliance**
* Follow **GMP, hygiene, safety, and company SOPs** during all manufacturing activities.
* Coordinate with QC/QA for in\-process testing and batch release requirements.
* Ensure manufacturing areas and equipment are maintained in proper hygienic condition.
* **Yield \& Process Control**
* Monitor batch yield and material consumption.
* Investigate abnormal yield variation, material loss, or process deviations.
* Support **RCA and CAPA** for recurring manufacturing issues.
* **Equipment \& Production Coordination**
* Ensure manufacturing equipment such as **manufacturing vessels, agitators, homogenizers, pumps, and transfer lines** are ready before batch processing.
* Coordinate with Maintenance for equipment breakdowns and preventive maintenance requirements.
* Ensure proper cleaning and line clearance before and after manufacturing activities.
* **Team Coordination \& Training**
* Guide and supervise operators/helpers involved in manufacturing activities.
* Provide training regarding manufacturing procedures, SOPs, GMP, safety, and material handling.
* Coordinate with QA, QC, R\&D, Stores, Maintenance, and PPIC for smooth batch execution.
* **Production Reporting \& Improvement**
* Prepare daily manufacturing reports and update production status to the reporting manager.
* Identify opportunities to improve **productivity, batch yield, process efficiency, and material utilization**.
* Support Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

* **B.Sc. / M.Sc. Chemistry** or relevant qualification.
* **1–3 years of experience** in Manufacturing/Production, preferably in **Cosmetics, Personal Care, FMCG, Pharmaceutical, or Chemical manufacturing**.
* Knowledge of **GMP, BMR, SOPs, batch manufacturing, and process parameters**.
* Good understanding of cosmetic manufacturing processes such as creams, lotions, shampoos, gels, liquid products, etc.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel and documentation**.
* Good communication, problem\-solving, and team coordination skills.
* Willingness to work on the manufacturing shop floor and in shifts, if required.

**Position:** Café Manager  
**Department:** Operations  
**Location:** Starbrews Coffee Shop, TCI Chowk, Rourkela  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Reports To:** Owners / Management

About Starbrews

Starbrews is a modern café built around **good coffee, good food and a welcoming café experience**. We are looking for a responsible and energetic **Café Manager** who can take ownership of the day\-to\-day outlet operations and ensure smooth service.

Job Summary

The Café Manager will be responsible for the **overall operation of the outlet**, including customer service, staff management, inventory, billing, cleanliness, order management and daily reporting.

The Manager should be capable of running the café efficiently even when the owners are not present.

Key Responsibilities1\. Outlet Operations

* Take complete responsibility for the **day\-to\-day functioning of Starbrews**.
* Ensure the café opens and closes on time.
* Conduct opening and closing checks every day.
* Ensure all departments are ready before service begins.
* Monitor the café throughout the shift and resolve operational issues immediately.
* Ensure all Starbrews SOPs and operational standards are followed.

2\. Customer Experience

* Personally ensure that every customer receives **quick, polite and professional service**.
* Ensure staff attends customers promptly after they are seated.
* Monitor table service, order accuracy and serving time.
* Handle customer complaints professionally and resolve issues whenever possible.
* Take regular customer feedback and communicate important feedback to management.
* Encourage staff to suggest suitable **add\-ons and upsells** such as desserts, fries, beverages and combos.

3\. Staff Management

* Manage the daily attendance and shifts of all café employees.
* Allocate duties before every shift.
* Ensure staff are properly groomed and dressed before starting work.
* Conduct daily briefings before service.
* Monitor staff performance, discipline and behaviour.
* Ensure proper communication between the kitchen, bar and service team.
* Train new employees on Starbrews' service standards and SOPs.
* Report repeated performance or discipline issues to management.

4\. Order \& Service Management

* Monitor **dine\-in, takeaway and online orders**.
* Ensure orders are accepted only after confirming product availability.
* Coordinate between the kitchen and barista team.
* Monitor order preparation time.
* Ensure the correct items are packed and served.
* Prevent delays, missing items and incorrect orders.

5\. Inventory \& Stock Control

* Maintain daily stock levels of food, beverages, packaging and other consumables.
* Check incoming stock and verify quantities.
* Follow **FIFO (First In, First Out)**.
* Monitor wastage, spoilage and unnecessary consumption.
* Prepare purchase requirements and inform management on time.
* Ensure stock records are updated accurately.
* Conduct regular physical stock checks.

6\. Billing \& Cash Management

* Monitor all billing and payment transactions.
* Ensure every sale is properly billed through the POS system.
* Verify cash, UPI and other payment collections.
* Maintain the daily sales report.
* Report any billing discrepancy immediately.
* Ensure discounts and offers are applied only as authorized by management.

7\. Hygiene \& Café Standards

* Ensure the café, tables, service area and washroom are clean throughout the day.
* Monitor kitchen and bar hygiene.
* Ensure garbage is cleared regularly.
* Conduct regular checks for **flies, mosquitoes, spills, food contamination and cleanliness issues**.
* Ensure all staff follow proper hygiene and grooming standards.

8\. Daily Reporting

description:
Job Summary

A Robotics Trainer is responsible for teaching robotics, electronics, coding, AI, IoT, and STEM concepts to school students through hands\-on learning. The trainer will conduct practical sessions, guide students in projects and competitions, maintain laboratory equipment, and foster innovation and problem\-solving skills among students.

Key Roles \& ResponsibilitiesTraining \& Teaching

* Conduct Robotics, Electronics, Coding, AI, IoT, and STEM classes for students.
* Deliver engaging practical sessions using robotics kits, microcontrollers, and sensors.
* Explain technical concepts in a student\-friendly manner.
* Develop lesson plans and training materials aligned with school requirements.

Project Development

* Guide students in building robotics and STEM projects.
* Mentor students for science exhibitions, competitions, and innovation challenges.
* Support students in project design, prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Encourage creativity, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.

STEM Lab Management

* Maintain robotics kits, tools, components, and laboratory equipment.
* Ensure proper inventory management of STEM lab materials.
* Report damaged or missing equipment and coordinate replacements.
* Maintain safety standards within the laboratory.

* Troubleshoot hardware and software issues during training sessions.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Prepare progress reports for students and schools.
* Document student projects and achievements.
* Capture photos and videos of activities for reporting and promotional purposes.

Competition \& Event Coordination

* Train students for robotics competitions and hackathons.
* Organize STEM workshops, innovation camps, and demonstrations.
* Support school\-level and inter\-school robotics events.

Continuous Learning

* Stay updated with emerging technologies in Robotics, AI, IoT, and STEM education.
* Participate in internal training and skill development programs.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE), Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Physics (B.Sc.), Mathematics (B.Sc.), Electronics (B.Sc.), or any other relevant STEM discipline.
* Freshers with strong technical skills are encouraged to apply.
* Prior teaching or training experience is an added advantage.

Required Technical Skills

* Arduino Programming
* Electronics and Circuit Design
* Robotics Systems
* Embedded Systems
* Python Programming (Basic to Intermediate)
* IoT Concepts
* Sensor and Actuator Integration
* Basic AI and Machine Learning Concepts
* Troubleshooting and Debugging

Soft Skills

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to handle school students of different age groups.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities.
* Passion for teaching and technology.
* Good teamwork and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in STEM education.
* Participation in robotics competitions or technical projects.
* Knowledge of 3D Printing, CAD Design, Drones, or AI applications.
* Certification in Robotics, Embedded Systems, or STEM Training.

title: Campus Growth & Partnerships Intern
description:
Campus Growth \& Partnerships InternHackingly Innovators

**Location:** Jaipur \+ Travel  
**Duration:** 6 Months  
**Stipend:** ₹10,000–₹15,000 per month \+ performance incentives  
**Opportunity:** Pre\-placement / Full\-time opportunity after the internship

This is not a typical internship.

At **Hackingly**, we are building a large ecosystem connecting students, developers, professionals, founders, companies, colleges, universities and institutions.

As a **Campus Growth \& Partnerships Intern**, you will not simply be sending emails or making calls.

You will be **building relationships, pitching ideas, developing partnerships, identifying revenue opportunities and helping execute the programs you bring to Hackingly.**

One day, you could be speaking with a college Director. The next, you could be pitching a program to a university, coordinating an event, meeting a community leader or figuring out how an existing institutional relationship can become a larger business opportunity.

If you are someone who enjoys meeting people, dislikes repetitive work and wants to learn business by actually doing it, this internship is for you.

What will you do?

Your journey will broadly be:

**Research → Connect → Pitch → Negotiate → Close → Execute → Grow**

You will:

* Identify colleges, universities, institutes, schools and communities that could work with Hackingly.
* Reach out to decision\-makers and initiate meaningful conversations.
* Understand institutional requirements and identify potential Hackingly solutions.
* Pitch Hackingly's programs, partnerships and offerings.
* Follow up, negotiate and work towards closing paid partnerships.
* Identify opportunities for recurring or larger institutional engagements.
* Coordinate with the internal team to execute the partnerships you help close.
* Support student registrations, institutional outreach and event/program deliverables.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with institutional decision\-makers.
* Track conversations, opportunities and revenue pipelines.
* Explore new ways to convert institutional relationships into sustainable business opportunities.

Revenue mindset is important.

We are not looking for someone who thinks a partnership simply means signing an MoU.

We want someone who can look at an institution and think:

“What problem are they trying to solve, and how can Hackingly solve it as a meaningful business opportunity?”

A workshop could become a hackathon.

A hackathon could become a student chapter.

A student chapter could become an annual institutional partnership.

A single conversation could become a long\-term client.

You should constantly be looking for the next opportunity.

Who are we looking for?

You do not need a particular degree or years of experience.

We care much more about **personality, communication, curiosity, ownership and hunger to learn.**

You should be:

* Extremely comfortable talking to new people.
* Confident communicating with senior decision\-makers.
* Highly energetic and outgoing.
* Curious and commercially minded.
* Comfortable with rejection and persistent follow\-ups.
* Comfortable travelling and meeting people.
* Good at negotiation and persuasion.
* Comfortable working independently.
* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Interested in sales, business development, partnerships and entrepreneurship.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment where every day can look different.

Most importantly:

**You should want to build something, not just complete an internship.**

Why join Hackingly?

This will not be a conventional internship where your work is limited to lead generation.

You will learn how a real business works:

**Lead Generation**  
↓  
**Sales \& Pitching**  
↓  
**Negotiation**  
↓  
**Revenue Closure**  
↓  
**Event Execution**  
↓  
**Relationship Management**  
↓  
**Account Growth**

You will get the opportunity to interact with **Deans, Directors, Placement Heads, Founders, HR leaders, community leaders and other decision\-makers.**

You will also gain exposure to **technology, entrepreneurship, startups, campus ecosystems, events and corporate partnerships.**

What happens after six months?

We want this internship to have a clear growth path.

If you are currently in your final semester:

You can be considered for a **full\-time opportunity after completing six months**, subject to your performance and graduation requirements.

If you are already graduating / have recently graduated:

After six months, based on your performance, your **stipend can be revised**, followed by transition into a **full\-time role once you graduate**.

The objective is simple:

**Intern → Prove yourself → Grow with us → Full\-time opportunity**

Exceptional performance can accelerate this journey.

How will we measure you?

Not simply by how many calls you make.

We will look at:

* Quality of conversations
* Qualified opportunities generated
* Meetings converted
* Partnerships closed
* Revenue generated
* Institutional relationships built
* Repeat and expanded opportunities
* Execution quality
* Ownership and initiative

**Activity is good. Impact is better.**

This role is for you if...

You would rather meet interesting people than sit behind a spreadsheet all day.

You would rather pitch an idea than prepare another presentation.

You would rather work towards closing a real partnership than simply complete a target number of calls.

You would rather travel to a new city and meet a new institution than repeat the same day every day.

And if your mindset is:

“Give me a target, give me the opportunity, and I will figure out how to make it happen.”

Then we want to meet you.

Campus Growth \& Partnerships Intern

**Hackingly Innovators**

**Build relationships. Create opportunities. Drive growth.**

Pay: ₹8,301\.50 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time

title: Human Resource (HR) Fresher
description:
We are hiring an Human Resources Fresher who can support HR operations through data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and modern AI tools.
   

  

 This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who are interested in Human Resources, data analytics, Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI\-enabled work. The ideal candidate should not only understand HR processes but should also be comfortable working with data, creating reports, identifying patterns, and using AI tools to complete work faster and more accurately.
   

  

 The person will work closely with the HR team to analyze recruitment, employee, attendance, performance, and workforce data, build dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to improve speed, accuracy, and decision\-making.
   

  

**Core Job Responsibilities**
* HR Data Analysis \& Reporting Collect, clean, organize, and analyze HR data related to recruitment, employee records, attendance, onboarding, performance, attrition, and workforce planning.
* Power BI Dashboards \& MIS Reporting Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and MIS trackers using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar reporting platforms.
* Recruitment Analytics Track hiring funnel metrics such as applications received, shortlisted candidates, interview status, offer rollout, joining status, turnaround time, source effectiveness, and drop\-off points.
* Workforce Analytics Analyze employee data to identify trends related to headcount, attrition, attendance, performance, engagement, skills, and manpower requirements.
* AI\-Assisted Workflows Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar platforms to speed up data cleaning, report writing, formula creation, dashboard planning, insight generation, documentation, and process improvement.
* Data Interpretation \& Business Insights Convert raw HR data into clear insights and summaries that help the HR team and business leaders make better decisions.
* HR Operations Support Support day\-to\-day HR operations such as onboarding tracking, employee documentation, HRMS data updates, employee query tracking, and process documentation.
* Automation \& Process Improvement Identify repetitive HR reporting or operational tasks and suggest ways to automate or simplify them using Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, AI tools, or other workflow tools.
* Data Accuracy \& Quality Checks Validate reports and AI\-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability before sharing them with internal stakeholders.
* Data Privacy \& Responsible AI Use Handle employee and candidate data responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and ensuring AI tools are used carefully and ethically.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong interest in HR analytics, people data, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, filters, lookup functions, and data cleaning.
* Familiarity with Power BI or willingness to build dashboards using Power BI.
* Ability to interpret data and explain insights in simple business language.
* Hands\-on usage of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar tools for work\-related tasks.
* Ability to write clear prompts, verify AI\-generated outputs, and improve responses through iteration.
* Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data.
* Curiosity to learn new HR tech, analytics tools, and automation methods.


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, DAX, or dashboard creation.
* Basic understanding of SQL, Python, or data visualization concepts.
* Experience with HRMS, ATS, payroll systems, or employee management tools.
* Prior internship, academic project, or personal project involving data analysis, dashboards, or HR analytics.
* Experience using AI tools to create reports, clean data, generate formulas, summarize trends, or automate repetitive work.
* Understanding of recruitment, onboarding, attendance, performance management, or employee lifecycle processes.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* B.E. / B.Tech degree is Mandatory
* MBA degree is Mandatory
* Freshers are eligible to apply.
* Candidates with internships, projects, certifications, or practical exposure in HR analytics, Power BI, Excel, or AI tools will be preferred.
