title: Human Resources Administrator
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **HR Executive / HR Manager** to manage recruitment, candidate screening and first\-round interviews, onboarding, employee documentation, attendance, payroll coordination, employee relations, performance management, HR administration, and applicable HR compliance.

The HR professional will work closely with management, employees, recruiters, and the payroll team to ensure smooth day\-to\-day HR operations.

Candidate Screening \& First\-Round Interviews

* Review and screen resumes before forwarding candidates to management.
* Match candidate skills, qualifications, experience, and background against job requirements.
* Conduct the **first\-round HR interview** for shortlisted candidates.
* Evaluate communication skills, professionalism, experience, attitude, and overall suitability.
* Verify current salary, expected salary, notice period, availability, and preferred work location.
* Ask position\-specific screening questions before scheduling candidates with management or technical teams.
* Review employment history and identify unexplained employment gaps, frequent job changes, or inconsistencies requiring clarification.
* Maintain interview notes and prepare clear candidate summaries for management.
* Forward only qualified and properly screened candidates for technical or management interviews.
* Schedule and coordinate second\-round, technical, and final interviews.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process.
* Maintain records of shortlisted, interviewed, selected, rejected, and pending candidates.

Recruitment \& Hiring

* Manage the complete recruitment process from job posting through employee joining.
* Prepare and publish job descriptions on appropriate hiring platforms.
* Source candidates through job portals, recruitment agencies, referrals, and other recruiting channels.
* Maintain an active candidate pipeline for open positions.
* Coordinate technical and management interviews.
* Conduct reference and background verification when required.
* Discuss compensation and salary expectations within management\-approved ranges.
* Prepare and issue offer letters and appointment letters.
* Coordinate joining dates and pre\-employment requirements.
* Maintain complete recruitment and hiring records.

Employee Onboarding \& Documentation

* Collect and verify required employee documents.
* Prepare employment agreements, NDAs, company policies, and required HR forms.
* Complete employee joining formalities.
* Conduct new\-employee HR orientation.
* Explain working hours, attendance requirements, leave policies, holidays, workplace rules, and company expectations.
* Create and maintain employee personnel files.
* Coordinate allocation and documentation of company laptops, equipment, and other company assets.
* Ensure required employment documents are properly completed and signed.

Attendance \& Leave Management

* Maintain employee attendance, working\-hour, and leave records.
* Monitor employee absences, late arrivals, and unauthorized leave.
* Maintain employee leave balances.
* Process and document leave requests.
* Follow up with employees regarding attendance issues.
* Provide accurate monthly attendance information for payroll processing.
* Maintain holiday and weekly\-off records.

Payroll Coordination

* **Coordinate directly with the payroll team for monthly employee payroll processing.**
* Prepare and provide accurate attendance, leave, salary, bonus, deduction, and other required payroll information.
* Review payroll information for discrepancies before processing.
* **Make sure employee salaries are processed accurately and paid on time.**
* **Verify after each payroll cycle that salary payments have been successfully processed.**
* Follow up with the payroll team regarding any delayed, missing, rejected, or incorrect salary payments.
* Coordinate correction of payroll discrepancies.
* Maintain records of salary revisions, bonuses, deductions, reimbursements, and other compensation changes.
* Respond to employee payroll questions and coordinate with the payroll team to resolve issues.
* Maintain appropriate payroll documentation and confidentiality.
* Coordinate **Full \& Final Settlement (F\&F)** with the payroll team for departing employees.
* Confirm completion of final payments and applicable settlement documentation.

Employee Relations

* Serve as the primary HR contact for employees.
* Handle employee questions, concerns, and workplace grievances professionally.
* Maintain professional communication between employees and management.
* Help management resolve employee conflicts and workplace issues.
* Communicate company policies and management decisions to employees.
* Address workplace conduct and disciplinary concerns.
* Maintain confidentiality regarding employee and company matters.

Performance Management

* Track employee probation periods.
* Coordinate probation\-period performance reviews with managers.
* Coordinate regular employee performance evaluations.
* Maintain performance\-review documentation.
* Assist management in documenting performance concerns.
* Coordinate Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) when required.
* Track employee progress against performance expectations.
* Maintain records of employee warnings and disciplinary actions.
* Coordinate salary revisions and promotions approved by management.

Employee Termination \& Separation

* Manage employee resignation and termination documentation.
* Coordinate notice periods and last working dates.
* Prepare warning, resignation acceptance, termination, relieving, and experience documentation as applicable.
* Ensure company laptops, equipment, documents, ID cards, and other company property are returned.
* Coordinate removal of company system and account access with the appropriate department.
* Coordinate Full \& Final Settlement with the payroll/accounts team.
* Verify completion of final salary and settlement processing.
* Conduct exit interviews when required.
* Maintain complete employee separation records.

HR Compliance – India

* Maintain HR policies, procedures, and employee records according to applicable Indian employment requirements.
* Coordinate applicable statutory requirements relating to **EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS, gratuity, statutory bonus, maternity benefits, leave, and other employment obligations**, where applicable.
* Maintain required employee and statutory documentation.
* Coordinate with payroll providers, accountants, consultants, or legal professionals when necessary.
* Monitor applicable HR and labour requirements and recommend policy updates when necessary.

title: Admin Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and highly organised Admin Manager to oversee the administrative functions of i’Deli Cafe and ensure smooth coordination between management, outlets, employees, vendors, and external agencies.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, disciplined, detail\-oriented, and capable of handling multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced restaurant environment. The person will be responsible for maintaining administrative systems, employee records, vendor coordination, statutory documentation, office requirements, and supporting the management team in the effective running of the business.

Key Responsibilities

1\. General Administration

* Manage day\-to\-day administrative activities of the company and outlets.
* Maintain proper filing systems for physical and digital documents.
* Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of licenses, registrations, agreements, insurance and other business documents.
* Coordinate with government departments, local authorities and external agencies when required.
* Maintain records of company assets, equipment, office supplies and administrative materials.
* Coordinate internal communication between management, outlets and departments.

2\. Employee Administration

* Maintain accurate employee records, joining documents, ID proofs and other HR\-related documentation.
* Coordinate employee joining, transfers, exits and documentation.
* Maintain attendance, leave and other administrative records in coordination with HR/accounts.
* Assist management with staff accommodation, uniforms, ID cards and other employee requirements.
* Coordinate staff welfare and administrative requirements across outlets.
* Ensure company policies and administrative procedures are properly communicated and followed.

3\. Outlet Administration

* Coordinate administrative requirements of all i’Deli Cafe outlets.
* Ensure each outlet has the required stationery, forms, registers, uniforms, cleaning materials and other administrative supplies.
* Monitor outlet\-level documentation and reporting.
* Coordinate maintenance, housekeeping, pest control, security and other support services.
* Follow up with outlet managers regarding pending administrative matters.
* Conduct periodic administrative checks and prepare reports for management.

4\. Vendor \& Service Provider Coordination

* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for administrative and operational requirements.
* Maintain vendor records, quotations, agreements and service schedules.
* Follow up on pending deliveries, repairs, maintenance and services.
* Assist management in evaluating vendors based on cost, quality and reliability.
* Coordinate AMC/service contracts for equipment and facilities where applicable.

5\. Procurement \& Inventory Support

* Monitor administrative and non\-food consumables across outlets.
* Raise purchase requirements and coordinate procurement with the concerned department.
* Maintain records of stationery, uniforms, cleaning supplies, packaging\-related administrative materials and other non\-food items.
* Ensure proper stock levels and avoid unnecessary purchases or wastage.

6\. Compliance \& Documentation

* Maintain a calendar of important statutory renewals, licenses, registrations and contracts.
* Ensure required documents are available and updated at each outlet.
* Coordinate with accountants, consultants, auditors and legal professionals when required.
* Maintain confidential company and employee documents securely.
* Assist management during inspections, audits and compliance\-related requirements.

7\. Management Support

* Prepare administrative reports and updates for management.
* Track pending tasks and ensure timely follow\-up.
* Assist with opening new outlets by coordinating documentation, vendors, utilities, licenses, uniforms, signage and other administrative requirements.
* Support management in implementing new systems, SOPs and administrative processes.
* Handle confidential information with discretion.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, HR, Commerce or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in administration, preferably in restaurants, hotels, retail, QSR or F\&B.
* Strong organisational and coordination skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word, Google Workspace and administrative software.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and external vendors.
* Strong follow\-up and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Draft and issue warning letters, show\-cause notices, termination letters.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
HR Strategy \& Business Partnership
   

  

* Partner with the General Manager and Heads of Department on all people\-related matters.
* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives.
* Provide HR advice and support to management on employee\-related matters.
* Develop programmes and initiatives that foster a positive, inclusive and high\-performing work environment.
* Support the hotel leadership team in building a strong people and service culture.
* Monitor manpower productivity, staffing levels and organisational requirements.


 Talent Acquisition \& Manpower Planning
   

  

* Work with department heads to identify manpower requirements.
* Manage recruitment and selection processes in line with approved manning and budgets.
* Prepare and maintain manpower plans and recruitment trackers.
* Ensure timely hiring of quality candidates across all departments.
* Coordinate interviews, selection, reference checks and background verification.
* Ensure appropriate offer, joining and onboarding documentation.
* Maintain effective relationships with recruitment agencies, institutions and other talent sources.
* Support internal mobility, transfers and career opportunities within IHG.


 New Joiner Experience \& Onboarding
   

  

* Welcome and orient new colleagues to the hotel and IHG.
* Conduct HR induction and ensure completion of joining formalities.
* Ensure colleagues understand hotel policies, procedures, benefits, code of conduct and IHG values.
* Coordinate departmental induction and job\-specific orientation.
* Ensure all employee documentation is complete and maintained accurately.
* Create a positive first\-day and onboarding experience for new colleagues.


 Employee Engagement \& Culture
   

  

* Develop creative initiatives to engage, inspire and motivate colleagues.
* Plan and execute employee engagement activities, celebrations and recognition programmes.
* Support and administer the annual Team Member Satisfaction Survey and develop action plans based on results.
* Monitor employee feedback and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct regular employee interactions and engagement forums.
* Promote a culture of trust, respect, inclusion and collaboration.
* Recognise and celebrate employee achievements and contributions.
* Support IHG wellbeing initiatives and promote colleague wellbeing.


 Employee Relations
   

  

* Act as a trusted point of contact for colleagues on HR\-related matters.
* Address employee concerns, grievances and workplace issues professionally and confidentially.
* Support management in disciplinary and performance\-related matters.
* Ensure fair, consistent and transparent application of HR policies.
* Conduct exit interviews and analyse employee feedback and reasons for separation.
* Monitor employee turnover and develop retention initiatives.
* Maintain positive employee relations and a healthy workplace environment.


 Learning \& Development
   

  

* Identify training needs in consultation with department heads.
* Prepare and monitor the annual training calendar.
* Coordinate induction, mandatory and operational training programmes.
* Promote IHG learning platforms and development programmes.
* Support leadership development and succession planning.
* Encourage cross\-training and career development opportunities.
* Monitor training completion and maintain appropriate records.
* Support the development of colleagues through the IHG Room to Grow philosophy.


 Performance Management
   

  

* Coordinate the hotel's performance management process.
* Ensure timely completion of probation reviews and performance evaluations.
* Support managers in setting clear performance objectives.
* Coach managers on performance improvement and employee development.
* Monitor Performance Improvement Plans where required.
* Support succession planning and talent identification.
* Encourage continuous feedback and development conversations.


 Payroll \& HR Administration
   

  

* Coordinate monthly payroll activities with Finance and ensure accurate employee data.
* Maintain employee records, attendance, leave and payroll inputs.
* Ensure timely processing of salary, deductions and statutory contributions.
* Monitor attendance, overtime, leave and payroll\-related discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate employee files and HR documentation.
* Ensure HR reports and dashboards are updated and submitted on time.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and payroll information.


 Local Law \& Statutory Compliance
   

  

 Ensure compliance with all applicable
 **Central Government, Goa State and local employment laws and statutory requirements** 
 , including, as applicable:
   

  

* Applicable wage and employment requirements
* Provident Fund (PF)
* Employees' State Insurance (ESI)
* Professional Tax, where applicable
* Labour Welfare Fund, where applicable
* Gratuity requirements
* Bonus requirements
* Maternity Benefit requirements
* POSH / Prevention of Sexual Harassment requirements
* Shops \& Establishments / applicable establishment regulations
* Working hours, weekly off and leave requirements
* Contract Labour requirements
* Child labour and employment eligibility requirements
* Applicable Goa\-specific labour and employment regulations


 Additional responsibilities include:
   

  

* Maintain statutory registers, records and returns as required.
* Ensure timely payment and filing of statutory dues and returns.
* Coordinate labour inspections and statutory audits.
* Work with external consultants and authorities when required.
* Ensure employment documentation and HR practices remain compliant with applicable laws.
* Keep management updated on significant changes in employment legislation.


 HR Reporting \& Analytics
   

  

 Prepare and analyse regular HR reports including:
   

  

* Headcount and manpower status, Recruitment status, Attrition, Absenteeism, Payroll cost, Overtime, Employee turnover, Training hours and completion, Employee engagement, Diversity and inclusion, Leave utilisation, Pending HR actions
* Provide meaningful HR insights and recommendations to the General Manager and leadership team.


 Employee Welfare \& Wellbeing
   

  

* Promote colleague wellbeing and work\-life balance.
* Coordinate employee welfare initiatives.
* Ensure appropriate employee facilities and welfare provisions are available.
* Support IHG wellbeing programmes.
* Monitor employee accommodation, meals, uniforms, lockers and other welfare facilities, where applicable.
* Organise health, safety and wellbeing awareness initiatives.
* Encourage a workplace culture where colleagues feel supported and valued.


 Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion
   

  

* Promote an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with dignity and respect.
* Support IHG's commitment to equal employment opportunities.
* Encourage diversity across recruitment, development and career progression.
* Ensure employment decisions are based on merit, capability and business requirements.
* Promote a culture where colleagues feel they belong and are encouraged to contribute.


 HR Audit \& Risk Management
   

  

* Conduct regular HR audits and compliance reviews.
* Ensure employee files and statutory documentation are complete and accurate.
* Identify HR risks and implement corrective actions.
* Support IHG, internal, statutory and external audits.
* Track and close audit observations within agreed timelines.
* Ensure appropriate controls are maintained for employee data and confidential information.


 HR Responsibilities
   

  

 For the opening of
 **Holiday Inn Express Goa Morjim** 
 , the HR Manager will additionally be responsible for:
   

  

* Developing the manpower plan.
* Coordinating recruitment against approved manning.
* Preparing the recruitment and joining calendar.
* Supporting sourcing and selection of the opening team.
* Coordinating joining documentation and background verification.
* Developing the opening HR action plan.

 Core Competencies

 IHG True Hospitality

 The HR Manager is expected to demonstrate:
   

  

**True Attitude**

We are looking for someone who:  

* Has a strong interest in IT Infrastructure and Technology.

* Can learn new technologies quickly.

During the internship, the candidate will gain practical exposure to:

* Virtualization
* Networking

* Zabbix and Grafana monitoring

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Amazon Music - Catalog Quality
description:
**Description**
 The Music Catalog Quality team is seeking a passionate and talented Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) to join us. The Music Catalog Quality team is on a mission to enable accurate, complete, and enriched music metadata and content across the Amazon Music catalog. Our team is responsible for detecting, correcting, and enriching catalog metadata in real\-time, leveraging technologies such as large language models (LLMs), computer vision, natural language processing, deep learning classifiers, and related methods.
   

  

 Our mission is to provide high\-quality, dynamically validated and enriched catalog metadata with low latencies across the Amazon Music experience. We automate the detection and correction of metadata anomalies, including misattributed tracks, duplicate content, incorrect artist information, and incomplete album details, while providing internal teams with the tools and flexibility to continuously improve catalog integrity at scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, build, and operate scalable machine learning pipelines and online serving systems
* Work closely with applied scientists to optimize ML model performance and implement end\-to\-end solutions from experimentation through production
* Drive technology choices and continuous innovation for ML infrastructure across the sponsored products organization
* Collaborate with product managers, scientists, and engineers to deliver the right product for customers
* Build and maintain strong relationships across partner disciplines (Product, Science and Engg) to ensure customer\-focused delivery
* Contribute to operational excellence \- monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting high\-volume, low\-latency systems


**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Experience with at least one general\-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C\+\+, C\#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object\-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis

 AI / Generative AI Engineer

 Bangalore (On\-site / Hybrid)

 1 Year

 ₹15,00,000 – ₹20,00,000 LPA

 Full\-Time
   

  

**About the Role:** 
 We are a cutting\-edge technology startup building next\-generation AI products. We are looking for a highly exceptional, early\-career Generative AI Engineer to join our core AI team. In this high\-impact role, you will move beyond basic API wrappers to design, build, and optimize custom LLM workflows, RAG pipelines, and intelligent AI agents.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement complex Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for enterprise data.
* Integrate and evaluate foundational models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and open\-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral) for specific product use cases.
* Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen.
* Develop robust backend Python APIs (FastAPI) to serve AI models to frontend applications.
* Set up and query Vector Databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Chroma, or Weaviate) for semantic search.
* Optimize system latency, prompt architectures, and token economics for production workflows.


**Must\-Have Qualifications**
* Minimum 1 year of hands\-on, professional software engineering experience (or highly exceptional academic/internship experience in GenAI).
* Expert\-level proficiency in Python.
* Demonstrable production or deep open\-source project experience with LLMs, RAG, and Vector Databases.
* Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar orchestration frameworks.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Degree from a Tier\-1 engineering institution (IIT, NIT, IIIT, BITS) is highly preferred.
* Experience fine\-tuning open\-weight models (LoRA, QLoRA).
* Familiarity with AWS/GCP and Docker deployments.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

description:
Tech Guru IT Solutions is building an inside sales desk at its Nehru Place office and is hiring two Inside Sales Executives to run it.

title: Customer Success & Support Executive
description:
**Company Description:**

IndustryPrime is a SaaS platform built for manufacturing companies to manage their procurement and inventory in one place.

We help factories move away from Excel, Registers, and WhatsApp\-based workflows to a simple, transparent, and automated system that improves control, reduces costs, and saves time.

Today, 70\+ companies across India trust IndustryPrime to run their plant operations smoothly.

**Why This Role Exists:**

Most of our clients use only a small part of what IndustryPrime can do, and many don't use it the right way.

Explaining things over a phone call rarely leads to real change.

The biggest impact comes from visiting clients in person: understanding how they work, showing them what they're missing, and helping them use IndustryPrime more effectively.

The goal of this role is simple: make sure every client gets the maximum value from IndustryPrime.

You'll work closely with client teams, meet their management, identify gaps in adoption, and help them fix those gaps.

**Role Overview:**

This is a high\-ownership, client\-facing, travel\-heavy role where you will be responsible for:

● Proactively visiting clients to review their actual usage against the full capability of the platform, and closing that gap

● Onboarding new companies onto IndustryPrime, end to end

● Handling day\-to\-day client support, since deep adoption work requires deep product knowledge anyway

● Building the kind of relationship with client management and teams that turns into renewals and referrals

You will act as a consultant, trainer, and relationship owner for our clients, not simply someone who closes tickets.

(Open to freshers and experienced candidates alike; what matters more here is energy and ownership than years on a resume)

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Adoption \& Client Experience Enhancement (Core Focus)***

● Travel to client sites, including outstation manufacturing plants, proactively and on short notice

● Review each client's actual usage of the platform and identify features they aren't using, or are using incorrectly

● Sit with the client's team and management to demonstrate the value of full adoption in terms they care about (time saved, control gained, cost avoided)

● Pitch and push under\-used features directly to decision\-makers, not just end\-users

***Client Onboarding (New Companies)***

● Understand the client's current purchase \& inventory workflow

● Set up their system on IndustryPrime (items, users, permissions, etc.)

● Conduct onboarding sessions and product training, in person where needed

● Ensure a smooth transition from manual systems (Excel / Registers) to the software

● Take ownership until the client is fully live, comfortable, and actually using the product well

***Customer Support (Existing Clients)***

● Handle client queries via call/WhatsApp/email

● Resolve day\-to\-day operational issues on the platform

● Guide users on best practices within the software

● Ensure timely follow\-ups and issue closure

***Internal Coordination***

● Work closely with the product/tech team to report bugs or improvements

● Share real client feedback, especially patterns in what clients don't adopt and why, to improve the product

● Help refine onboarding, training, and adoption\-tracking processes

**What We're Looking For:**

***Attitude \& Energy***

● Someone who takes it personally when a client is not using the software properly, and acts with urgency rather than waiting for it to become a bigger problem

● High energy, and genuinely comfortable with outstation travel (sometimes on short notice)

● An "adjusting," no\-excuses attitude toward travel and changing plans. Delayed trains, last\-minute reschedules, and remote locations should not upset you

***Skills***

● A naturally assertive person who can push a client toward what's good for them, respectfully but firmly, rather than just agreeing with whatever they say

● Strong communication skills (Hindi \+ English required), and specifically the confidence to present to factory owners and senior management, not just operators

● Ability to explain in a simple, practical way

● You actively use AI tools (beyond just chatbots) to work smarter (we will be keen on seeing it during interview)

***Ways of Working***

● Quick learner, able to understand the product deeply enough to spot what a client should be using and isn't

● Being the one who follows up before the client even realizes there's a gap

**What You'll Learn**

● Deep understanding of how manufacturing businesses operate

● Real\-world purchase \& inventory workflows

● How to drive product adoption and manage client relationships at the management level

● SaaS implementation \& client management

● Problem\-solving skills

**Why Join IndustryPrime:**

● Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 (depending on experience) (flexible with salary if you have good experience) (Travel days are compensated separately)

● Work directly with founders and the core team

● High ownership from Day 1

● Real impact: you will directly improve how factories operate

● Fast learning curve in both business \& SaaS

● Frequent travel across India, including to plant locations most people never get to see

**If you're someone who's energized by getting in front of a client rather than staying on the phone and who sees a client relationship as something to actively grow rather than just maintain, we want to meet you.**

title: 3D Designer – Exhibition & Space Design
description:
**Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly capable and technically proficient 3D Artist specializing in Exhibition Stall and Space Design to join our design team. The ideal candidate should possess a strong combination of creative visualization, technical understanding, spatial awareness, and practical knowledge of exhibition fabrication and execution.
 



 We follow an established space design pipeline and workflow, and the selected candidate will be expected to work seamlessly within this system while taking ownership of the complete 3D requirements for exhibition projects.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Develop sophisticated and visually compelling 3D exhibition stall and spatial designs based on project briefs, brand guidelines, site dimensions, and functional requirements.
 



 • Take complete ownership of the 3D design process, from initial interpretation of the brief through design development, visualization, revisions, and final presentation.
 



 • Adhere to the existing design pipeline, production workflow, and quality standards followed by the organization.
 



 • Translate conceptual ideas into technically sound, dimensionally accurate, and practically executable 3D environments.
 



 • Demonstrate a strong understanding of exhibition structures, fabrication techniques, construction methodologies, materials, finishes, and spatial limitations.
 



 • Evaluate the technical feasibility of proposed designs, identifying potential structural, fabrication, or execution\-related limitations at the design stage itself.
 



 • Ensure that proposed designs can be realistically fabricated, assembled, and executed on\-site without compromising the intended creative vision.
 



 • Develop accurate 3D models with appropriate proportions, dimensions, clearances, structural logic, material specifications, and detailing.
 



 • Produce high\-quality, photorealistic renders suitable for client presentations, internal reviews, and project approvals.
 



 • Handle design iterations and modifications efficiently based on client feedback, technical requirements, site constraints, and execution considerations.
 



 • Coordinate effectively with designers, project managers, production teams, fabricators, and other stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
 



 • Maintain clear and consistent communication to ensure there are no gaps in understanding, execution, or project requirements.
 



 • Proactively identify design or technical challenges and provide practical, solution\-oriented alternatives.
 



 • Manage multiple projects, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining consistency in design quality and accuracy.
 



  





**Software Proficiency** 




 Blender is our primary 3D software and forms an integral part of our existing production pipeline.
 



 The candidate must have strong working knowledge of Blender, particularly in:
 



 • Advanced 3D modelling
 



 • Exhibition stall and spatial modelling
 



 • Material creation and texturing
 



 • Lighting and scene development
 



 • Camera composition
 



 • High\-quality rendering
 



 • Realistic visualization
 



 • Design iterations and modifications
 



 Familiarity with additional 3D, rendering, or visualization software will be considered an advantage.
 



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 




 • Minimum 1\+ year of professional experience in Exhibition Stall Design, Space Design, Interior Visualization, or a closely related field.
 



 • Demonstrable experience in designing and visualizing exhibition stalls or commercial spaces.
 



 • Strong understanding of structural systems, fabrication processes, materials, and on\-site execution.
 



 • Ability to interpret technical drawings, spatial dimensions, and project requirements accurately.
 



 • Practical understanding of what is structurally and technically feasible within an exhibition environment.
 



 • Strong portfolio demonstrating relevant exhibition, spatial, architectural, or commercial design work.
 



  





**Core Competencies** 




 Technical \& Structural Understanding\-
 



 The candidate should possess a practical understanding of how exhibition structures are designed, fabricated, assembled, and executed. The ability to distinguish between a visually impressive concept and a genuinely buildable solution is essential.
 



 High\-Quality Visualization\-
 



 A strong command of lighting, materials, textures, composition, camera perspective, and rendering techniques is expected. The candidate should be capable of producing polished, realistic, and presentation\-ready visualizations.
 



 Multitasking \& Project Management\-
 



 The role requires the ability to handle multiple stall requirements and parallel assignments without losing attention to detail. The candidate should be capable of prioritizing tasks, managing revisions, and consistently meeting project deadlines.
 



 Communication \& Collaboration\-
 



 Clear and effective communication is a critical requirement. The candidate must be able to understand briefs accurately, communicate technical limitations, raise concerns proactively, and coordinate effectively with internal teams and execution partners.
 



 Problem\-Solving Ability\-
 



 The candidate should approach design challenges with a solution\-oriented mindset and be capable of independently identifying technical issues and proposing viable alternatives.
 



 Attention to Detail\-
 



 Precision in dimensions, proportions, structural elements, materials, finishes, lighting, and overall presentation is essential.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 




 We are not looking for a general\-purpose 3D artist.
 



 We are specifically looking for a professional who understands the unique requirements of Exhibition Stall and Space Design and can bridge the gap between creative visualization and real\-world execution.
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to look at a design and immediately consider:
 



 “Is this technically feasible? Can this structure actually be fabricated and executed?”
 



 The selected candidate will be responsible for handling diverse exhibition stall requirements while working within our established design pipeline. They should be technically sound, creatively capable, comfortable with Blender, proficient in high\-quality rendering, capable of managing multiple assignments, and highly reliable in communication and execution.
 


* Ultimately, we are looking for an individual who can conceptualize, model, visualize, technically evaluate, communicate, and deliver exhibition spaces that are both visually compelling and practically executable.

title: AI Product Builder
description:
**The Short Version**




  





**Who we’re looking for:** 
 An AI Product Builder who thinks in terms of problems, systems, and leverage — and is excited to use AI to turn ideas into working solutions. You’re someone who likes getting your hands dirty, experimenting with new tools, and building and testing solutions quickly, with a strong bias toward action and real\-world validation.
 



  





**What the role is about:** 
 At Kraftshala, you’ll work on problems across student experience, revenue (admissions, sales, marketing), and internal operations. You’ll identify opportunities, figure out what to build, and use AI, automation, and modern tools to turn ideas into working products, workflows, and systems. You’ll work closely with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions from prototype to production.
 



  





**What makes this role meaningful:** 
 Rather than spending most of your time writing requirements or waiting for development cycles, you’ll be expected to experiment, prototype, ship, and learn quickly.
 



  





**Why you should apply:** 




  




* ***Build things that actually get used —***
 products, tools, workflows, and automations that solve real problems for students and teams at Kraftshala.
* ***Go from idea to working solution fast —***
 use AI and modern development tools to prototype, test, and ship instead of waiting around for long development cycles.
* ***Own problems, not just tasks —***
 take an idea from identifying the problem to building the solution and seeing what impact it creates.
* ***Work on problems that matter —***
 across student experience, revenue, and internal operations, alongside product, engineering, and business teams.
* ***Get to build across the stack —***
 from understanding users and business problems to prototyping, testing, and shipping solutions with AI and modern technology.



  





 If you’re someone who sees a problem and immediately wants to figure out how to build a better way, this role is for you.
 



  





**About us:** 
 Kraftshala is India’s largest higher\-education institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.
 



  





 We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex\-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.
 



  





**The Detailed Version**




  





 As an AI Product Builder at Kraftshala, you’ll be at the intersection of product, technology, and business. You’ll work closely with teams across the organisation to understand how they work, spot opportunities for improvement, and build solutions that make a meaningful difference.
 



 You’ll be expected to move quickly from understanding to experimentation — using AI and modern tools to explore different approaches, build prototypes, and learn what works. As solutions take shape, you’ll work with the right teams to refine, scale, and improve them.
 



  





 A core expectation in this role is the ability to build quickly and learn through experimentation — using AI\-assisted development, LLMs, APIs, integrations, automation, and modular systems to turn ideas into usable solutions, validate them in real contexts, and iterate based on what you learn.
 



  





**What you’ll own:** 




  




* Find \& Understand Problems: Work with users and teams to identify meaningful problems, understand what’s causing them, and figure out what is worth solving.
* Build \& Prototype: Turn ideas into working prototypes, tools, workflows, and automations using AI and modern development tools.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Time from idea to prototype, number of experiments shipped
* Test \& Iterate: Put what you build in front of real users, learn from feedback and data, and improve the solution based on what you learn.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Adoption, iteration velocity, solution effectiveness
* Ship \& Improve: Work with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions into production and continuously improve them based on usage and impact.
 **Metrics to measure:** 
 Delivery speed, adoption, business impact



  





**How you’ll operate:** 




  




* You move fluidly between understanding the problem and building the solution
* You use AI as a force multiplier across research, prototyping, development, and execution
* You default to building and testing, rather than spending too long planning
* You’re comfortable trying things that may not work and iterating quickly
* You prioritize speed to insight and usable output over perfect upfront planning
* You think in systems, not just features
* You care about what happens after something is built — adoption, impact, and outcomes



  





**Monthly Outcomes**




  





**Month 1:** 



* Build a strong understanding of Kraftshala’s users, systems, and business priorities
* Identify and validate meaningful problems worth solving
* Build and ship at least one small prototype, automation, or workflow improvement



  





**Month 2:** 



* Own a problem from understanding to solution
* Build, test, and iterate on prototypes using AI and modern tools
* Ship at least one meaningful product, workflow, or automation improvement



  





**Month 3\+:** 



* Take on increasingly complex problems and build solutions with greater autonomy
* Run faster build\-test\-learn cycles and improve what you ship based on real\-world feedback
* Deliver solutions that create measurable improvements in user experience, revenue, or operational efficiency



  





**Must Haves:**




  




* 1–2 years of experience in Product, a builder, technical, or closely related role — startup experience is a plus. (We’re not fussed about the exact years of experience, as that’s just a proxy for your skill level.)
* Have built and shipped something — a digital product, tool, prototype, workflow, automation, or similar.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development, APIs, automation, no\-code/low\-code, or modern development tools.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a bias for action.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast\-moving contexts.
* Strong user empathy, product intuition, and communication skills.



  





**Selection Process:**




  





 As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30\-60 minutes.
 



  





**Setting Expectations:** 
 This will be a call to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process.
 



**Technical Exercise:** 
 This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role
 



**Conversation 1:** 
 This will be a detailed assessment review conversation to go over your submission for the technical exercise along with other competencies required for the role.
 



**Conversation 2:** 
 A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode.
 



**Extending an offer:** 
 If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.
 



  





**Location:**




 Delhi
 



  





 Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors here.

We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Product Manager** 
 to lead the development and evolution of an AI\-native B2B product designed for complex engineering, tendering and document\-intensive business workflows.
 



  





 The successful candidate will combine product\-management capability with practical domain understanding. You will work directly with enterprise users, product designers, business analysts, AI engineers and software\-development teams to identify customer problems, define the roadmap and convert domain workflows into scalable product capabilities.
 



  





**Professional experience in at least one of the following sectors is mandatory:** 



* Water and wastewater infrastructure
* Electrical or modular infrastructure
* Data centres
* Industrial manufacturing



  





 Relevant experience may come from working within these industries, supporting EPC or engineering projects, managing bids and proposals, or developing technology products for these sectors.
 



 This is a product\-ownership role—not solely a project\-coordination position. You will be accountable for what the product should solve, what gets prioritised and the outcomes delivered to customers.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 



* Develop a deep understanding of users, industry workflows and operational challenges within the target sectors.
* Conduct discovery sessions with bid, proposal, estimating, engineering, commercial, contracts and management teams.
* Map complex workflows involving tender review, qualification, compliance, risk, estimating, proposals, approvals and contract handover.
* Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, priorities and release objectives.
* Translate customer and domain problems into clearly defined product opportunities and use cases.
* Prioritise features based on customer value, domain relevance, market opportunity, technical effort and scalability.
* Distinguish between customer\-specific requests and capabilities that should become part of the core product.
* Work with the Product Business Analyst to define requirements, business rules, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with Product Designers to create intuitive workflows, prototypes and enterprise\-product experiences.
* Partner with AI and engineering teams to assess feasibility, define expected behaviour and make product trade\-offs.
* Define how AI should assist users while maintaining accuracy, transparency, reviewability and human control.
* Manage the product backlog and ensure requirements and priorities are clearly understood by the development team.
* Participate in sprint planning, design reviews, product demonstrations and release\-readiness reviews.
* Engage directly with customers during product demonstrations and pilots.
* Capture structured feedback from pilots and convert validated learning into product improvements.
* Define and track product metrics such as adoption, feature usage, workflow completion, time saved and customer outcomes.
* Conduct market and competitor analysis to strengthen product differentiation.
* Support Product Marketing and Sales with positioning, use cases, demonstrations, launches and sales\-enablement material.
* Ensure product decisions consider enterprise requirements such as security, permissions, auditability, integrations and deployment.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* **Mandatory** 
 professional experience in at least one of these sectors: water and wastewater infrastructure, electrical or modular infrastructure, data centres, or industrial manufacturing.
* 2–5 years of experience in Product Management, preferably involving B2B SaaS, enterprise software or workflow platforms.
* Demonstrated experience taking a software product or major feature from discovery through launch and adoption.
* Understanding of engineering, EPC, tendering, proposal, estimating, commercial or contract\-related workflows.
* Strong capability in customer discovery, problem definition, roadmap planning and feature prioritisation.
* Experience managing complex business workflows and document\-intensive enterprise applications.
* Ability to translate industry problems into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Experience working with product designers, business analysts, engineering, AI and QA teams.
* Strong understanding of agile product\-development practices, backlog management and release planning.
* Experience defining user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, edge cases and product\-success metrics.
* Ability to communicate credibly with domain experts, enterprise customers, senior stakeholders and technical teams.
* Ability to challenge customer requests constructively and protect the long\-term scalability of the product.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* A track record of ownership, independent decision\-making and cross\-functional leadership.



  





 Experience with AI/LLM\-enabled products, document intelligence, knowledge systems or workflow automation would be highly valuable.

 Real Jobs Consulting Services is a Gurgaon\-based placement firm known for dependable and high\-quality recruitment solutions. The organization offers a wide range of services including HR consultancy, placement consultancy, manpower recruitment, domestic placement, career consultancy, and work\-from\-home opportunities. * Prior experience in recruitment, HR services, or consultancy environments is beneficial but not mandatory.

 Uplevyl builds AI\-powered knowledge and community infrastructure for organizations serving women. Our products include UpGenie (our domain\-specific AI assistant), WeHub (our community platform), and UpSocial (a social platform for women). We work with mission\-driven partners to turn complex, high\-stakes information into clear, trustworthy guidance, and to build systems that create lasting impact.
 



  





 We hold a simple conviction: in high\-stakes domains like rights, law, and financial security, a generic AI is not enough. The answers people stake their lives and livelihoods on need a purpose\-built system with verified, native data. That is what we build, and it is why the work is urgent. AI is reshaping how the world learns, works, and earns, and the women we serve cannot afford to be left off that train.
 



  





 We have also made a deliberate choice about how we build: a small team of exceptional people, paid well above market, each doing work that would normally take several. We would rather be ten people who move the world than thirty who move paper. That choice sets the bar for every hire, including this one.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Our website is our front door. Almost everyone who meets our founder goes there next, and over the coming months that traffic arrives on the back of a Forbes piece, an industry award, and a Financial Times feature. What those visitors find cannot merely be tidy. It has to look like it was made by someone with taste, and it has to carry a story no one else is telling.
 



  





 You own that, and more than that. You are the design function at Uplevyl: the website, the interfaces inside UpGenie, WeHub, and UpSocial, the brand itself, and the investor and partnership material that goes into rooms we are not in.
 



  





 What makes this role unusual is that you build what you design. We are not looking for someone who produces a file and hands it to engineering; the gap between those two people is where quality has died for us before. You work in Framer today, and you will move into the codebase as the site grows. The interactive pieces are yours end to end: a chart a reader clicks into rather than watches, a hero that answers a cursor, a section that assembles as you scroll. Being able to build something like that quickly, and build it well, is not a bonus skill in this role. It is the job, and it is the first thing we look for.
 
  
 




  





 It helps to know what we are trying to make. Uplevyl’s work is recovering knowledge about women that was never collected, or was collected and then lost. Our site is meant to be the first small instance of that idea: more than twenty works by historical women artists woven through it and properly attributed, because when we went looking for a site that already did this, there wasn’t one. The whole thing should read like a good technology magazine — feminine without being decorative, art and engineering in the same frame, closer to something etched in glass than printed on paper. That is a real design problem, and it is the interesting part of this job.
 
  
 




  





**What you’ll own** 



* **The website, end\-to\-end.** 
 Structure, layout, typography, motion, and the copy when the copy is the thing that is wrong. You publish it, you test it on desktop and mobile, and you test it in Safari, because most of the people we build for are on Safari.
* **Interactive work that feels alive.** 
 The magazine version of our site: case data rendered as colored stripes a mathematically\-minded reader understands on sight, a panel that opens onto one woman’s story and closes back into the page, visualizations a reader moves through rather than watches. You build these in days, not quarters.
* **Product interfaces and the system underneath them.** 
 UpGenie, WeHub, and UpSocial are live products with real users and recurring design bugs. Own the design system and component library that end them, and set the standard for what our product looks like when someone who does this for a living opens it.
* **The brand and the assets that carry it.** 
 Logo, type, palette, and the investor decks, capability statements, brochures, and campaign creative that represent us when we are not in the room. Keep them recognizably Uplevyl even when three of them are due the same day.
* **The quality bar itself.** 
 Whether things line up, whether a card breaks the pattern, whether the text sits right — these are calls only a sharp, trained eye can make. Nothing leaves you that a founder has to catch. You are the last person who looks, and you look properly.
* **A cadence the team can rely on.** 
 Changes compiled Monday, pushed Wednesday, tested Thursday, live Friday. Page owners across the company come to you, and you make the result read as one thing.



  





**Who we’re looking for** 




 We are not looking for a UI/UX designer, and we are not looking for a front\-end developer who executes a mock. We want the rarer person who is honestly both: understands art, understands engineering, and would be bored doing only one of them. We hire across levels. The portfolio decides, not the years.
 



  




* **You build high\-end interactive and animated work, fast.** 
 This is the gate. Show us a piece that would normally take a team much longer than it took you — an interactive visualization, a generative or motion piece, a scroll experience — and be able to walk us through how you pulled it off. If you cannot do this, nothing else in the application will make up for it.
* **An eye that is almost uncomfortable.** 
 You notice the four\-pixel gap, the card that breaks the grid, the clipped descender, the animation that stutters on someone else’s machine. You notice it first, because the alternative is that our CEO notices it first.
* **You ship code.** 
 Framer now; React, CSS, and whatever the motion asks for — GSAP, Three.js, WebGL, SVG — as the site moves into the repository. You are at home in a codebase and in a browser’s dev tools.
* **You read the content, not just the layout.** 
 Hand you a dense page about jurisdictional employment law or wealth advisory and you work out what it is trying to say, then design something that says it better. When the words are the problem, you say so and offer a fix.
* **Taste with an argument behind it.** 
 You can hold “feminine” and “serious technology” in one design without collapsing into either. You have references, opinions about those references, and reasons for a choice beyond liking it.
* **High agency.** 
 There is no design team below you and no brief waiting on your desk. You take a surface, own it, finish it, and tell us it is done.
* **Outcomes over hours.** 
 We care about what shipped and how good it was.



  





**Even better if** 



* You came to design sideways — through finance, engineering, marketing, growth, or something else entirely. Some of the strongest people we have looked at did.
* You have a real practice in generative art, WebGL or Three.js, motion design, or data visualization.
* You have built and maintained a design system or component library in production.
* You have worked in Framer, Webflow, Replit, Lovable, or similar, and you know where each one stops.
* You have built a brand from nothing: identity, logo, type system, the lot.
* You have worked in mission\-driven, social\-impact, women\-focused, or nonprofit ecosystems.
* You have founder, startup operator, or early\-employee experience.



  





**Before you apply** 




 We want to be direct about what this is. You would be the only designer here, working closely with our founders, whose feedback is immediate, specific, and not softened. Careless work is the one thing that does not survive at Uplevyl, and if you would find that exhausting rather than clarifying, this is not the right fit, and that is fine. It is also a role with unusual room: nobody is going to tell you which typeface, which motion, or which idea. That part is yours.
 



  





 Send us a portfolio. With it, send two things: one piece where you used AI to make something you could not have made otherwise, with a short note on how you did it; and your answer to a question we ask everyone — if budget were no object, what tool would you buy tomorrow, and what would you do with it?
 



  





 The work is demanding, the expectations are real, and the rewards, in compensation, in ownership, and in what you will learn, match them. Our interview process is thorough, and we will walk you through every step of it in our first conversation.
 



  





**How we work at Uplevyl** 



* **We finish what we start, and we do it well.** 
 We follow through on what we say we’ll do, and we care about the difference our work makes.
* **We listen before we decide.** 
 Before we act, we ask who it actually affects: a customer, a partner, a teammate, or the communities we serve. Trust here is built the plain way, by consistently showing up for people.
* **We move with ownership and urgency.** 
 We don’t wait for perfect information or for someone else to raise their hand. If something looks like it could go wrong, we say so early. We make the call, we move fast, and we hold a high bar for quality.
* **We’re better together than alone.** 
 We work across teams, say what we actually think, and go out of our way to help each other succeed. Leadership here is measured by the impact you create.
* **We stay curious and keep learning, including how to use AI well.** 
 We hold ourselves to the bar we’re building toward: questioning our own assumptions and using AI to think better and move faster.

title: Software Development Engineer II , Product & Offers Experience
description:
**Description**
 Do you shop on Amazon? Have you ever browsed a product detail page, scrolled through images, compared prices, checked delivery dates, and then clicked "Add to Cart"? That entire experience? Our team builds it.
   

  

 The Product \& Offers Experience organization is responsible for building the world's best product evaluation and discovery experiences for Amazon shoppers. We own the experiences that help hundreds of millions of customers worldwide make confident purchase decisions, from the moment they land on a product page to the moment they add to cart. Our work spans offer selection, offer display, pricing presentation, and the rich product information that surrounds the buy box. As the worldwide product showroom for the "everything store," we directly drive the majority of purchase decisions on Amazon across all surfaces: mobile, desktop, and voice.
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will own the design and delivery of significant features and services end to end. You will make architectural decisions that shape how hundreds of millions of customers discover, evaluate, and purchase products on Amazon. You will work on highly scalable systems in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment where your code ships to customers quickly and your impact is real and measurable. You will raise the operational bar, contribute to a federated architecture that enables hundreds of partner teams across Amazon to innovate, and mentor engineers around you.
   

  

 The ideal candidate has strong technical depth, sharp problem\-solving skills, and a genuine passion for building technology that directly shapes the customer experience. You are customer obsessed, take ownership of your work end to end, and thrive in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. If you want to build experiences that matter to hundreds of millions of customers and grow as an engineer alongside a talented, motivated team, we want to meet you.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the design, development, and delivery of major features and services, from broadly defined problems through to production and operations.
* Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
* Make sound architectural and technical trade\-offs, and drive engineering best practices, design reviews, code quality, testing, and operational excellence, across the team.
* Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault\-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage and use.
* Collaborate with cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the technical growth of the team.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3\+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: HR Analytics Trainee (B.Tech + MBA)
description:
A great entry\-level opportunity for
 **B.E./B. Tech \+ MBA** 
 graduates passionate about HR, data, and AI.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Human Resources Fresher who can support HR operations through data analysis, reporting, dashboards, and modern AI tools.
   

  

 This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who are interested in Human Resources, data analytics, Power BI, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI\-enabled work. The ideal candidate should not only understand HR processes but also be comfortable working with data, creating reports, identifying patterns, and using AI tools to complete work faster and more accurately.
   

  

 The person will work closely with the HR team to analyze recruitment, employee, attendance, performance, and workforce data, build dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to improve speed, accuracy, and decision\-making.
   

  

**Eligibility Criteria**
* B.E./B.Tech \+ MBA — both degrees required
* Freshers are eligible to apply
* Candidates with internships, projects, certifications, or practical exposure in HR analytics, Power BI, Excel, or AI tools will be preferred


**Core Job Responsibilities**
**HR Data Analysis \& Reporting** 
 — Collect, clean, organize, and analyze HR data related to recruitment, employee records, attendance, onboarding, performance, attrition, and workforce planning.
   

  

**Power BI Dashboards \& MIS Reporting** 
 — Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and MIS trackers using tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar reporting platforms.
   

  

**Recruitment Analytics** 
 — Track hiring funnel metrics such as applications received, shortlisted candidates, interview status, offer rollout, joining status, turnaround time, source effectiveness, and drop\-off points.
   

  

**Workforce Analytics** 
 — Analyze employee data to identify trends related to headcount, attrition, attendance, performance, engagement, skills, and manpower requirements.
   

  

**AI\-Assisted Workflows** 
 — Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar platforms to speed up data cleaning, report writing, formula creation, dashboard planning, insight generation, documentation, and process improvement.
   

  

**Data Interpretation \& Business Insights** 
 — Convert raw HR data into clear insights and summaries that help the HR team and business leaders make better decisions.
   

  

**HR Operations Support** 
 — Support day\-to\-day HR operations such as onboarding tracking, employee documentation, HRMS data updates, employee query tracking, and process documentation.
   

  

**Automation \& Process Improvement** 
 — Identify repetitive HR reporting or operational tasks and suggest ways to automate or simplify them using Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, AI tools, or other workflow tools.
   

  

**Data Accuracy \& Quality Checks** 
 — Validate reports and AI\-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability before sharing them with internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Data Privacy \& Responsible AI Use** 
 — Handle employee and candidate data responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and ensuring AI tools are used carefully and ethically.
   

  

**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong interest in HR analytics, people data, and data\-driven decision\-making
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, filters, lookup functions, and data cleaning
* Familiarity with Power BI, or willingness to build dashboards using Power BI
* Ability to interpret data and explain insights in simple business language
* Hands\-on usage of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, or similar tools for work\-related tasks
* Ability to write clear prompts, verify AI\-generated outputs, and improve responses through iteration
* Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data
* Curiosity to learn new HR tech, analytics tools, and automation methods


**Preferred Skills**
* Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, DAX, or dashboard creation
* Basic understanding of SQL, Python, or data visualization concepts
* Experience with HRMS, ATS, payroll systems, or employee management tools
* Prior internship, academic project, or personal project involving data analysis, dashboards, or HR analytics
* Experience using AI tools to create reports, clean data, generate formulas, summarize trends, or automate repetitive work
* Understanding of recruitment, onboarding, attendance, performance management, or employee lifecycle processes

description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we’re working to be the "Earth's Best Employer and Earth's Safest Place to Work." To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. If you would like to help us make history, here’s your chance to accelerate our growth and ability to serve our employees and associates by joining the India Operations Employee Relations (ER) Team.
   

  

 The India Operations ER team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfilment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees and associates that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, ER team’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories.
   

  

 INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience.
   

  

 As an Employee Relations Manager (ERM), you will drive positive employee relations and enable positive associate and employee experience in your region and line of business.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. The role will set in motion and advance numerous programs that develop and nurture a positive work environment, and advancing our work towards being the earth’s best employer. This position requires an individual who has employee relations experience. Experience and exposure to Indian statutory labor compliance laws will be helpful. Successful candidate will be able to independently own and drive broad spectrum of employee relations programs and handle issues. This role requires considerable domestic travel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The individual will be responsible for the following types of proactive work:
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Communicate Effectively: Rapidly produce high\-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and recommends solutions; design and deliver highly\-engaging training sessions. Partner to engage in continuous improvement in communication vehicles and practices
* Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs. Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee feedback
* Detect and Mitigate Risks: Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends, gaps, and challenges; execute solution\-focused strategies and programs to mitigate risks
* Project Management: Independently own large\-scale, network\-wide projects delivered on time that improve associate experience at a site and network level. Conduct and oversee employee relations vulnerability assessment programs


 The individual also will work on critical employee relations issues that are crisis oriented and typically can only be successfully completed with limited time while exercising judgment. Time management between proactive and reactive responsibilities is a critical component for success in the position.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 5\+ years of employee relations, labor relations, human resources, operations or related field experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources Management or a related field
* 6\+ years of relevant professional experience
