title: IT Infrastructure & Server Administrator
description:
**Job Purpose**
 To manage, maintain, monitor, and support the organization's IT infrastructure, servers, networks, storage, backup systems, and related IT services. The role is responsible for ensuring high availability, security, performance, and smooth functioning of critical IT infrastructure across the hospital.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

* Server \& Infrastructure Management
* Manage and maintain physical and virtual servers, including Windows and Linux environments.
* Monitor server performance, availability, storage, CPU, memory, and system health.
* Perform server installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Manage Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policies, and user access.
* Manage virtualization platforms such as VMware/Hyper\-V.
* Ensure timely resolution of server and infrastructure\-related incidents.
* Maintain server room infrastructure, including racks, UPS, power, cooling, and related equipment.
* Network Infrastructure
* Manage and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, switches, routers, firewalls, and related network infrastructure.
* Monitor network performance and identify connectivity or performance issues.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers and external IT vendors for connectivity\-related issues.
* Maintain network diagrams, IP address records, and infrastructure documentation.
* Ensure proper network segmentation and access controls.
* Backup \& Disaster Recovery
* Manage and monitor daily backups of critical servers, databases, and applications.
* Ensure backup integrity through periodic verification and restoration testing.
* Develop and maintain backup and disaster recovery procedures.
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery activities.
* Ensure critical hospital systems have appropriate backup and recovery mechanisms.
* IT Security
* Implement and monitor infrastructure security controls.
* Manage antivirus/endpoint security, firewall policies, access controls, and system hardening.
* Ensure timely application of operating system and security patches.
* Monitor and investigate infrastructure\-related security incidents.
* Maintain appropriate user access and privileges based on organizational requirements.
* Hospital IT Systems Support
* Provide infrastructure support for critical hospital applications such as HIS/HMS, EMR, LIS, RIS/PACS, billing, pharmacy, laboratory, and other integrated systems.
* Coordinate with application vendors and internal teams for infrastructure\-related issues.
* Ensure availability of IT infrastructure supporting critical hospital operations.
* Support integration and connectivity requirements for medical and administrative systems.
* Monitoring \& Maintenance
* Conduct regular preventive maintenance of servers, network devices, storage, and other infrastructure.
* Monitor system alerts and proactively identify potential failures.
* Maintain IT infrastructure inventory and asset records.
* Prepare infrastructure performance and incident reports.
* Ensure all infrastructure\-related activities are properly documented.
* Vendor \& Project Coordination
* Coordinate with hardware, networking, server, software, AMC, and other IT vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure timely resolution of service issues.
* Assist in IT infrastructure procurement, installation, migration, and implementation projects.
* Evaluate infrastructure requirements and provide technical recommendations.
* IT Service \& Incident Management
* Handle and resolve L2/L3 infrastructure\-related incidents.
* Provide technical guidance to the IT support team.
* Perform root cause analysis for recurring infrastructure issues.
* Maintain incident, problem, change, and maintenance records.
* Ensure timely closure of critical IT incidents as per defined SLAs.


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or a related field.
   

  

 Must have skills
   

  

* Windows Server Administration
* Active Directory, DNS, DHCP \& Group Policy
* Server Monitoring \& Troubleshooting
* Hardware \& Storage Management
* Vendor Management


 Good to have skills
   

  

* Experience in hospital IT infrastructure and 24×7 critical environments.
* Cloud infrastructure knowledge – Azure/AWS.

* Zabbix
* Grafana
* SigNoz
* Uptime Monitoring
* Docker
* Git/GitHub
* CI/CD
* Shell scripting
* Python
* LDAP
* Active Directory
* VPN
* Firewall administration
* Cloud platforms
* Database administration
* Backup and disaster recovery


 Educational Qualification
   

  

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.
* BCA / MCA or equivalent IT qualification.
* Freshers and recent graduates are welcome.
* Candidates with academic projects in Infrastructure, Networking, DevOps, Full\-Stack Development, or System Administration are preferred.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who:**
* Has a strong interest in IT Infrastructure and Technology.
* Has basic knowledge of both Infrastructure and Software Development.
* Is comfortable working with Linux and Windows.
* Understands basic networking concepts.
* Has basic Frontend, Backend, and Full\-Stack knowledge.
* Has good troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Is willing to work hands\-on with servers, networks, systems, and applications.
* Can learn new technologies quickly.
* Has good communication and teamwork skills.
* Is willing to work in an onsite infrastructure environment.


 Key Learning Opportunities
   

  

 During the internship, the candidate will gain practical exposure to:
   

  

* Server administration
* Linux administration
* Windows administration
* Virtualization
* Networking
* Firewalls and VPN
* Endpoint security
* Zabbix and Grafana monitoring
* Application monitoring
* Database environments
* Backup and disaster recovery
* CCTV infrastructure
* IT asset management
* LDAP
* Frontend applications
* Backend applications
* Full\-Stack architecture
* APIs
* Application deployment
* DevOps fundamentals
* Infrastructure troubleshooting


 Career Path
   

  

**This Internship Can Provide a Foundation For Careers In:**
* Infrastructure Engineer
* System Administrator
* Network Engineer
* DevOps Engineer
* Cloud Engineer
* IT Operations Engineer
* Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
* Application Support Engineer
* Full\-Stack Infrastructure/Platform Engineer


 Internship\-to\-Hire
   

  

 Based on
 **performance, technical skills, learning ability, discipline, and organizational requirements** 
 , the successful intern may be considered for a
 **full\-time employment opportunity after completion of the internship** 
 .
   

  

 Important Requirement
   

  

 Candidates with only basic desktop\-support knowledge and no understanding of
 **Frontend, Backend, Full\-Stack, APIs, and databases** 
 will not be considered suitable for this position.
   

  

**The Role Requires a Combination Of:**
**Infrastructure \+ Networking \+ Systems \+ Application \+ Development knowledge.**

 The CSAM (IC1\) is an early\-in\-career Customer Success Account Manager who delivers standardized customer success outcomes spanning executive partnership, solution health, cloud adoption, and AI acceleration activities. These CSAMs act within a pod model.
   

  

 Working under the direction of CSAMs and a M1 Manager, the CSAM operates within a defined pod covering a shared portfolio of accounts. The role contributes to portfolio\-level intelligence, execution orchestration, and reactive signal aggregation – reducing context\-switching for senior CSAMs and accelerating customer outcomes.

title: Customer Success & Support Executive
location: Kolkata metropolitan area, West Bengal, India
description:
**Company Description:** 




  





 IndustryPrime is a SaaS platform built for manufacturing companies to manage their procurement and inventory in one place.
 



  





 We help factories move away from Excel, Registers, and WhatsApp\-based workflows to a simple, transparent, and automated system that improves control, reduces costs, and saves time.
 



  





 Today, 70\+ companies across India trust IndustryPrime to run their plant operations smoothly.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists:** 




  





 Most of our clients use only a small part of what IndustryPrime can do, and many don't use it the right way.
 



  





 Explaining things over a phone call rarely leads to real change.
 



  





 The biggest impact comes from visiting clients in person: understanding how they work, showing them what they're missing, and helping them use IndustryPrime more effectively.
 



  





 The goal of this role is simple: make sure every client gets the maximum value from IndustryPrime.
 



 You'll work closely with client teams, meet their management, identify gaps in adoption, and help them fix those gaps.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




  





 This is a high\-ownership, client\-facing, travel\-heavy role where you will be responsible for:
 



 ●  Proactively visiting clients to review their actual usage against the full capability of the platform, and closing that gap
 



 ●  Onboarding new companies onto IndustryPrime, end to end
 



 ●  Handling day\-to\-day client support, since deep adoption work requires deep product knowledge anyway
 



 ●  Building the kind of relationship with client management and teams that turns into renewals and referrals
 



  





 You will act as a consultant, trainer, and relationship owner for our clients, not simply someone who closes tickets.
 



  





 (Open to freshers and experienced candidates alike; what matters more here is energy and ownership than years on a resume)
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





***Adoption \& Client Experience Enhancement (Core Focus)***




 ●  Travel to client sites, including outstation manufacturing plants, proactively and on short notice
 



 ●  Review each client's actual usage of the platform and identify features they aren't using, or are using incorrectly
 



 ●  Sit with the client's team and management to demonstrate the value of full adoption in terms they care about (time saved, control gained, cost avoided)
 



 ●  Pitch and push under\-used features directly to decision\-makers, not just end\-users
 



  





***Client Onboarding (New Companies)***




 ●  Understand the client's current purchase \& inventory workflow
 



 ●  Set up their system on IndustryPrime (items, users, permissions, etc.)
 



 ●  Conduct onboarding sessions and product training, in person where needed
 



 ●  Ensure a smooth transition from manual systems (Excel / Registers) to the software
 



 ●  Take ownership until the client is fully live, comfortable, and actually using the product well
 



  





***Customer Support (Existing Clients)***




 ●  Handle client queries via call/WhatsApp/email
 



 ●  Resolve day\-to\-day operational issues on the platform
 



 ●  Guide users on best practices within the software
 



 ●  Ensure timely follow\-ups and issue closure
 



  





***Internal Coordination***




 ●  Work closely with the product/tech team to report bugs or improvements
 



 ●  Share real client feedback, especially patterns in what clients don't adopt and why, to improve the product
 



 ●  Help refine onboarding, training, and adoption\-tracking processes
 



  





**What We're Looking For:** 




  





***Attitude \& Energy***




 ● Someone who takes it personally when a client is not using the software properly, and acts with urgency rather than waiting for it to become a bigger problem
 



 ● High energy, and genuinely comfortable with outstation travel (sometimes on short notice)
 



 ● An "adjusting," no\-excuses attitude toward travel and changing plans. Delayed trains, last\-minute reschedules, and remote locations should not upset you
 



  





***Skills***




 ● A naturally assertive person who can push a client toward what's good for them, respectfully but firmly, rather than just agreeing with whatever they say
 



 ● Strong communication skills (Hindi \+ English required), and specifically the confidence to present to factory owners and senior management, not just operators
 



 ● Ability to explain in a simple, practical way
 



 ● You actively use AI tools (beyond just chatbots) to work smarter (we will be keen on seeing it during interview)
 



  





***Ways of Working***




 ● Quick learner, able to understand the product deeply enough to spot what a client should be using and isn't
 



 ● Being the one who follows up before the client even realizes there's a gap
 



  





**What You'll Learn** 




  





 ●  Deep understanding of how manufacturing businesses operate
 



 ●  Real\-world purchase \& inventory workflows
 



 ●  How to drive product adoption and manage client relationships at the management level
 



 ● SaaS implementation \& client management
 



 ●  Problem\-solving skills
 



  





**Why Join IndustryPrime:** 




  





 ●  Salary: ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 (depending on experience) (flexible with salary if you have good experience) (Travel days are compensated separately)
 



 ●  Work directly with founders and the core team
 



 ●  High ownership from Day 1

title: Computer Vision Research Intern
description:
**About the Role** 




 Auric AI Labs is developing the world's most advanced AI\-powered vision intelligence platform for defense applications. Our system processes satellite (EO, IR, SAR, hyperspectral) and drone imagery to detect, classify, and track high\-value enemy assets like tanks, radars, missile launchers, aircraft, and warships.
 



 We are not just building an AI model—we are designing the future of defense intelligence, enabling real\-time situational awareness and strategic military decision\-making.
 



 If you’re an exceptional AI/Computer Vision Researcher who thrives on solving hard problems with first\-principles thinking, we want you on our team.

**Computer Vision Model Development** 



* Design, train, and deploy advanced computer vision models to detect and classify a wide range of military assets, including trucks, tanks, radars, aircraft, ships, and submarines.

**Data Processing \& Pipeline Development**

**Geospatial Analysis \& Targeting** 



* Implement intelligent target prioritization workflows that adapt dynamically to operator inputs.
* Develop advanced localization techniques to determine and visualize the position of identified targets accurately.



**Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Demonstrated excellence through research, internships, or personal projects in computer vision.
* Strong foundation in first\-principles problem solving to tackle complex technical challenges.
* Proficiency in Python with hands\-on experience in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and OpenCV.
* Expertise in image processing, object detection, segmentation, and classification.



**Why Join Us?** 



* Be part of building a groundbreaking, high\-impact defense technology platform.
* Collaborate with a team of innovative professionals dedicated to excellence.
* Competitive compensation and benefits tailored to your expertise.
* Shape the future of AI\-driven defense solutions while making a direct contribution to national security.

title: Hardware Design Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Noida (On\-site)
 



**Company:** 
 Aereka Airtech Pvt. Ltd.
 



  





**About AEREKA** 




 AEREKA is building a next\-generation environmental technology platform focused on outdoor and semi\-outdoor air purification. We're developing a multidisciplinary deep\-tech product that brings together mechanical engineering, airflow and filtration, electronics, sensing, firmware, industrial design, data, AI, manufacturing, and real\-world deployment, making clean air accessible wherever people live, work, and gather.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a passionate Hardware Design Engineer who enjoys building electronic systems from concept to reality. You will design, develop, debug, and validate the embedded hardware platform at the core of AEREKA's outdoor air purification product — sensor systems, power electronics, motor/fan control, and connectivity — working closely with mechanical, firmware, and product teams. If you enjoy designing circuits, creating PCBs, solving hardware challenges in demanding outdoor environments, and bringing products to life, we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Hardware Design \& Development
 


* Design analog, digital, mixed\-signal, and power electronic circuits for outdoor deployment — including motor/fan drive electronics, power supply and battery/charging circuits.
* Develop schematics and production\-ready PCB layouts.
* Select components based on technical requirements and outdoor\-environment constraints (temperature, humidity, dust, vibration).
* Design air\-quality sensor interface circuits (particulate matter, gas, temperature/humidity sensors) and power management circuits.
* Design connectivity hardware (Wi\-Fi, cellular, LoRa, or similar) to support IoT and AI\-driven monitoring.



 PCB Design \& Prototyping
 


* Create multi\-layer PCB designs using industry\-standard tools.
* Generate BOMs, manufacturing files, and assembly documentation.
* Support prototype development, enclosure/thermal coordination with mechanical teams, and vendor coordination.



 Testing \& Debugging
 


* Perform hardware bring\-up, validation, and troubleshooting, including under outdoor/environmental stress conditions.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* Use oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, and other lab equipment for debugging.
* Support environmental and reliability testing (temperature, humidity, ingress protection, vibration) relevant to outdoor hardware.



 Collaboration \& R\&D
 


* Work closely with firmware, mechanical, industrial design, and product teams to integrate hardware into the complete air purification system.
* Contribute to new product development for AEREKA's outdoor air purification platform, from concept through field deployment.
* Explore emerging technologies in sensing, power electronics, and low\-power connectivity relevant to environmental hardware.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Required
 


* B.Tech / M.Tech / Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, or related fields.
* 1–5 years of hands\-on hardware design experience.

**Robotics Software Usecases Validation Engineer**
**About The Role**
 Join AMD’s PAVS team as a Robotics Usecases Validation Engineer where you will Validate and Execute diverse Robotics platforms, variants and customer usecases for advanced robotics systems across software, hardware, and integrated platforms. Your work will ensure safety, reliability, and performance through rigorous testing in simulation, Gazebo, Isaac sim, SIL/HIL environments, and real\-world deployments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Validation Strategy \& Usecases : Define Usecases and execute validation plans for robotics software stacks (perception, planning, control) and hardware subsystems.
* Automation \& Frameworks: Develop automated test suites for ROS2 nodes, navigation stack (Nav2\), and fleet APIs using Python/C\+\+, pytest, gtest/gmock.
* Simulation \& Scenario Testing: Build simulation environments (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim) for warehouse layouts; author scenarios for obstacle avoidance, dynamic traffic, and multi\-robot coordination.
* SIL/HIL Validation: Set up Software\-in\-the\-Loop and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop rigs for AMR controllers, LiDAR emulators, and safety sensors; automate provisioning and logging.
* Sensor QA: Validate LiDAR, depth cameras, IMU, wheel encoders, and odometry accuracy under varying conditions.
* Navigation \& Fleet QA: Test SLAM, localization robustness, path planning, and fleet orchestration (traffic management, task allocation, VDA5050 compliance).
* Safety \& Compliance: Execute safety protocols for AMRs (emergency stop, zone monitoring, speed limits) aligned with ISO 3691\-4, ISO 13849, ANSI/RIA R15\.06\.
* Performance \& Reliability: Measure latency, throughput, and stability under high\-load scenarios; validate battery management and docking behaviors.
* CI/CD Integration: Embed automated tests into pipelines for continuous validation; monitor KPIs like defect escape rate and scenario coverage.
* Leadership: Act as a strong individual contributor and mentor for robotics validation teams; collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure customer experience is prioritized.


**Required Qualifications**
* 4 to 7 years in QA/Validation, with 4\+ years in robotics or AMR systems.
* Strong Python for automation and C\+\+ for ROS2 integration.
* Hands\-on experience with ROS2, Nav2 stack, colcon, and simulation tools (Gazebo/Ignition, Isaac Sim).

title: Associate Product Manager/ Product Manager – Supply Chain
description:
**About The Team**
 Purplle's Product Management team builds the technology products that power a comprehensive e\-commerce platform. The team constantly ships new supply chain features that are scalable, reduce cost, and enhance customer experience. As a lean team, every individual is expected to make a significant, measurable impact on the business.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who will own our Warehouse Management System (WMS) and internal supply chain tools as the core of the role, while also driving our ERP integration and our data platforms for reporting and data warehousing. You will work at the intersection of product, operations, and data, turning the needs of warehouse stakeholders into reliable, well\-built features. This is an individual contributor role that works closely with the data engineering, backend engineering, and analytics teams, as well as operations and business stakeholders, to deliver the roadmap.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Warehouse Management and Internal Tools
   

  

 Own the product roadmap for the WMS and adjacent internal tools used by warehouse teams.
   

  

 Translate operational problems into clear Product Requirement Documents, use cases, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA.
   

  

 Partner with backend engineering to design, build, and roll out new features, and drive adoption with operations teams.
   

  

 Identify workflow gaps and inefficiencies on the ground, then define structured improvements that scale.
   

  

 ERP Systems
   

  

 Support the integration and data consistency between the WMS and the ERP for sales, inventory, and reconciliation flows.
   

  

 Work with engineering and operations to debug system\-level discrepancies and drive root causes to closure.
   

  

 Help define and validate the impact of ERP\-related product changes.
   

  

 Data Platforms, Reporting, and Data Warehousing
   

  

 Lead the reporting and data warehousing layer that gives stakeholders a single, reliable source of truth.
   

  

 Coordinate with the data engineering team on ETL processes and pipelines that feed the warehouse.
   

  

 Build and maintain dashboards and reports covering inventory positions, stock movements, reconciliation health, and system performance.
   

  

 Use data analysis to surface insights and drive data\-informed product decisions.
   

  

**Must\-Have Skills And Requirements**
 1\+ years of experience in a product, analytics, or supply\-chain technology role.
   

  

 BE / B.Tech from a reputed institute. MBA is a plus but not mandatory.
   

  

 Working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying datasets in a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery.
   

  

 Solid data analysis fundamentals and the ability to understand discrepancies across systems.
   

  

 Familiarity with ETL processes and pipelines and how data moves from source systems into a data warehouse.
   

  

 Ability to write clear PRDs and use cases, and to think and work in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities.
   

  

 Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, and business teams.
   

  

 High ownership mindset with the ability to drive a problem from identification to resolution.
   

  

 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

 Exposure to Warehouse Management Systems and ERP systems, and an understanding of how inventory and sales data flow between them.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with BI or data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase.
   

  

 Experience with SAP or a similar enterprise ERP.
   

  

 Exposure to inventory management, or quick\-commerce and dark\-store operations.
   

  

 Familiarity with pipeline orchestration tools such as Airflow.
   

  

 What You Will Gain
   

  

 End\-to\-end ownership of the WMS and internal tools that run day\-to\-day supply chain operations.
   

  

 A role at the intersection of product, supply chain, and technology, with real influence on the roadmap.
   

  

 Deep exposure to ERP integration and to building the data platform behind business\-critical reporting.
   

  

 A clear growth path from Associate Product Manager toward a full Product Manager role.
   

  

**About Company**
 Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000\+ brands, 60,000\+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
   

  

 Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000\+ offline touchpoints and launched 100\+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third\-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend\-driven, high\-quality beauty essentials.
   

  

 What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper\-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer\-first approach.
   

  

 In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
   

  

 With a 3,000\+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

description:
**Product Manager
 *Commercialization / Downstream***




  





***\*\*This is not a software product manager role\*\****




  





**Location:** 
 Mahadevapura, Whitefield, Bangalore
 



**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site · 5 days/week
 



**Experience** 
 : 3–6 years
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Product Manager who will own the
 **commercial success of WaterScience products across their lifecycle** 
 .
 



 The role spans both
 **pre\-launch and post\-launch** 
 product management, understanding consumers and identifying opportunities, deciding what products to launch and how to position and price them, building strong go\-to\-market plans, and continuously improving product performance after launch.
 



 This is a highly cross\-functional role working across Product Development, R\&D, Sourcing, Category, Marketing, Sales, Retail, E\-commerce, and Customer Experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Product Commercialization \& Launch** 



* Own the commercial readiness and
 **go\-to\-market plan** 
 for new products.
* Define launch objectives, target audience, pricing, positioning, messaging, channels, and launch calendar.
* Coordinate with online, retail and direct sales teams to ensure each channel is ready for launch.
* Work with Marketing and Category teams to create product pages, launch videos, demonstrations, photography, comparison content, sales collateral and other product communication.
* Ensure sales and customer\-facing teams understand the product, its target customer, competitive advantages and key selling points.
* Plan structured product launches rather than simply making products available for sale, including appropriate digital, social, PR/LinkedIn and channel communication.
* Track early launch performance and quickly identify issues requiring intervention.



  





**2\.Consumer Insights \& Product Opportunities** 



* Regularly
 **talk to consumers,** 
 both existing customers and prospective users, to understand their problems, usage behaviour, purchase decisions, unmet needs and feedback on existing products.
* Use customer conversations, reviews, complaints, search trends, market research, channel feedback and competitive intelligence to identify new product opportunities.
* Spend time with sales teams, retail partners, e\-commerce/category teams and customer experience teams to understand what customers are asking for and where existing products fall short.
* Benchmark competing products across features, pricing, positioning, reviews, communication and customer experience.
* Convert these insights into clear product opportunities and recommendations.
* Evaluate whether an opportunity is worth pursuing based on customer need, market potential, differentiation, pricing, margins and strategic fit.



  





**3\. Product Strategy, Positioning \& Pricing** 



* Define the target customer, use case, value proposition and right\-to\-win for each product.
* Work with Product Development and R\&D teams to translate market and consumer requirements into the right product proposition.
* Develop pricing recommendations based on consumer willingness to pay, competitive benchmarks, product costs, channel economics and target margins.
* Define the positioning of products within the WaterScience portfolio and relative to competitors.
* Ensure that product features are translated into clear and compelling
 **consumer benefits** 
 .



  





**4\. Product Marketing** 



* Own
 **marketing** 
 for the portfolio in partnership with the Marketing team.
* Develop the core consumer proposition, positioning, messaging and communication hierarchy for each product.
* Identify which product benefits and use cases should be communicated to different customer segments.
* Work with Marketing to develop campaigns and content that improve product awareness, consideration and conversion.
* Continuously test and improve product communication based on consumer response and performance.
* Ensure that product messaging remains relevant as competition, customer expectations and the market evolve.
* The Product Manager is not expected to personally execute every marketing activity, but should be able to identify
 **what needs to be communicated, to whom, and why** 
 , and work with the relevant teams to execute it.



  





**5\. Product Performance \& Lifecycle Management** 



* Own periodic performance reviews of products across
 **D2C, Amazon, other marketplaces, retail and direct sales** 
 .
* Track sales, growth, conversion, pricing, margins, ratings, reviews, returns, complaints and other relevant product KPIs.
* Understand performance at a channel level rather than looking only at overall sales.
* Identify why a product is growing or underperforming and recommend specific interventions.
* Work with Category, Marketing and Sales teams on actions such as pricing changes, promotions, bundles, improved content, channel\-specific positioning or campaigns.
* Work with Product Development/R\&D when customer feedback indicates that the physical product itself needs improvement.
* Monitor competitor launches, pricing changes and new propositions and assess their impact on the portfolio.
* Recommend when products should be improved, repositioned, extended with new variants or eventually rationalised.



  





**6\. Continuous Product Improvement** 



* Build a structured feedback loop between
 **customers, CX, sales channels, marketing and Product Development** 
 .
* Analyse customer reviews and complaints to identify recurring product or communication issues.
* Conduct consumer conversations and research to understand the reasons behind quantitative performance data.
* Prioritise improvements based on customer impact, commercial opportunity and implementation effort.
* Drive improvements across the physical product, packaging, pricing, positioning, content and customer experience.
* Follow improvements through to execution and measure whether they actually improved product performance.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 3–6 years of experience in
 **Product Management, Category Management, Product Marketing or a similar commercial product role** 
 .
* **Exceptional communication skills,** 
 able to articulate product ideas, consumer insights and commercial recommendations clearly across teams.
* **Strong attention to detail and aesthetics** 
 , with a high bar for how products, packaging, content and communication are presented to consumers.
* Preferably experience with personal care/consumer durables/home improvement, consumer electronics or similar categories.
* Strong understanding of
 **consumers and consumer behaviour** 
 , with comfort speaking directly to customers and converting qualitative insights into product decisions.
* Experience in product launches, positioning, pricing and go\-to\-market strategy.
* Commercially and analytically strong, comfortable working with sales, pricing, margin, conversion and product\-performance data.
* Comfortable working across Product Development, R\&D, sourcing, marketing, category, sales and CX teams.
* Strong ownership and ability to connect the dots across functions and drive outcomes without waiting for individual tasks to be assigned.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 This role should ultimately be able to answer three questions for every product:
 


* **Why did we launch this product?**
* **How are we going to make it successful?**
* **How is it performing, why is it performing that way, and what are we going to do next?**

title: Product Manager
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
 WisdomAI builds AI\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
   

  

 We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**About WisdomAI**
 WisdomAI is on a mission to make working with data delightful. We empower businesses to unlock insights, drive innovation, and make data\-driven decisions at scale. Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast\-paced, early\-stage startup, currently \~30 people and growing.
   

  

**The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor**
 This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands\-on function built for the age of AI\-native product development. We are a build\-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.
   

  

 At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4\+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
 The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.
   

  

* Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
* Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context.
* Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team.
* Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions.
* Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer\-facing teams.
* Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
* Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM\-first, Design\-first, or Dev\-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform.
* Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals.
* Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch.
* Work effectively in our fast\-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long\-term strategic goals.
* Strategic Communication
* Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization.
* Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value.
* Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process.


**What You'll Bring: Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI\-native platforms.
* Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade\-offs with customers and engineers.
* Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy.
* Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Our CRAFT**
 CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
   

  

**C — Customer trust.** 
 Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
   

  

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** 
 We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
   

  

**A — Authenticity.** 
 We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
   

  

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.**

description:
**Job Purpose**
 To manage the product marketing and product management of the new primary application Air\-GIS insulated switchgear as well as the traditional AIS primary ranges, to ensure customers present and future needs are met profitably and to co\-ordinate product promotion both internally and externally to ensure maximum awareness both in the UK and international markets. Support the global roadmap and strategy for the product range, drive new product development and launches as part of the international team within Lucy Electric.
   

  

**Job Context**
 The primary switchgear range is a new offer central to the continued growth of the Lucy Electric business; the role is critical to the introduction of this offer in the global market. Understanding of regional legislation, markets and applications shall be used to ensure the offer is developed and marketed correctly ensuring successful product launch to the target markets and fully supporting the offer during its lifetime.
   

  

**Job Dimensions**
 The role will be home based / Lucy Electric hybrid office based, visits to Lucy Electric offices, manufacturing units and customers will be required as will supporting exhibitions and events both in the UK and overseas locations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities;
   

  

 Current Offer Management \-
   

  

 Responsible with the Global Head of Product management for the control and management of the current and any future primary application switchgear offers through its lifecycle. This shall also include working with other digital products for integration and co\-ordination of these offers into the offer. This includes being part of the current tender escalation and approval process. Maintenance control and update and issue of all sales and marketing collateral. Creation and maintenance of any standard offer decision trees and management of the implementation into Tacton / configurator tendering tool. Produce up to date collateral to support the sales, technical teams and agents/distributors e.g. brochures, presentations, white papers, technical documentation and ensure the internet and intranet are populated with the up\-to\-date collateral.
   

  

 Sales Support \-
   

  

 Update and support the global sales managers on a regular basis on any offer updates which would affect the technical offer or application. Provision of ad\-hoc support to global sales and tendering functions in the form of technical or application support, review of technical specifications completion of technical schedules and submission of appropriate type test certificates. Creation of any sales specific tools as requested such as white papers, price lists or custom collateral.
   

  

 Customer Support \-
   

  

 Support global sales with direct interaction with their customers where required. This may range from attending meetings to present the offer to delivering specific training sessions to the end users. Attendance at global customer events and exhibition to present the offer shall be required as will support of new product launches.
   

  

 New Product Development (NPD) \-
   

  

 Identifi cation by conducting market research and customer visits to understand the precise needs, challenges and problems faced by our current and future customers. Creating Market Requirement Documents and Special Projects forms for local and global markets and owning the NPD process to ensure products are delivered on time and to budget. Offering continued support to Engineering and sales during the NPD process. Defi ning, leading and owning product road maps globally and locally, working with our global offi ces and agents to understand and interpret our customers’ requirements.
   

  

 Marketing \-
   

  

 Obtain data to analyse and report on the market positioning of the offer within the local and global markets, segments and sectors. Monitoring and interpreting market tends and competitors, analysing any opportunities and threats that may be present. This will include analysing current data for to understand historic trends and using various channels to obtain competitor and market share information. Develop and deploy the marketing strategy for their product ranges to maximise sales.
   

  

 Secondary Activities /Tasks \-
   

  

 Working collaboratively with other Lucy Group business to ensure the full width of wallet is leveraged within the customer segments.
   

  

 To undertake any other duties and responsibilities as required / instructed by your direct line manager.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications, Knowledge And Experience**
 Higher Level qualification in Electronic Engineering or related subject held from an accredited university.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years’ experience around MV transmission or distribution networks.
   

  

 Knowledge of primary application switchgear and associated protection schemes.
   

  

 High level of English (spoken and written).
   

  

**Job Specific Skills**
* Team player, results\-focused, determined, and responsible.
* Ability to manage multiple projects

* Computer literacy.
* Strategic thinking, enthusiastic, able to work under pressure, initiative and strong analytical skill.

title: Fractional Product Manager – D2C
description:
**About EnglishBhashi**
 EnglishBhashi is a product\-led EdTech company building AI\-powered language learning experiences for learners across India. Our mission is to make spoken English learning more personalized, practical, and accessible, particularly for learners from Tier 2, Tier 3, and Tier 4 cities.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Fractional Product Manager** 
 who can take meaningful ownership of our product and growth initiatives and work closely with the Founder and cross\-functional teams to drive measurable outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a
 **high\-ownership, founder\-style product role** 
 .
   

  

 You will work approximately
 **3 hours per day with flexible working hours** 
 . The expectation is not about being available for a fixed number of hours, but about taking ownership of defined product outcomes and consistently moving them forward.
   

  

 You will be expected to think independently, identify opportunities, prioritize ruthlessly, work with data and users, and drive initiatives from:
   

  

**Problem → Insight → Hypothesis → Product → Launch → Measurement → Iteration**
 You will work directly with the Founder and collaborate with Engineering, Design, Content, Marketing, and Community teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy \& Ownership
* Understand EnglishBhashi's product, users, business model, and growth objectives.
* Identify and prioritize the highest\-impact product opportunities.
* Own and continuously improve the product roadmap.
* Define product priorities based on user impact, business value, data, and execution effort.
* Convert ambiguous business problems into clear product opportunities and initiatives.
* Work closely with the Founder on product strategy and important product decisions.
* User Research \& Product Discovery
* Conduct user interviews, usability testing, and qualitative research.
* Develop a deep understanding of our learners, particularly Tier 2/3/4 audiences.
* Analyze user feedback, reviews, support conversations, and behavioral patterns.
* Identify key pain points affecting activation, engagement, learning outcomes, and retention.
* Study competitors and global language\-learning products.
* Convert insights into product hypotheses, requirements, and experiments.
* Product Analytics \& Funnel Optimization
* Own the product funnel across acquisition, onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, and conversion.
* Analyze product behavior using tools such as GA4, Firebase, Amplitude, Mixpanel, and Microsoft Clarity.
* Identify funnel drop\-offs, friction points, and behavioral patterns.
* Build and monitor cohorts and product metrics.
* Define and track product KPIs.
* Use data to identify opportunities and validate product decisions.
* Lifecycle, Engagement \& Retention
* Own product\-led engagement and retention initiatives.
* Design and optimize lifecycle journeys using CleverTap, MoEngage, WebEngage, or similar platforms.
* Build segmentation, push notification, in\-app messaging, and re\-engagement journeys.
* Improve onboarding and activation experiences.
* Develop habit loops around daily learning and practice.
* Experiment with streaks, missions, reminders, rewards, and personalized nudges.
* Continuously work toward improving user retention and engagement.
* Product Execution
* Write PRDs, user stories, feature specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with Engineering and Design to translate ideas into shipped products.
* Support wireframes and prototypes where required.
* Drive execution of prioritized initiatives.
* Participate in QA and release validation.
* Analyze post\-launch performance and determine the next iteration.
* Ensure product initiatives do not stop at launch but are measured against outcomes.
* Growth \& Experimentation
* Identify product\-led growth opportunities.
* Develop hypotheses to improve activation, engagement, retention, and monetization.
* Design and execute product experiments and A/B tests.
* Measure experiment results and document learnings.
* Identify scalable growth loops within the product.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Content, and Community teams to improve the overall user journey.
* Strategic \& Founder Support
* Work directly with the Founder on high\-priority product and growth initiatives.
* Prepare product strategy documents, product briefs, dashboards, and presentations.
* Support investor, grant, accelerator, and strategic documentation when required.
* Bring structured thinking and data\-driven decision\-making to ambiguous problems.


**What We're Looking ForExperience**
* 3–6 years of experience in Product Management, Growth Product, Consumer Apps, UX, MarTech, or a related role.
* Experience owning products, features, funnels, or growth initiatives end\-to\-end.
* Experience working in a startup or fast\-paced product environment is strongly preferred.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* Strong product thinking and ownership mindset.
* Strong understanding of product funnels, activation, engagement, retention, and cohorts.
* Hands\-on experience with GA4, Firebase, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar analytics tools.
* Hands\-on experience with CleverTap, MoEngage, WebEngage, or similar lifecycle engagement platforms.
* Strong understanding of lifecycle marketing, segmentation, automation, and retention.
* Experience writing PRDs, user stories, and product requirements.
* Ability to work effectively with Engineering and Design teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Experience with consumer mobile apps.
* Experience in EdTech, language learning, or AI products.
* Experience working with Tier 2/3/4 Indian audiences.
* Experience with gamification and habit\-forming products.
* Familiarity with Figma, Jira, Notion, or similar tools.
* Understanding of LTV, CAC, conversion, monetization, and growth loops.


 What We Value
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Thinks in terms of outcomes, not tasks.
* Can identify what not to build.
* Is comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
* Uses data but does not ignore qualitative user insights.
* Can move quickly from an idea to an experiment.
* Is comfortable challenging assumptions.
* Can independently drive initiatives from discovery to execution and measurement.
* Enjoys working closely with founders and small, ambitious teams.


 Engagement
   

  

**Fractional \| Approximately 3 hours per day \| Flexible working hours**
 This role is designed for an experienced product professional who wants to contribute meaningfully to a high\-growth startup while maintaining a flexible time commitment.
   

  

 The role offers significant autonomy and ownership, with the opportunity to directly influence
 **EnglishBhashi's product, growth, engagement, and retention strategy** 
 .
   

  

**If you are someone who can bring 3 hours of focused product ownership rather than simply 3 hours of availability, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: Project Engineer – Product Development & Execution
description:
Project Engineer – Product Development \& Execution
 
**(Graduate Engineer Trainee – Program Management)** 



* **Location:** 
 Noida (On\-site)
* **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
* **Experience:** 
 Fresher / 0–1 year
* **Company:** 
 Aereka Airtech Pvt. Ltd.



  




 About AEREKA
 
 AEREKA is building a next\-generation environmental technology platform focused on outdoor and semi\-outdoor air purification, a multidisciplinary deep\-tech product spanning mechanical engineering, airflow and filtration, electronics, sensing, firmware, industrial design, data, AI, manufacturing, and real\-world deployment.
   




 The Role
 
 We're looking for an engineering graduate who wants to sit at the center of a hardware product, build not behind a desk tracking status updates, but in the room where mechanical, electronics, firmware, and manufacturing decisions actually get made. You'll convert ambitious product goals into structured plans, measurable milestones, and executed outcomes working directly with engineers, vendors, and leadership to take AEREKA's product from prototype to real\-world deployment.
 



  





**This is an engineering\-first role.** 
 You don't need to be the expert in every discipline, but you need enough technical grounding from your engineering degree to understand dependencies, ask intelligent questions, and know when an engineering update is real progress versus activity.
 



  




 What You'll Do
 
**Project Planning \& Execution** 



* Convert product and engineering goals into clear milestones, deliverables, timelines, owners, and review checkpoints
* Track multiple engineering workstreams and keep them aligned to overall product milestones
* Identify schedule risks, dependencies, and execution gaps before they become delays



**Cross\-Functional Engineering Coordination** 



* Work closely with mechanical, electronics, firmware, testing, industrial design, AI/software, procurement, and manufacturing teams
* Understand the technical dependencies between workstreams and make sure teams get what they need, when they need it
* Act as the execution bridge between engineering, leadership, vendors, and management



**Project Monitoring \& Reporting** 



* Maintain project plans, milestone trackers, risk registers, and execution dashboards
* Distinguish between activity and actual deliverable completion
* Prepare concise management updates and escalate blockers with clarity



**Meetings, Decisions \& Action Closure** 



* Capture decisions, dependencies, risks, and owner\-wise action items in engineering and product reviews
* Track actions through to closure, not just to "I followed up"



**Vendor \& Manufacturing Coordination** 



* Coordinate with fabricators, manufacturers, testing partners, and suppliers
* Track quotations, procurement timelines, and deliveries; flag vendor risks early



**AI\-First Execution** 
 You'll use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and automation tools as everyday working tools to plan faster, turn meetings into structured actions, build dashboards, and improve your own and your team's execution speed. We're looking for someone who uses AI to think and execute better, not just to generate documents.
   




 Who Should Apply
 
**Mandatory \- Engineering Degree:** 




 B.Tech / B.E. in one of:
 


* Mechanical Engineering
* Mechatronics
* Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)
* Electrical Engineering
* Instrumentation
* Robotics \& Automation
* Industrial / Manufacturing Engineering
* (or another closely related core engineering discipline)



**A strong plus, not required:** 




 An MBA / PGDM in Operations, Project Management, Technology Management, or a related field. Candidates without an MBA but with strong execution ability, technical curiosity, and a genuine interest in product/program management are equally encouraged to apply.
 



**Experience:** 
 Fresh graduates or up to 1 year of relevant experience.
   




 What We Look For
 * **Structured thinking** 
 — you can turn an ambiguous problem into clear tasks, priorities, and owners
* **Ownership** 
 — you care whether the outcome actually happened, not just whether you followed up
* **Technical curiosity** 
 — you enjoy understanding how physical products actually work
* **Analytical ability** 
 — comfortable with schedules, metrics, spreadsheets, dashboards
* **Communication** 
 — clear with engineers, vendors, and leadership alike
* **Bias for action** 
 — you drive what needs to happen next rather than waiting to be told
* **AI\-first mindset** 
 — you actively use AI/automation tools to move faster


 What You'll Gain
 
 Direct exposure to deep\-tech hardware product development end to end: prototype design and validation, manufacturing and vendor ecosystems, testing, AI\-enabled project management, and founder\-level decision\-making — building toward a career as a Project Manager, Program Manager, or technology\-business leader.
   




 Apply
 
 Apply through LinkedIn or send your resume to
 **sushil@aereka.com** 
 with the subject line:
 **"Application – Project Engineer (Product Development) – AEREKA"**

title: Scrum Master/Project Manager
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As PM / Scrum Master for Digital Finance, you sit at the intersection of delivery and transformation. You keep agile teams focused, unblocked, and moving — while ensuring that the digitalization projects you oversee are grounded in real finance processes and tied to tangible business outcomes. Your day spans sprint ceremonies, dependency tracking, stakeholder updates, and close collaboration with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Data \& AI/ML Engineers, BI developers, and finance leads across TI’s business units.
   

  

 How You’ll Make an Impact
   

  

* Drive Agile Delivery
+ Facilitate sprint ceremonies — stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives — to ensure effective team collaboration and continuous improvement.
+ Use agile methods to project manage multiple digitalization initiatives simultaneously, maintaining pace and quality across the portfolio.
+ Support teams in keeping project planning tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) up to date — monitoring engagement, status accuracy, and documentation completeness.

* Remove Impediments and Manage Dependencies
+ Proactively identify and remove obstacles that hinder team progress, ensuring smooth workflow and on\-time delivery of project milestones.
+ Identify, track, and manage cross\-team dependencies — communicating potential impacts on timelines early and facilitating alignment on priorities and responsibilities.

* Lead Projects End to End
+ Act as project lead for digitalization initiatives within TI, owning scope definition, milestone planning, and delivery accountability.
+ Support project scope definition, schedule, tasks, and objectives — translating business requirements from the finance domain into structured, executable delivery plans.
+ Enforce strong project governance and delivery discipline (e.g., release frameworks, product lifecycle), ensuring clarity of requirements and preventing scope creep.
+ Drive cross\-functional, interdisciplinary teams across business units, keeping diverse stakeholders aligned and accountable.

* Engage Stakeholders and Support Change
+ Build and maintain effective working relationships with business communities, understanding their operational and informational needs.
+ Provide clear, timely reporting on project status, budget impacts, and objective progress to management and business units.
+ Support change management associated with digital transformation — ensuring teams are prepared and equipped to adopt new processes and technologies.
+ Act as a role model for the digital finance transformation, embodying agile ways of working and a continuous improvement mindset.


 What You Bring
   

  

* Expert\-level project management skills across both agile and classic methodologies, with hands\-on experience running Scrum ceremonies and managing delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Solid understanding of finance processes — record to report, purchase to pay, order to cash — sufficient to engage credibly with finance stakeholders and translate their needs into delivery requirements.
* Working familiarity with enterprise tools such as Alteryx, SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Tableau, Snowflake, Jira, or Confluence — enough to support teams without being the technical expert in the room.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills — results\-oriented, empathic, and effective as both sender and receiver of complex, multi\-stakeholder information.
* Formal certification in Scrum (e.g., CSM, PSM) or project management (e.g., PMP); university degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Proficiency in English.


**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* All employees are automatically covered under the Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay on a monthly basis.

title: Technical Implementation Consultant
description:
**Strength in Trust**
 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

**The Challenge**
 Due to rapid growth and an increased demand for our platform, OneTrust is seeking a
 **Technical Implementation Consultant** 
 . The Technical Implementation Consultant role is one of the key pieces of the OneTrust architecture. After the sales process, consultants are the key contact in driving and building the relationship, implementing the solution and managing the expectations of the customer. Technical Implementation Consultants work across the technical modules. As a Technical Implementation Consultant, you will be responsible for the customer relationship and will work directly with our customers to enhance their overall user experience with the OneTrust platform. The role is one of the most important as it is the bridge between OneTrust and the customer, helping the business grow by identifying product enhancements and relaying them between the customer and OneTrust Product teams.
   

  

**Your Mission**
**As a Technical Implementation Consultant, You Will**
* Own end\-to\-end technical implementation and support customer adoption from kick\-off through go\-live.
* Monitor and analyze the customer’s adoption of our solution features and functionality in order to provide leadership with an understanding of their overall business needs as they relate to our products and improve value realised.
* Provide assurance and oversight to customers implementing OneTrust’s platform regarding SaaS implementations including underlying hardware and software architectures.
* Triage, prioritise, and drive resolution for escalated technical issues.
* Proactively identify, assess, and communicate project risks, including but not limited to delivery timelines, scope changes, customer engagement, and technical constraints.
* Use your experience across a broad range of core technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript and APIs.
* Complete internal and project documentation (including configuration logs and functional specifications).
* Seek opportunities in day\-to\-day workflow to improve quality and efficiency from ideation to deployment.
* Document processes and workflows in shareable documents for future use and adoption.
* Work closely with UI/UX design, marketing, product management and engineering on project goals and requirements
* Be an advocate for our customers by representing their issues to Product Management and Software Engineering with a focus on steering the OneTrust roadmap.
* Provide strategic and tactical support for Sales, Professional Services, and Business Development.


 You will also act as system and regulatory best practice expert, drawing from a plethora of consulting experience to advise customers on optimization of privacy program. Act as the customer advocate. Seamlessly transition ownership and action plan back to involved teams. Show ownership of issues, engage customers, establish urgent priorities and implement resolution plan. Able to resolve simple to moderate issues with minimal management intervention. Ability to interpret and deliver on custom SOW customer projects.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Also**
* Demonstrate strong tech awareness and problem\-solving by gathering client requirements and delivering system\-based solutions.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to stakeholders, taking a consultative approach to client engagements.
* Apply prior SaaS implementation experience to drive successful outcomes.
* Demonstrate independent, professional communication tailored to audience expertise; participate in discovery discussions and deliver presentations during project meetings.
* Understand and proactively manage project timelines, scope, and dependencies; consistently deliver implementation tasks on time with high quality.


**You Are**
* A coachable and organized individual with strong communication and critical thinking skills who can understand the needs of the clients and navigate them to success.
* Able to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team environment.
* Willing to travel 10 – 20%.


**Your Experience Includes**
* BA/BS OR MS in Computer Science, Electrical OR Computer Engineering, Web Design/Development, Engineering Management or Information Technology/Systems, with 2\-5 years of relevant experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, technical consulting or advanced degree in relevant field
* Experience working with HTTP, SSO, SSL certificates, networking, and API integrations
* Experience working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python
* Familiarity with Jira/Atlassian Suite
* Exposure to other systems such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe, Eloqua, and Marketo, ServiceNow
* Effective customer\-facing relationship building skills. Proven success in and genuine enthusiasm for working directly with customer(s)
* Proven ability to engage across corporate functions (Sales, Professional Services, Support, Customer Success and Product Management)
* Previous end\-to\-end implementation experience, ideally on a SAAS platform/product
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to chair meetings or host webinars
* Strategic and critical thinking, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities
* Ability to build relationships across stakeholders in marketing, sales, and engineering
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Strong entrepreneurial skills to excel in a complex and rapidly evolving SAAS environment
* Working knowledge of implementation practices including configuration, testing, and deployment processes


 Where we Work
   

  

 We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
   

  

 Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
   

  

**Benefits**
 As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
   

  

 Resources
   

  

 Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
   

  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram


 Your Data
   

  

 You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
 **.** 
 You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
   

  

 Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
   

  

**Our Commitment to You**
 When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
   

  

 OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Project Manager, Education Team (Full time, 1-year contract)
description:
**Join The Team Redefining How The World Experiences Design.**
 Hey, g'day, namaste, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
   

  

 Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.
   

  

**Where And How You Can Work**
 The Project Manager is expected to operate from the education department office of the State and provide support for Canva Education initiatives.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Canva Education team in India is a mission\-driven group working to embed creativity, collaboration, and visual communication across classrooms nationwide. We actively partner with state governments, national\-level education bodies, and large private school networks to scale Canva Education as a safe, inclusive, and impactful teaching and learning platform.
   

  

 Our team brings deep expertise across education policy, teacher training, and edtech implementation—aligning Canva’s global mission with India’s priorities such as NEP 2020, foundational learning, multilingual classrooms, and digital equity. Whether it’s a district in rural Tamil Nadu or a private school in Delhi, we’re working to ensure that every educator and student can design and learn with confidence.
   

  

**Job Description**
 What you’d be doing in this role
   

  

 We are seeking a passionate and proactive Project Manager to support the implementation and scaling of Canva Education across Government and private school systems in Andhra Pradesh. The team member will be based at the Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) office in Vijayawada, contributing to the Project Management Unit (PMU).This role will act as a local anchor for our state\-level initiatives, helping drive teacher adoption, support partnership initiatives, and ensure alignment with educational priorities including the National Education Policy 2020\.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of education, technology, and system change — bringing creativity, collaboration, and equity into classrooms at scale.
   

  

 At the moment, this role is focused on:
   

  

* Coordinate and support the execution of Canva Education programs in partnership with the State Government, SCERTs, teacher training institutions, and local NGOs.
* Serve as a key point of contact for field\-level stakeholders including school administrators, DIETs, CRCs/BRCs, and master trainers.
* Support planning and delivery of training programs for teachers, administrators, and implementation partners.
* Collaborate with internal Canva teams (Partnerships, Product, Community, Data) to ensure smooth implementation and troubleshooting of product rollouts.
* Track and report on adoption metrics, success stories, and program impact at the ground level.
* Coordinate localization of content, resources, and communication to ensure cultural and linguistic relevance.
* Identify risks and implementation challenges early and flag them with mitigation plans.
* Support day\-to\-day coordination with state education departments and facilitate reviews, updates, and planning meetings.


**Qualifications**
 You're probably a match if you
   

  

* Have at least 3 years of experience in the K\-12 education field, especially with government schools or large\-scale programs.
* Experience in coordinating or running edtech programs through NGOs, CSR, EdTech organizations, or government partnerships.
* A strong grasp of the National Education Policy (NEP 2020\), particularly in digital education, foundational learning, and teacher capacity building.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Telugu — both spoken and written.
* Proven ability to work in dynamic, cross\-functional, and remote teams.
* Comfortable juggling multiple stakeholders and timelines.
* Organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive with a knack for solving problems.
* Adaptable and creative, comfortable with uncertainty, and eager to learn, grow, and innovate.
* Quickly build trust by showing integrity, credibility, and consistency in every interaction.
* Show grit and resilience — you're resourceful, proactive, and action\-focused.
* Stay humble, open to feedback, and always looking for ways to improve.


**Additional Information**
 Other stuff to know
   

  

 We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.
   

  

 We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above \- we still want to hear from you!
   

  

 Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

**About the Role**
 We’re looking for a passionate and driven Design Intern to join our Product Design team in Bangalore for a 6\-month immersive experience. This is a hands\-on role where you’ll work as a full member of the team, contributing to real\-world projects that ship to external users. You’ll collaborate cross\-functionally, learn from experienced designers, and help shape the culture and processes of our growing design organization.
   

 What You’ll Do
 


* **Design and Ship:** 
 Work on end\-to\-end design projects — from research and ideation to prototyping and final delivery — that will be released to real users.
* **Collaborate:** 
 Partner with product managers, engineers, and other designers to solve user problems and create intuitive, delightful experiences.
* **Learn and Grow:** 
 Receive mentorship and feedback from other designers, participate in design critiques, and gain exposure to the full product development lifecycle.
* **Contribute to Culture:** 
 Help evolve our design rituals, tools, and team culture. Your fresh perspective will be valued and encouraged.
* **Own Your Impact:** 
 Take initiative, bring ideas to the table, and see your work make a tangible difference.

* Experience with user research or usability testing.
* Interest in product strategy or design systems.

**What You’ll Gain** 



* Real\-world experience shipping products to users.
* Mentorship from experienced design and product leaders.
* A strong foundation in product design processes and team collaboration.
* A chance to leave your mark on a growing design team.



**Work from office expectations:**
