**Diversity \& Inclusion** 
   
 



 At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a truly world\-class product and experience, we are also intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We’re focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day.  
 



 We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams and individual team members.  project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!  
 



 For any needed accommodations during the hiring process, please email recruiting@project44\.com. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.
 



**About project44** 
   
 



 Since 2014, project44 has been transforming the way one of the largest, most important global industries does business. In just a few short years, we’ve created a digital infrastructure that eliminates the inefficiencies caused by dated technology and manual processes. title: Frontend Developer Intern
description:
**About the job** 




 We’re looking for a Frontend Developer Intern to join our engineering team at Credes — someone who can build clean, responsive, scalable interfaces across web and mobile, understands UI systems beyond just individual components, and works effectively with AI\-assisted development tools.
 



  





***This is a paid, completely remote internship with real stakes.***



* Stipend: ₹15,000 per month
* Location: Completely Remote
* Duration: 3 months or 6 months
* Eligibility: Must be located in India



  





 You won’t be building static UI screens. You’ll be working on production\-grade web and mobile applications — handling real user flows, state management, performance constraints, and integrations with live backend systems. If you have strong fundamentals in React\-based frontend development and 2–3 projects you’ve actually shipped, we want to talk. Experience with Flutter or React Native is a strong advantage. If you don’t have experience with either, you’ll be expected to learn them as required during the internship.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Build responsive, scalable web interfaces using React\-based frameworks (Next.js preferred)
* Develop cross\-platform mobile applications using React Native or Flutter
* Learn and adapt to React Native or Flutter when required by the project
* Implement clean, reusable UI components and design systems
* Manage application state effectively (context, Redux, Zustand, Riverpod, etc.)
* Integrate frontend with backend APIs (REST / GraphQL)
* Handle performance optimisation (rendering, lazy loading, state updates)
* Ensure consistency across devices, screen sizes, and platforms
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) — while validating outputs critically
* Debug UI issues, edge cases, and cross\-platform inconsistencies
* Collaborate closely with backend, design, and product teams



  





**Must\-have qualifications** 



* Strong proficiency in React\-based frontend frameworks (Next.js / React)
* 2–3 deployed projects (web or mobile) with real users and functional flows
* Solid understanding of frontend architecture — component structure, state management, data flow
* Strong Data Structures \& Algorithms (DSA) foundation applied to UI logic and performance (render optimisation, state updates, list handling)
* Demonstrable depth in AI\-assisted development — ability to validate, debug, and refine AI\-generated UI/code
* Strong understanding of API integration and async data handling
* Must be located in India



  





**Preferred qualifications** 



* Experience with Next.js (SSR/SSG, routing, performance optimisation)
* Familiarity with state management tools (Redux, Zustand, Riverpod, Bloc, etc.)
* Experience with React Native (bonus — significantly improves selection chances)
* Strong understanding of responsive design and cross\-platform UI consistency
* Experience with design systems / component libraries
* Familiarity with performance optimisation (memoization, lazy loading, reducing re\-renders)
* Experience handling forms, validation, and complex UI states
* Exposure to animations and micro\-interactions
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs or SDKs
* Familiarity with deployment workflows (Vercel, Firebase, Play Store builds, etc.)



  





**How We Evaluate Candidates** 




*We do not evaluate candidates based on resumes alone.* 




 You will be evaluated on:
 


* How you structure UI and manage complexity
* How you handle state and performance
* How you integrate and handle real data
* How deeply you understand the tools you use (including AI)
* The quality and completeness of the projects you have actually built



 If your experience is limited to static UI clones or tutorial\-based apps, this role will not be a fit.
 



  





**Important: Working Projects Are Mandatory** 




 Your resume must include working, deployed projects.
 



 Anyone without a working project or without a working link to their project will not be considered for this job application. GitHub repositories without a working demo are not valid submissions and will not be considered. To have a better chance of being selected, please add your working projects directly in the application questions and/or in your resume as direct hyperlinks.
 



 Make sure all submitted links are publicly accessible and working before applying.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Apply via LinkedIn or email:
 



 careers@credes.in
 



*Subject: Frontend Developer Intern — \[Your Name]* 




 Please include:
 


* Links to deployed projects (mandatory)
* GitHub profile
* Resume / LinkedIn



***Applications without deployed, working project links will not be reviewed.***

title: Research Associate - Gas and LNG

 Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector\-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.
   

  

 This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.
   

  

 Wood Mackenzie
   

  

 Intelligence Connected
   

  

**WoodMac.com**
**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**
**Wood Mackenzie Values**
* Inclusive – we succeed together

* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action


 We monitor key events and conduct research to produce thought\-provoking reports, data models, and presentations. From asset valuation to corporate reports, from market supply\-demand research to price\-forecasting, and from the regional to the global, our analysis helps shape our customers’ commercial strategies.
   

  

 We also support bespoke consulting projects, diving deeper into our data to answer unique questions. We help our Sales team retain and win new business by spending time with customers and answering questions that matter to them. We work closely with colleagues in our Data and Product functions to maintain the quality of our published data and to deliver content via our
 **growing Lens platform** 
**.**
 Through carrying out primary research, responding to customer questions, and presenting to industry stakeholders, you will build relationships and a network of contacts at key operators, national bodies, and other relevant institutions. Over time you will gain specialist knowledge and develop the skills you require to progress your career at Wood Mackenzie.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Research Associate to join our LNG assets team, within our Gas \& LNG research practice.
   

  

 You will have responsibility for tracking the development of the Woodmac view, specifically related to LNG asset developments in Europe, Africa, Russia, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. This includes understanding and updating information on LNG regas projects, LNG supply projects, LNG contracts and LNG shipping.
   

  

 You will need to be capable of operating autonomously but you will also require strong collaborative skills, as you will work with the regional gas markets and upstream teams on a variety of topics. You will create innovative reports, develop visualizations of our data sets and communicate our views to clients.
   

  

 You will be a contributor to the update of our global LNG outlook and help develop our views on key LNG market trends. You will become comfortable articulating the supply and demand views and the broader short\-term and long\-term LNG outlook to clients and prospects. You will also support the creation of datasets for our Global Gas Model product and build scenarios of how the future LNG market will evolve.
   

  

 Through research trips, client interactions and industry events you will build your network to understand the key topics and challenges in the industry. You will address these in your contribution to our regular deliverables and through development of specific informs, insights and webinars.
   

  

 You will have relevant experience, skills and knowledge that you can apply to the role, allowing you to contribute to our research from day one. As you develop your career, you will strengthen a broad range of skills, including data, market expertise, and client interactions, in a fast\-paced environment. You will contribute to complex and high\-quality analysis and modelling, write market reports, and actively engage with customers. You will work closely with and learn from experienced regional analysts in various locations.
   

  

 This is a full\-time Research Associate role, based in Gurugram OR Mumbai, India.
   

  

 Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the sectors we cover and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie.
   

  

**General Core Capabilities**
* Research and data gathering – we identify and gather intelligence that feeds our industry expertise. We need inquisitive and passionate people with a keen eye for detail.
* Analysis \- we provide market\-leading research using this data/intelligence and form opinions for, and tell stories to, our customers. We need people with natural curiosity with potential to become experts in their field, and with the ability to articulate – both verbally and in writing – clear, insightful analysis.
* Internal engagement – we work with colleagues across the Wood Mackenzie business to deliver a compelling, integrated view of the natural resources sector to customers through our cutting\-edge products. For this, we need people who are as comfortable working collaboratively as they are independently and who have excellent interpersonal skills.
* External engagement – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand. This requires people with the potential to become industry experts who have intellectual curiosity, passion, and excellent presentation skills.
* Continuous improvement – at Wood Mackenzie, we are committed to transform the way we power our planet. The energy transition is here and this impacts our customer base and how we serve them. We need colleagues with a change mindset, who are flexible, growth\-orientated and proactive.


**Specific Role Requirements**
* Build and develop high\-quality research on the short\-term LNG market, with a focus on demand and shipping.
* Forecast monthly gas and LNG demand for various countries, run complex models and ensure our view remains robust, up\-to\-date, and consistent.
* Participate in the creation of new demand models.
* Run our shipping models and drive enhancements to our methodologies.

title: HR Manager (HR & Administration)
description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Pirgal Consulting Private Limited is a multidisciplinary consulting company based in Bangalore. We provide allied and support services across accounting and finance, direct and indirect taxation, GST and tax litigation support, legal and regulatory compliance, construction and real estate. We work alongside Chartered Accountants, Advocates and other practising professionals, supporting them and their clients on live matters — which means our teams build technical depth across several disciplines rather than within a single vertical.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for one person to own HR and administration end to end for the Company and its group entities — hiring, onboarding, records, payroll inputs, policy, statutory compliance and office administration. You will not be inheriting a large team or a mature system; you will be building and running it, with direct access to the management. This suits an HR generalist who is tired of owning one slice of the function and wants the whole of it.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own the full recruitment cycle — requisition, job descriptions, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer roll\-out and joining — across professional, support and intern roles.
* Manage and grow our sourcing channels: LinkedIn, WorkIndia, Indeed, Internshala, consultants, referrals, and campus relationships with law, engineering, commerce and management institutions in Bangalore.
* Run campus outreach and internship drives — placement\-cell relationships, drive scheduling, intern selection and conversion to full\-time roles.
* Handle onboarding and induction end to end: documentation, background verification, offer and appointment letters, asset handover, and orientation on firm policy.
* Maintain employee records and the HR MIS, and keep the salary register and attendance and leave data accurate and current.
* Administer GreytHR — attendance, leave, employee master, payroll inputs — and drive its adoption across the group.
* Prepare monthly payroll inputs, coordinate with the accounts team on salary processing, and support statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT and related filings) with our consultants.
* Draft, implement and maintain HR policy and SOPs — code of conduct, leave policy, POSH, appraisal framework, offboarding — and enforce them consistently.
* Run the performance and appraisal cycle, coordinate training programmes, and handle employee relations, grievances and disciplinary matters with discretion.
* Manage offboarding: resignation processing, exit interviews, full and final settlement coordination, relieving and experience letters.
* Own office administration — vendors, AMCs, assets, facilities, travel, housekeeping and general upkeep of the premises.
* Report to the Directors on headcount, hiring pipeline, attrition, payroll cost and HR MIS every month.

**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS**

* Proven experience running HR end to end single\-handedly — hiring, records, payroll inputs, compliance and admin.
* Practical knowledge of Indian labour and statutory requirements: PF, ESI, PT, gratuity, POSH.
* Hands\-on recruitment ability. You will be sourcing and screening yourself, not delegating it.
* Strong MS Excel and reporting skills; experience with GreytHR or a comparable HRMS is a strong advantage.
* Excellent communication and the maturity to hold confidential information and to have difficult conversations.
* Fluency in Kannada and English required; Hindi is an advantage.
* Prior experience in a consulting or professional services environment is preferred.
* Comfortable being the sole HR presence for a growing multi\-entity group.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Complete ownership of the function, reporting directly to the Directors.
* The opportunity to build systems and policy from the ground up rather than administer someone else's.
* Exposure across multiple group entities in consulting, construction and real estate.
* Scope to build a team under you as the group grows.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your CV to **hr@pirgal.com**, with a copy to **sahana@pirgal.com**, using the subject line **“Application – HR Manager (HR \& Administration)”**.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

title: Finance Data Analyst (MIS & Reporting)
description:
##### **About Headphone Zone**


We don’t run Headphone Zone like a company. We run it like a community — of people who care deeply about helping others rediscover music. We’re proud to be a 100% independent, Indian\-owned business, committed to bringing the world’s finest headphones and audio gear to discerning listeners across the country.


We choose to be the best, not the biggest. We serve our customers with the same level of care, respect, and attention we’d want for ourselves — guided by a simple ethos: **we’re ladies and gentlemen, serving ladies and gentlemen**. And above all, while we are not a music company, music is at the core of everything we do.

##### **About the Role**


As a Finance Data Analyst at Headphone Zone, you’ll turn financial data into insights — helping us run a healthy, profitable, and sustainable business.


You’ll work closely with our Finance and Operations teams — building reports, automating dashboards, analysing trends, and supporting better decision\-making across the company.

##### **Why This Role Matters**


We take pride in being an independent, self\-funded business. But staying that way requires sharp financial discipline and data\-driven decisions.


Your work will help us manage cash flow, optimise margins, control costs, and guide how we grow — so we can serve more music lovers, while staying true to our values.

##### **What You’ll Do**

* Collect, analyse, and interpret financial data to generate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports
* Build dashboards and financial models to support leadership decision\-making
* Maintain and update financial databases, ensuring data accuracy and consistency
* Automate financial reporting processes using Excel, Power BI, or SQL
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes
* Identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights to drive business performance
* Collaborate with Finance, Operations, and other teams to streamline reporting and data flow
* Monitor key financial metrics — revenue, margins, costs, profitability, working capital, and cash flow health

##### **What We’re Looking For**

* **Freshers are welcome** — we love hiring proactive freshers! Or even better, 1–2 years of experience in finance, MIS, or data analysis
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to turn financial data into clear, actionable insights — and communicate them well
* Proficiency in **MS Excel** (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Macros)
* Familiarity with tools like SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar (nice to have)
* A mindset aligned with our values: doing it the right way, not the easy way; always learning and improving; taking ownership and responsibility; understanding that growth lies in discomfort; serving with grace and respect
* Curiosity about how finance drives business performance
* Based in Mumbai — this is a **full\-time, in\-office** role at our HQ in **Andheri West**

##### **Cultural Fit**


Headphone Zone is a place for people who want to do great work — the right way, not the easy way. We believe in showing up every day with curiosity, ownership, and a commitment to getting better. Titles and ladders don’t matter here; how you think, learn, and contribute does.


You’ll fit right in if you care about craft, take responsibility for your own growth, and thrive in an environment that’s fast, unstructured, and a little chaotic (in the best way). Most of all, we’re here to help people rediscover music — and everything we do comes from that purpose.

##### **Why Join Us?**


At Headphone Zone, you’ll be part of a small, passionate team that takes pride in doing things differently. We believe in craft, community, and curiosity — and we’re here to serve, not to sell. You’ll have the freedom to own your work, learn constantly, and contribute to a team that values quality over scale.


If you believe in treating customers with grace and respect, care about helping people experience music more deeply, and thrive in a culture built on trust and hustle — you’ll love it here.

##### **How to Apply**


If this sounds like your kind of role, hit 'Apply' — we’d love to hear from you.

title: SEO & AI-Powered Market Research Analyst
description:
SEO \& AI Market Research Analyst

**TechSmew Innovations Pvt. Ltd.**  
**Chennai \| Work From Office \| Full\-Time \| 0–3 Years**

About the Role

TechSmew Innovations is building **agentic\-AI products and platforms**. We are looking for a **highly curious, proactive and research\-driven SEO \& Market Research Analyst** who enjoys discovering opportunities through **research, search, data, competitors, AI and experimentation**.

This is **not a routine SEO execution or data\-entry role**.

We want someone who naturally asks questions, investigates deeply, discovers things others may miss and converts discoveries into **insights, leads and business value**.

What You'll Do

* Continuously **research and discover** new opportunities across SEO, markets, competitors, customers and growth.
* Conduct **keyword, SEO, market and competitor research** across Google, Bing, AI search and other platforms.
* Discover high\-value, emerging, untapped and commercially relevant keywords.
* Analyze competitor rankings, content, positioning, strategies, gaps and opportunities.
* Monitor competitor **high\-budget advertising and paid campaigns** to understand their messaging, offers, keywords, market focus and commercial intent.
* Research and discover **potential companies, prospects, decision\-makers and leads**.
* Validate, enrich and organize lead information using research and prospecting tools.
* Maintain research findings, lead information, activities and follow\-ups in **CRM systems**.
* Use **AI tools and AI agents** for research, competitor intelligence, lead discovery, analysis, monitoring and automation.
* Experiment with new AI\-powered workflows and continuously find better ways to perform research.
* Convert research into **numbers, insights, recommendations, leads and actionable opportunities**.
* Proactively identify what should be investigated next rather than waiting for instructions.

The Mindset We Want

**Discovery is the most important part of this role.**

We want someone who naturally thinks:

* **Why is this happening?**
* **How did they achieve this?**
* **What are competitors doing?**
* **What are they missing?**
* **What are we missing?**
* **What else can I discover?**
* **What is the opportunity?**
* **What evidence do we have?**
* **What is the potential value?**
* **Can AI help me investigate this at scale?**
* **What should we do next?**

You should be comfortable going **beyond the original task** and bringing back useful discoveries that nobody specifically asked you to find.

What We Look For

* Excellent **research and internet\-searching ability**.
* Strong **curiosity, questioning and investigative mindset**.
* Strong **discovery\-oriented personality**.
* Numbers\- and evidence\-driven thinking.
* Ability to identify patterns, connect information and form useful insights.
* Thinks about **value, impact and business outcomes**, not just activity.
* Highly proactive and self\-driven.
* Good written and verbal **communication skills**.
* Basic understanding of SEO, search engines and digital marketing.
* Interested in **AI, AI agents and agentic systems**.
* Willing and excited to **learn new tools, technologies and methods continuously**.
* Comfortable learning and working with **lead\-generation and CRM tools**.
* Fast learner who adapts quickly to changing technology.

AI, Tools \& Learning

You do **not** need to already know every tool.

We care more about your **ability and willingness to learn**.

You may work with tools across:

**SEO \& Search:** Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, Google Trends  
**Analytics \& Data:** Google Analytics, Excel, Google Sheets  
**Lead Research:** LinkedIn, prospecting and enrichment platforms  
**CRM:** HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce and similar platforms  
**AI:** ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and AI agents  
**Automation:** n8n, Make, Zapier and similar platforms

**If you don't know a tool today, that's completely fine. We expect you to learn it when the work requires it.**

Agentic\-AI Environment

TechSmew is working towards **agentic products and platforms**.

You will work in an environment where we continuously explore:

**AI Agents → Research → Discovery → Analysis → Lead Generation → CRM → Monitoring → Automation → Insights**

You don't need to be an AI engineer.

You need to be **AI\-curious, adaptable and excited to experiment and learn**.

What Success Looks Like

We don't want someone who simply says:

“Competitor X is running ads.”

We want someone who says:

“I investigated Competitor X, found what they are investing in, identified the market and keyword patterns, compared their positioning with ours, discovered an opportunity, quantified what I could, and recommend what we should investigate or do next.”

The ideal person regularly comes back with:

**“I found something interesting.”**

Selection Process

Candidates will complete a practical **research \& discovery exercise** to evaluate:

**Research \| Questioning \| Discovery \| SEO \| Competitor Intelligence \| Paid Ads \| Lead Discovery \| CRM Thinking \| Numbers \| AI Usage \| Communication**

Experience

**0–3 Years**

Freshers are welcome if they demonstrate exceptional **research ability, curiosity, questioning, communication and willingness to learn**.

Core Principle

**Don't just execute tasks.**

**Research deeply. Ask better questions. Discover opportunities. Use AI. Find leads. Create insights. Add measurable value.**

**Location: Chennai – Work From Office**

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

title: AI Business Analyst
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Crowe's AI Y\-Hire practice moves from foundational skills — requirements support, artifact creation, learning the craft — toward independent ownership of complex engagements. The AI Business Analyst operates at an experienced level, applying established business analysis skills across complex engagements while leveraging AI\-enabled ways of working.
   

  

 At the entry level, a BA supports elicitation, assists with testing, and follows established standards. At this level, you lead elicitation, own testing programs, and extend standards to account for what AI\-augmented delivery requires. This role expands traditional business analysis responsibilities by incorporating AI\-enabled analysis, documentation, and delivery practices. In this role, you will facilitate workshops, synthesize information using AI\-enabled tools, and translate insights into actionable deliverables that support project outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The AI Business Analyst at Crowe translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements for AI solutions, automation platforms, and development teams. This means applying business analysis fundamentals — elicitation, documentation, testing — through an AI\-first operating model.
   

  

 You will use Gen AI tools including Claude Code as active instruments of analysis: interrogating process mining output to draft automation opportunity backlogs, generating first\-pass test plans from acceptance criteria, and using LLM analysis to surface requirement gaps before they reach development. You will be responsible for delivering high\-quality work products from discovery through user acceptance testing and implementation readiness.
   

  

 Operating from India, you will work in close partnership with US\-based teams across client engagements in process optimization, Hyperautomation, and Gen AI solution delivery.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Discovery \& Analysis**
* Lead structured discovery workshops with client stakeholders — using AI tools in session to capture, synthesize, and reflect back current\-state processes, pain points, and desired outcomes in real time; produce structured outputs before the debrief.
* Conduct process and task mining analysis using Microsoft Process Mining, Celonis, or equivalent platforms to surface high\-ROI automation opportunities; translate event\-log insights into prioritized opportunity backlogs with quantified business impact.
* Analyze UX feedback, job aids, procedures, and existing process maps to identify candidates for further optimization; summarize findings and present recommendations with supporting data.
* Proactively identify, analyze, and resolve requirement risks, gaps, and ambiguities — using LLM\-assisted cross\-reference of documentation to catch inconsistencies before they reach development; partner with stakeholders to resolve issues and appropriately escalate matters when additional guidance or decisions are required.


**Requirements \& Solution Design**
* Elicit and document business, user, functional, and non\-functional requirements with sufficient detail to support effective implementation of AI\-enabled and traditional technology solutions — including decision logic, tool invocations, exception handling, and appropriate human review and oversight checkpoints.
* Translate requirements into the full artifact set: user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, wireframes, data models, swimlane diagrams, and state diagrams — using AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate first\-draft creation and human judgment to validate and refine.
* Design Target Operating Models that show how people, AI agents, and automated processes interact in the future state — including role evolution, governance guardrails, and escalation paths that keep humans accountable for outcomes.

title: Data Analyst (Python + SQL / Power BI)
description:
**About us** 




 At Awesome Analytics, we are not just a company; we are a community of data enthusiasts, problem solvers and innovators. Our mission is to empower organizations with data\-driven insights that transform how they make decisions. As a remote\-first data analytics company based in India, we have redefined the way we work to make data analytics accessible and enjoyable for the people who build it.
 



  





 Our mission: automate your work, and elevate your life.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We build reporting, dashboarding, and AI\-driven automation solutions for enterprise clients across top industries including FMCG, finance, and retail: MIS reports, Power BI dashboards, data models, and process automation built with Excel, Python and ETL tools. A typical engagement means taking a client’s raw, messy data, building the model and the pipeline behind it, and shipping a dashboard or an automated report they rely on every week. You will own this end to end: the extraction, the model, the automation, the validation and the final report or dashboard. This is a build\-and\-think role.
 



  





**How we work, and what we are really hiring for** 




 Our delivery is AI\-assisted. Your effort concentrates on the data model, on reviewing what the tools produce, on edge cases, on data quality, and on getting a report or a dashboard genuinely production\-ready for a client.
 



  





 We want someone who is genuinely fast with AI\-assisted tools \- Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Copilot in Power BI and Fabric \- for writing SQL, DAX, and Python, and equally rigorous about checking what they produce before it reaches a client. If that is already how you work, you will fit right in.
 



  





 One line worth saying plainly, because it is the part of AI\-assisted work that goes wrong quietly: we use AI on the logic, not on client data. Schemas, structures, and sample shapes go into a tool; client rows and personal data do not. You will be expected to know the difference and to hold that line without being asked.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Translate client requirements into specific reports, dashboards or automation specs.
* Independently develop reports, dashboards and automation using Power BI, Excel and Python.
* Design data models and build the pipeline behind a dashboard: extraction and ETL, transformation, modeling and the visual layer.
* Source data from client systems \- ERP and accounting exports, SharePoint and Excel drops, REST APIs, databases and flat files \- and handle schema changes and bad data without silent failures.
* Automate processes and reports using Python, macros, VBA and ETL tools.
* Use AI tools as a standard part of building reports, dashboards and automation, and own the review, testing and validation of everything they produce before it reaches a client.
* Publish and operate what you ship: scheduled refresh, gateway connections, workspace and access setup, refresh\-failure handling, and documentation good enough to hand over.
* Test and validate outputs before anything reaches a client: numbers tie out to source, control totals reconcile, edge cases handled.
* Client\-facing time: requirement calls, demos, and walkthroughs.
* Maintain and troubleshoot existing dashboards and reports as client data or requirements change.
* Identify gaps and raise the right queries throughout the project lifecycle, from planning to delivery.
* Scale and extend projects based on client feedback, and record and report on work done.
* Participate in developing case studies: scope, record, and report on work done.
* Stay current on relevant tools and techniques to modernize how clients report and automate.



  





**Technical skills** 




  





**Must have** 



* **Python** 
 \- used to independently build reports and automation; comfortable with pandas and with scripting against client data.
* **SQL** 
 \- writing and tuning queries against relational databases for reporting and analysis.
* **Power BI** 
 \- dashboard design, plus Power BI Service \& Power BI Gateway.
* **Power Pivot / DAX** 
 (or MSBI more broadly) \- modelling and calculated measures.
* **Data modelling** 
 \- star schemas, fact and dimension tables, grain, and relationships you set up yourself rather than inherit.
* **Advanced Excel** 
 \- formulas, features, and VBA for Excel (optional) or MS Office automation.
* **Testing and validation** 
 \- reconciling to source, control totals, row\-count and edge\-case checks, and a regression check after a model change. Numbers that tie out are the deliverable; the dashboard is how they get seen.
* **Data handling and access control** 
 \- Power BI row\-level security, workspace and app permissions, gateway credentials, and judgement about what client data may leave the client environment.
* **AI\-assisted delivery** 
 \- fluent and critical use of AI tools for SQL, DAX, and Python.
* **Technical architecture** 
 \- able to read and assess a technical architecture and a project scope, and to say what will and will not work.
* **Git / GitHub** 
 \- branching, pull requests, and review for the Python, SQL and DAX you write. If you have not used it, say so: we will get you there, but you will be working in it.
* **A portfolio** 
 of reports, dashboards or automation to your name, with a github link we can open.
* **Strong analytical and problem\-solving** 
 skills, and a critical mindset.



  





**Good to have** 




 Everything below is welcome, and none of it is a gate. Tell us which of these you have rather than ruling yourself out for the ones you do not.
 



  




* SSIS, or Power Query (Advanced).
* Non\-Excel automation \- UiPath, Power Automate or similar.
* Cloud data warehouses \- Snowflake, BigQuery or Azure Synapse.
* Scheduled ETL and pipeline tools, and orchestration with Task Scheduler, cron or Airflow.
* LLM API integration (Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI) \- retrieval, prompt design, and token and cost control.
* Microsoft Fabric, Power BI dataflows, and deployment pipelines across dev, test and production workspaces.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience handling datasets or preparing automated reports, with at least 1 year of real client project work in Python and Power BI.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in data analytics, data science or a related field. A strong portfolio of delivered dashboards, reports or automation will be considered in place of a formal degree.
* Professional working English \- you will be on client requirement calls, demos and walkthroughs.
* Your own laptop and a reliable broadband connection. This is a remote role, and you will connect to a cloud remote system.
* Legally authorized to work in India.



  





**How we work** 



* **Remote\-first, anywhere in India** 
 . You design your workday around doing your best work, not around a commute.
* **An Awesome Analytics\-provisioned VM** 
 inside our network, with an in\-domain company account.
* **Direct client exposure from early on** 
 \- requirement calls, demos and walkthroughs.
* **GitHub** 
 for code and query work; Google \+ Microsoft Workspace, Slack and Notion for everything else.



  





**Why work with us** 



* **Work that ships** 
 . Your dashboards and reports go into production inside real enterprises. You will see the results of your work in someone’s actual workflow, not in a backlog.
* **A stack worth learning on** 
 . Python, SQL, Power BI and AI\-assisted delivery, on live client builds. This is the toolchain the next ten years of this work is being built on, and you will be using it every day rather than reading about it.
* **Range, then depth** 
 . You will touch the data, the model, the automation, the validation and the client conversation. We would rather you were competent across the whole path and excellent at a deliberate few things than boxed into one layer.
* **Real investment in your growth** 
 . Mentorship, training, and a clear path forward, whether you are a few years in or well established. We back people who are learning faster than their job description.
* **An inclusive team** 
 . We value different perspectives and backgrounds, and we are committed to an environment where everyone’s voice is heard. Analytics is a mindset, not just a degree.



  





**To apply** 




 Complete the application form below. Bring a dashboard, report or portfolio link, and be ready to walk us through one project you built in depth: the data model, the automation, the checks you ran, and the decisions you would now make differently.

title: Associate QA Engineer
description:
At Lemon Yellow, great design deserves great engineering.
   

  

 We bring the design, you bring the tech magic, and together we create UI and UX experiences that make users smile.
   

  

 We are looking for an Associate QA Engineer.
   

  

**Overview:** 
 We are looking for a QA Engineer with strong knowledge of manual testing and a basic understanding of automation and API testing. The role involves testing web and mobile applications, creating test cases, identifying defects, and ensuring a consistent UI/UX across platforms. The ideal candidate should be familiar with Jira, Figma, Excel, Java \+ Selenium/Katalon, and be eager to use AI tools to improve QA efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Quality Assurance \& Testing
+ Perform Manual, Functional, Regression, Smoke, Sanity, and Integration Testing for web and mobile applications.
+ Understand application requirements and ensure functionality meets expected business and user requirements.
+ Identify, document, and validate defects throughout the testing lifecycle.

* Test Case \& Scenario Management
+ Understand business requirements and create, review, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios.
+ Maintain test execution reports and ensure adequate test coverage across application features.
+ Perform retesting and regression testing to ensure issues are properly resolved.

* UI/UX \& Cross\-Platform Testing
+ Perform UI/UX testing and identify design inconsistencies using Figma and other relevant tools.
+ Validate applications across different browsers, devices, screen sizes, and responsive layouts.
+ Ensure the application provides a consistent and user\-friendly experience.

* API \& Automation Testing
+ Perform basic API testing and validate request/response data.
+ Gain exposure to automation testing using Java with Selenium or Katalon Studio.
+ Understand, write, and execute individual automation test scripts to support testing activities.


* Defect Management \& Documentation
+ Log, track, prioritize, and follow up on defects using Jira, Zoho, or similar test and defect management platforms.
+ Maintain test cases, test execution reports, defect reports, and other QA documentation using Excel and test management tools.
+ Collaborate with development teams to ensure defects are resolved and validated within expected timelines.

* Collaboration \& Requirement Analysis
+ Collaborate effectively with Developers, UI/UX Designers, Business Analysts, Clients, and other stakeholders.
+ Participate in requirement discussions and provide a QA perspective to identify potential issues and improve product quality.
+ Contribute to a collaborative and quality\-focused development environment.

* AI\-Assisted QA \& Continuous Improvement
+ Use AI tools responsibly and effectively to improve productivity in test case creation, test data preparation, documentation, and automation support.
+ Explore new QA tools, techniques, and methodologies to improve testing efficiency and product quality.
+ Continuously learn and contribute to improving QA processes and practices.


**Required Skills**
* BE/B.Tech/BSc/BCA or equivalent degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* 0–1 year of experience or strong knowledge in Software Testing / Quality Assurance.
* BFSI / Fintech domain experience or exposure is preferred.
* Good understanding of STLC and SDLC.
* Strong knowledge of Manual and Functional Testing.
* Basic understanding of API Testing.
* Exposure to Java \+ Selenium and/or Katalon Studio.
* Ability to create and maintain basic automation scripts independently.
* Good understanding of UI/UX testing and Figma designs.
* Knowledge of Jira, Zoho, Excel, or similar test and defect management tools.
* Basic understanding of the BFSI/Fintech domain will be an added advantage.
* Good analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and client\-facing environment.
* A passionate QA professional who is eager to learn, comfortable working across multiple teams, and interested in both manual and automation testing.


**What are we offering?**
**Experience**
* A chance to work on meaningful brands and digital products across industries. Every project brings new learning and opportunities to strengthen your development skills. You grow and you help the team grow.


**Exposure**
* If you believe in your work, we believe in you. You get to work directly with clients, understand real\-world problems, and build solutions that create impact.


**Empathy**
* A thoughtfully nurtured culture that values fun and fulfillment.
* Your well\-being, personal, professional, mental, and physical, becomes our priority.
* From Fitness Thursdays to learning sessions, we make sure you laugh, learn, and feel supported.


**Who are we?**
* Lemon Yellow LLP is a user\-centered UI and UX design agency based out of Thane, Maharashtra. With global experience, strong mentorship, and a passionate team, we aim to design digital happiness.
* You should apply if you believe in building experiences that people enjoy using.


**How do you reach us?**
* Well, after you send in your application, it takes us 2\-3 weeks to review it. Sometimes, not often, we might delay just a bit beyond that. This happens when our mailbox is flooded with applications.
* We promise we won’t ghost you; you’ll definitely hear from us. In the meantime, feel free to explore our official website.

Harris Computer Corporation family, helps organizations across healthcare, public sector, utilities, financial services, and other mission\-critical industries transform operations through secure cloud hosting, managed services, and intelligent operational solutions.**

* Maintain and provision development, test, and staging environments
* Automate repetitive engineering tasks with PowerShell and other scripting

* Support containerized workloads using Docker and/or Kubernetes

* Basic understanding of deployment tooling (e.g., TFS, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy)
* Programming or scripting experience, e.g., PowerShell
* Container experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes
* Basic domain administration skills (e.g., Windows Server, patching, Active Directory)
* Experience working with AI CLIs (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex)
* Strong logical aptitude and excellent communication skills


**Nice to Have**
* Working knowledge of packaging tools (e.g., InstallShield, NuGet, npm)
* Experience with SQL Server management (queries, deployments, permissions, DACPAC)
* Knowledge of mobile app deployments to Google Play and/or the App Store
* Understanding of Linux
* Understanding of AI models, weights, and routing

description:
**Company Overview** 




 ABusiness is a technology consulting company specializing in SAP consulting, enterprise integration, cloud solutions, digital transformation, and technology services.
 



 We work on SAP implementation, integration, application development, and enterprise transformation initiatives. As we continue to expand our SAP practice, we are looking for motivated professionals who want to build their careers in the SAP ecosystem and work alongside experienced SAP consultants and technical leaders.
 



  





**Role Overview** 



* We are looking for an enthusiastic and technically driven SAP Associate – SAP Integration with 0–3 years of experience to join our SAP team in Gurugram.
* The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of SAP integration concepts and hands\-on exposure to technologies such as SAP Cloud Integration (CPI), SAP Integration Suite, and SAP API Management (APIM).
* This position is suitable for candidates who want to develop their careers in SAP integration while gaining exposure to real\-world enterprise projects, client environments, development activities, and account management.
* You will work closely with senior SAP consultants, architects, developers, and account stakeholders on implementation, integration, support, and customer engagement activities.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Work with senior SAP team members on SAP integration development, implementation, testing, and support activities.
* Develop, configure, test, and troubleshoot integration flows using SAP Cloud Integration (CPI).
* Assist in designing and implementing APIs using SAP API Management (APIM).
* Support integration between SAP and non\-SAP applications using APIs and standard integration technologies.
* Work with REST APIs, SOAP APIs, OData, JSON, XML, HTTPS, and related integration protocols and formats.
* Assist senior consultants and architects with technical analysis, solution development, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* Participate in requirement discussions and convert business requirements into technical integration tasks.
* Perform testing, debugging, monitoring, and issue resolution for integration scenarios.
* Support API policies, authentication, security, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation for integrations, APIs, configurations, and development activities.
* Collaborate with internal development teams and customer stakeholders.
* Assist senior team members in handling assigned customer accounts, including technical coordination, issue tracking, follow\-ups, and delivery support.
* Participate in customer calls and provide technical updates where required.
* Follow development standards, code\-review processes, documentation standards, and project timelines.
* Continuously develop knowledge across the SAP BTP and SAP Integration ecosystem.



  





**Required Skills \& Knowledge** 



* Candidates should have good knowledge or practical exposure in the following areas:
* SAP Integration Suite
* SAP Cloud Integration (CPI)
* SAP API Management (APIM)
* SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP)
* REST APIs and SOAP Web Services
* OData Services
* JSON and XML
* API authentication and authorization concepts
* Integration monitoring and troubleshooting
* Understanding of cloud and enterprise application integration concepts

* This position requires candidates to work in the US shift aligned with the CST (Central Standard Time) time zone.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 Sarvam’s Work Agents team builds the harness for developing, evaluating, and serving autonomous agents at scale. The harness is the backbone behind how agents are run, tested, orchestrated, and deployed and it needs infrastructure that is as reliable and fast\-moving as the agents themselves.
   

  

 This role sits across both sides of infrastructure. You will build the tooling, pipelines, and automation that make the harness self\-service and reproducible, and you will operate the day\-to\-day keeping CI/CD healthy, environments consistent, networks and tunnels up, and deployments running smoothly. It is a mix of engineering and operations, not pure SRE\-on\-call and not pure platform\-product work.
   

  

 You should be a hands\-on DevOps engineer fluent in Kubernetes, comfortable with cloud infrastructure (AWS primarily, Azure secondarily), and literate in the networking and CI/CD concerns that keep a multi\-cluster, multi\-tenant environment running. You will work closely with the engineers building the harness; your job is to make their work shippable, observable, and operable at scale.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Kubernetes platform operations. Run and maintain multi\-cluster Kubernetes environments — upgrades, node lifecycle, RBAC, namespace hygiene, policy enforcement, and troubleshooting across environments.
* CI/CD and release engineering. Own the pipelines that take the harness from commit to production \- build, test, scan, sign, and deploy across environments, with rollout patterns (canary, blue\-green, rollback) wired into the platform.
* Cloud infrastructure (AWS primary, Azure secondary). Provision and maintain cloud resources via infrastructure\-as\-code \- VPCs, subnets, IAM, compute, storage, and managed services \- with reproducibility and cost awareness built in.
* Networking and connectivity. Manage platform\-level network plumbing — CNI configuration, ingress and service routing, network policies, and secure cross\-cluster and on\-prem connectivity via VPN tunnels, peering, and transit paths.
* Automation and tooling. Build the glue that makes the harness self\-service — CLIs, scripts, operators, and internal tooling that reduce toil and let engineers get work done without filing tickets.
* Observability and reliability. Maintain the metrics, logging, and tracing pipeline; set and tune alerts; and participate in incident response and postmortems so the platform keeps getting better.
* Provisioning and infrastructure\-as\-code. Keep environments standing reproducibly — Terraform / Crossplane, image management, and multi\-vendor cluster bring\-up alongside the team.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 3\+ years in DevOps, SRE, or platform / infrastructure engineering, with hands\-on ownership of systems you ran and improved \- not just scripts that worked once.
* Kubernetes fluency \- you can operate clusters day\-to\-day, understand the scheduler and API machinery well enough to debug failures, and have written or maintained operators, Helm charts, or controllers.
* Cloud proficiency \- solid AWS (VPC, EC2, EKS, IAM, storage, networking) with working knowledge of Azure equivalents; comfort provisioning via Terraform or similar IaC.
* Networking depth \- practical understanding of CNI, ingress, service routing, network policies, and VPN / tunneling (IPsec, WireGuard, site\-to\-site) for secure multi\-cluster and hybrid connectivity.
* CI/CD experience \- you have built and maintained pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Flux, or similar) and understand release engineering at a level beyond “it deploys on push.”
* DevOps tooling chops \- comfort across the toolchain: container runtimes, Helm / Kustomize, Prometheus / Grafana, ELK or Loki, and the judgment to pick the right tool for the job.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals \- Python or Go preferred; you write maintainable automation, not throwaway scripts.
* A product mindset toward internal users \- you measure success by adoption and reduced toil, not by tickets closed.


**Bonus Points**
* Experience with on\-premise infrastructure and deployments.
* Experience operating in air\-gapped or restricted\-network environments \- offline package management, image registries, and disconnected cluster bring\-up.
* Multi\-cluster or multi\-tenant Kubernetes in production, including RBAC and isolation as self\-service.
* Open\-source contributions to Kubernetes, CI/CD, or infrastructure tooling.

description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
   

  

**Cloud Security Analyst**
**Overview:** 
 Lilly Cyber is seeking a skilled Cloud Security Analyst with a strong understanding of cloud security technologies, cloud security posture management (CSPM), and vulnerability management best practices. The ideal candidate will join the Threat Mitigations team and play a pivotal role in supporting threat mitigation activities across Lilly's cloud environments, including infrastructure, cloud\-native applications, containers, and back\-end pipeline management. This is an exciting position that will be dedicated to helping address cloud security risks. As part of a cross\-functional team, this analyst will collaborate closely with a broad set of teams to ensure effective threat reduction. This is an excellent opportunity to grow and experience a wide array of different aspects of cloud cybersecurity while performing a meaningful and impactful role.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Cloud Security \& Threat Mitigation
* Assist Cyber Threat Mitigation Leads in identifying, assessing, and developing solutions to reduce security threats.
* Manage vulnerabilities through their full lifecycle: discovery, triage, ownership assignment, SLA tracking, and remediation verification.
* Continuously monitor multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) using CSPM platforms such as Wiz to identify misconfigurations, excessive permissions, and compliance drift.
* Disposition findings from scanning tools, validating issues, and producing clear remediation guidance for developers.
* Participate in the implementation of mitigation strategies across cloud workloads, containers, APIs, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Contribute to threat modeling activities for new and existing cloud architectures and applications.
* Support burndown of risk with the deployment of security tools through hands on involvement for hard to solve issues.
* Collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders to promote security best practices.
* Support tracking and reporting of security mitigation metrics to provide visibility into risk remediation efforts.
* DevSecOps Management
* Integrate security tooling into CI/CD pipelines to enable shift\-left practices and automated security checks during build process.
* Support pull request gating, secrets scanning, dependency scanning, and infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) scanning across engineering teams.
* Develop scripts to enable automation of scanning and triaging workflows.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 1\-3 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a focus on cloud security and/or vulnerability management.
* Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals across major cloud service providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including identity and access management, network segmentation, encryption, and logging/monitoring.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) platforms (e.g., Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca Security, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, or similar).
* Experience with vulnerability scanners and management platforms (e.g., Wiz, Qualys, Rapid7, or similar).
* Solid understanding of vulnerability management processes, including CVSS scoring, and risk\-based prioritization.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native architectures (containers, Kubernetes, serverless) and the security risks associated with each.
* Understanding of cloud IAM policies, least\-privilege access, and authentication/authorization standards (OAuth 2\.0, SAML) in cloud environments.
* General familiarity with security control technologies (firewalls, encryption, IAM, SIEM, and DLP).
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with a focus on identifying, addressing, and mitigating security risks.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional team environment, fostering collaboration with developers, platform engineers, and security peers.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps) and familiarity with Git workflows and pull request gating.
* Working knowledge of container security (Docker, Kubernetes), image scanning, and IaC scanning (Terraform, CloudFormation).
* Comfort with at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) for security automation.
* Multi\-cloud experience across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including native security services (e.g., AWS Security Hub, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, GCP Security Command Center).
* Threat modeling experience using frameworks such as STRIDE, PASTA, or attack trees.
* Hands\-on experience with security automation tools.
* Cybersecurity or cloud certifications: Security\+, AWS Certified Security \- Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, or a CSPM vendor certification (e.g., Wiz Certified Practitioner).

title: Security Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 





 Nanoprecise
 
  Sci Corp is building the security spine of a next\-generation IoT \+ AI platform used across industrial and enterprise environments. We are looking for a seasoned Security Engineer who combines deep technical offensive and defensive expertise with the ability to architect, automate, and scale security programs across firmware, cloud, AI systems, and wireless infrastructure. 
 



 You will own the security posture of our embedded hardware, CI/CD pipelines, AI implementations, and network perimeter — with a mandate to shift security left, operationalize threat intelligence, and mentor a growing team. 
 



  
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**AI Security** 

  
 



* Design and enforce security controls for all internal and external AI/LLM deployments
* Conduct threat modeling on AI pipelines using MITRE ATLAS and STRIDE frameworks
* Implement prompt injection defenses, output filtering, and AI audit logging
* Lead shadow AI discovery programs and define acceptable use policies
* Perform red teaming exercises against AI models and RAG systems



  
 



  





**DevSecOps** 

  
 



* Own the end\-to\-end security of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
* Integrate SAST (Semgrep, CodeQL), DAST (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite), SCA (Snyk, Dependabot), and secrets scanning (TruffleHog, Gitleaks)
* Implement policy\-as\-code using OPA/Gatekeeper for Kubernetes and IaC environments
* Establish container security standards: image signing (Cosign/Notary), runtime policy (Falco), RBAC hardening
* Drive developer security training and threat modeling in sprint planning



  
 



  





**Firmware Reverse Engineering \& Embedded Security** 

  
 



* Lead firmware security assessments on IoT and edge devices using Ghidra, IDA Pro, Binwalk, Radare2
* Design and enforce secure firmware development lifecycle: signed OTA, secure boot, encrypted comms
* Develop and maintain UART/JTAG/SPI flash extraction capabilities
* Perform vulnerability research on embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare\-metal firmware
* Produce actionable firmware security findings with CVSS\-scored remediation roadmaps



  
 



  





**Wireless \& Network Security** 

  
 



* Conduct WiFi penetration tests across enterprise WPA2/WPA3, 802\.1X, and guest network segments
* Assess IoT wireless protocols: BLE, Zigbee, LoRa, Z\-Wave for security weaknesses
* Deploy and tune Wireless Intrusion Detection Systems (WIDS)
* Develop wireless hardening standards and migration roadmaps (e.g., PSK → 802\.1X)
* Investigate rogue AP incidents, PMKID captures, and deauthentication attacks



  
 



  





**Security Architecture \& Operations** 

  
 



* Design Zero Trust network architecture with microsegmentation and identity\-aware access
* Own SIEM integration (Splunk, Elastic, Sentinel) and threat intelligence operationalization
* Lead incident response for security events across firmware, cloud, AI, and wireless layers
* Produce executive\-level risk reports translating technical findings into business impact



  
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Domain Expertise** 



* 3\+ years in security engineering, with demonstrable expertise across at least 3 of the 4 core domains (AI security, DevSecOps, firmware RE, wireless pentesting)
* Deep hands\-on experience with firmware analysis toolchains: Ghidra, IDA Pro, Binwalk, Firmwalker, QEMU/Firmadyne
* Proven WiFi/wireless pentesting skills: Aircrack\-ng, Kismet, Bettercap, Hostapd, Wireshark, HCXTOOLS
* Strong DevSecOps pipeline experience: SAST/DAST/SCA integration, secrets management, IaC security
* Experience securing AI/ML systems and LLM\-powered applications in production environments
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT\&CK, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Top 10, NIST AI RMF
* Strong scripting skills: Python, Bash; familiarity with Go or Rust is a plus
* Relevant certifications preferred: OSCP, OSWP, GREM, GWAPT, CKS, or equivalent



  
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 This role will define how our organization secures AI\-powered products from chip to cloud. You will directly influence the security architecture of devices deployed in critical industrial environments, protect AI systems used by thousands of enterprise users, and build the DevSecOps culture that enables us to ship secure software fast. 
 



 Your work will prevent breaches, protect customer data, and ensure our AI implementations remain trustworthy, auditable, and resilient against emerging threats. 
 



  
 



  





**KPIs for the Role** 




**DevSecOps \& Pipeline Security (35%)** 

  
 



* 100% of production pipelines with full security gate coverage within 6 months
* MTTR for critical pipeline vulnerabilities \< 48 hours
* Zero high\-severity secrets leak incidents per quarter



  
 



  





**AI Security (35%)** 

  
 



* AI security assessment coverage: 100% of production AI systems assessed within first 90 days
* Shadow AI discovery: \< 5 unmanaged AI tools in use at any time
* Prompt injection detection rate: \> 95% of known attack patterns blocked



  
 



  





**Firmware \& Hardware Security (20%)** 

  
 



* 100% of new device firmware reviewed before production deployment
* Mean time to patch firmware CVEs: \< 30 days for critical, \< 90 days for high
* Secure boot and OTA signing coverage: \> 95% of deployed device fleet



  
 



  





**Wireless Security (10%)** 

  
 



* 100% of enterprise WiFi migrated to WPA3/802\.1X within 12 months
* Rogue AP mean time to detection and containment: \< 4 hours
* Wireless security assessment: 100% of new sites assessed before go\-live

title: Social Media Associate
description:
We are looking for a sincere, creative, and detail\-oriented Social Media Associate who can support our LinkedIn\-focused content and social media activities.

This role is mainly suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates. However, a minimum of **1 year of experience in social media, content writing, LinkedIn content, digital marketing, or a similar field** will be preferred.

The ideal candidate should have strong English writing skills, a working understanding of LinkedIn, and the ability to use AI tools effectively for content ideation, drafting, proofreading, research, and content improvement.

This role requires someone who can think smartly, write clearly, follow instructions carefully, and help maintain a professional and consistent online presence.

**Key Eligibility Criteria**

* Minimum **80% in Class 10**.
* Minimum **80% in Class 12**.
* Minimum **60% in Graduation**.
* Education from an **English\-medium school is mandatory**.
* Freshers may apply; however, **minimum 1 year of relevant experience is preferred**.
* Candidate must have a **working LinkedIn profile of their own**.
* Strong written English with good grammar, sentence structure, clarity, and flow.
* Good spoken English for internal communication and coordination.
* Basic understanding of LinkedIn content, professional branding, social media posting, and audience engagement.
* Practical knowledge of using **AI tools such as ChatGPT or similar platforms** for content ideas, drafting, editing, proofreading, summarizing, and improving content.
* Ability to use AI intelligently while reviewing, refining, and correcting the output instead of blindly copying it.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality and consistency.
* Good time management and ability to complete tasks within deadlines.
* Disciplined, responsible, and willing to learn.
* Comfortable working in a structured, quality\-focused, and performance\-oriented environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

The selected candidate may be expected to:

* Assist in creating LinkedIn\-focused content for professional branding and company visibility.
* Draft, edit, proofread, and organize social media content in clear and professional English.
* Support content planning, post ideas, captions, hooks, and basic content structuring.
* Use AI tools for content ideation, drafting, proofreading, research, and refinement.
* Review AI\-generated content carefully and improve it for tone, grammar, clarity, relevance, and originality.
* Help maintain consistency in brand voice, messaging, and content quality.
* Research industry trends, professional topics, and content ideas relevant to the company’s audience.
* Support LinkedIn profile and page activities, including content preparation and basic engagement tracking.
* Coordinate internally for content inputs, approvals, and posting requirements.
* Organize content drafts, calendars, references, and social media material properly.
* Support other content and documentation\-related tasks as required.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is not only interested in social media, but also understands the importance of professional communication.

The ideal candidate should be able to write well, use LinkedIn actively, understand basic content presentation, and use AI tools smartly to improve the quality and speed of work.

We value:

* Strong English writing ability.
* Interest in LinkedIn and professional content.
* AI familiarity and smart tool usage.
* Creativity with structure.
* Attention to detail.
* Discipline and time management.
* Willingness to learn.
* Accountability in assigned work.
* Consistency in output quality.

**Work Schedule**

* **Role Type:** Full\-time
* **Working Hours:** 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM
* **Work Duration:** 9 hours per day

**Who Should Apply**

This role is suitable for freshers or early\-career candidates who have strong English communication skills, interest in LinkedIn\-based content, and the ability to use AI tools productively.

Candidates who take pride in writing, enjoy social media content, understand professional communication, and want to grow in a structured work environment will be a good fit for this role.

**Application Requirement**

Applicants may be asked to share:

* Updated resume.
* Class 10, Class 12, and Graduation percentages.
* Confirmation of English\-medium schooling.
* Link to their LinkedIn profile.
* Writing samples, social media posts, captions, blogs, or any previous content work.
* Brief note on AI tools they have used and how they use them for content or social media work.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**

  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. **ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for an engineering fresher who is happy to be on the ground rather than behind a desk all day. This is a multipurpose, hands\-on role covering building inspections, repair and maintenance supervision, and day\-to\-day facility management across our office and group properties in and around Bangalore. It suits someone who wants broad practical exposure early in their career — civil works, MEP maintenance, vendor handling and reporting — instead of one narrow specialisation.

* Carry out periodic building and site inspections at office premises, project sites and group properties, and record observations with photographs in a structured field visit report.

* Working knowledge of MS Excel and MS Word; ability to read basic drawings and layouts.

* Practical, self\-starting attitude, and the discipline to close a job and report it rather than leave it half done.

* Exposure across construction, real estate and facility management under one roof.

* Clear growth path into Site Engineer / Projects \& Facilities Executive roles.

Send your CV to **hr@pirgal.com**, with a copy to **sahana@pirgal.com**, using the subject line **“Application – Site \& Facilities Engineer (Fresher)”**.
